V USA na rozdiel od Eurpy nevidme nedostatok energetickch surovn a ich vysok ceny. Tu nemono hovori o energetickej krze na rozdiel od Eurpy. V Eurpe zase na rozdiel od USA nie s zatia iadne zsadn problmy vo finannom sektore. V Amerike nedvno padli tri banky, zatia o v Eurpe nepadla iadna. Problmy vajiarskej Credit Suisse nie s vnym problmom? Credit Suisse vyzer v poriadku. Nedvno potrebovala pomoc od vajiarskej nrodnej banky, dostala ju, ale vyzer ako solventn banka. Je niekde plne inde ako tie tri americk banky, ktor s u dvno po smrti. V eurozne v tejto chvli nevidie iadne znaky finannej krzy. Situcia sa vak v najblich doch bude urite zaujmavo vyvja. Zvis al vvoj energetickej krzy od toho, ako rchlo doke njs Eurpa alternatvne zdroje v dostatonej miere? V strednodobom a dlhodobom hadisku ide presne o to, o ste povedali. Eurpa zatia vemi spene nachdza alternatvu k ruskmu plynu. Presun z tradinch, povedzme, foslnych zdrojov energie na obnoviten zdroje, ako slnko, voda, vietor, sa pre konflikt na Ukrajine znane urchuje. Ale napriek tomu to bude nejak as trva. Hovorme o rokoch, nie o mesiacoch. Je teraz medzi odbornou verejnosou v Spojench ttoch vou tmou skr stabilita bankovho sektora ne inflcia, ktor dominuje v Eurpe? Urite, zatia je to takto. Pre ekonmov v centrlnych bankch s kov obe tmy: inflcia aj finann stabilita. Problmom je, e v tchto doch prichdzaj tieto dve tmy do istej miery do konfliktu, kee sprsovanie menovej politiky na jednej strane pomha zniova inflciu, no na druhej strane me prispieva k finannej nestabilite. Problm americkej SVB odtartoval tm, e pre vysok inflciu zaali rs roky. Startupy prili o lacn zdroj financovania a zaali vyahova vklady z banky. Take km sa inflcia dostane na rozumn rove, narobia rastce rokov sadzby ete vea problmov podnikateom vo svete? Verm, e nie, ale je jasn, e nrast rokovch sadzieb zniuje trhov ceny dlhopisov a inch aktv, ktor maj dlhodob hotovostn toky. Sprsovanm menovej politiky sa centrlne banky snaia docieli cenov stabilitu, ie bojuj s inflciou. Ale do istej miery to ide na kor finannej stability, o ktorej hovorte. Take zvyovanie rokovch mier krtkodobo bankm kod, pretoe zniuje trhov ceny dlhopisov, ktor vlastnia. Ale zase dlhodobo im pome, kee im pome navi rokov mare. Je eurpska regulcia prsnejia ako americk? no, urite je prsnejia, najm pre stredne vek banky, ako bola Silicon Valley Bank. Stredne vek americk banky maj rzne vnimky na regulan poiadavky, take vina z nich nespa mnoh kritri, ktor by v Eurpe spa museli. Aj v prpade vekch bnk s rozdiely. Naprklad vek eurpske banky maj na rozdiel od americkch vo svojich portflich vy podiel likvidnch, teda ahko predajnch aktv. Je pre ne ahie zska hotovos v prpade, e by vea vkladateov chcelo naraz vybra svoje vklady, o sa stalo v SVB. Ke to zhrniem, vek eurpske banky s prsnejie regulovan ako vek americk banky. A vek americk banky maj zase prsnejie pravidl ako stredne vek americk banky. Klientmi SVB boli najm technologick startupy, ktor neustli rastce roky. Ukzalo sa tak zloenie klientely ako vek problm? Nemyslm si, e to bol jej hlavn problm. Skr ilo o to, e viac ako 90 percent vkladov banky nebolo poistench. Klienti si chceli nepoisten vklady vybra v rovnak as von. Do istej miery preto, lebo boli z jednho sektora, ie tam s vami shlasm. To prispelo k pdu tejto banky. Ak je zodpovednos regultora, teda americkej centrlnej banky Fed? Ke bol covid, poiadavku na povinn minimlne rezervy znila na nula percent a neskr sa to u nezmenilo. Nebola to chyba? Poiadavku na minimlne rezervy nepovaujem za problm. To nebol problm SVB ani iadnej inej banky, ktor sa nedvno dostala do problmov. V poslednch rokoch banky na oboch stranch Atlantiku postupne naakumulovali obrovsk mnostvo nadbytonch rezerv najm v dsledku kvantitatvneho uvoovania (centrlna banka nakupovala na sekundrnom trhu od komernch bnk ttne dlhopisy a dlie aktva, pozn. E). Take banky nemali iaden problm s poiadavkou na minimlne rezervy, mali prli vea nadbytonch rezerv. Tam nevidm regulan problm. Kde bol teda problm? V roku 2018 prilo v USA k bankovej deregulcii, v rmci ktorej banky s aktvami do 250 milird dolrov u nemuseli spa prsne kritri Fedu ohadom poiadaviek na likviditu, kapitlov primeranos, zaov testy a tak alej. Tkalo sa to aj SVB, ktor mala aktva okolo 200 milird. Idea bola tak, e menie a stredne vek banky nepredstavuj a tak vek systmov riziko. Teraz sme zistili, e to tak nie je. Hranica medzi tm, ktor banka je systmovo dleit a ktor u nie, sa prve posunula smerom nadol. Take no, vidm regulan problm, ale nevidm ho v minimlnych rezervch, ale skr v deregulcii. Preto by som sa neudoval, keby USA v najblich mesiacoch prehodnotili systm regulcie stredne vekch bnk. Paradoxn je, e pred piatimi rokmi tieto banky vrtane SVB silno lobovali v prospech deregulcie. Mysleli si, e im to pome a teraz pre to trpia. Ak by tak banka bola v Eurpe, dostala by sa do takch problmov alebo nie? Ak by SVB bola v Eurpe, bola by podstatne prsnejie regulovan. Poviem dva prklady. Eurpsky regultor by ju nechal urobi zaov testy, o sa stane s bankovm kapitlom, ke sa rokov sadzby zvia - povedzme - o tri percent. Takto test by rchlo odhalil rizikovos portflia SVB a viedol by k nprave. V USA pre spomnan deregulciu na tak testy nedolo. Dobre manaovan banka by si ich urobila interne a riziko by si zahedovala, ale SVB nebola dobre manaovan banka. Okrem toho na stredne vek banky ako SVB sa vzahuj in kapitlov poiadavky ako v Eurpe. V tomto prpade bolo dleit, e nerealizovan straty z nakpench dlhopisov nedvhali kapitlov poiadavky SVB. Viac ako polovica jej aktv bola v dlhodobch dlhopisoch, ktor stratili trhov hodnotu po nraste rokovch sadzieb. SVB vak nemusela navyova svoj kapitl a tieto dlhopisy sa naalej viedli v pvodnej hodnote, za ktor ich banka nakpila. V Eurpe a ani pri vekch americkch bankch by to tak nebolo. V om zlyhalo vedenie banky? Vedenie banky si z nejakho dvodu zobralo na plecia obrovsk rokov riziko. Viac ako polovica aktv bola v dlhodobch dlhopisoch, ktorch ceny s vystaven pohybom rokovch sadzieb. V Amerike je mlo bnk, ktor maj tak vek podiel dlhodobch dlhopisov na aktvach, ako mala SVB. Navye viac ako 90 percent vkladov v banke bolo nepoistench. Ilo o vysok firemn vklady. Neviem, i je ete vbec nejak banka v USA, ktor by mala tieto dve rizik naraz: tak vysok podiel dlhopisov na strane aktv a sasne tak vysok podiel nepoistench vkladov na strane pasv. Ak tak banka existuje, som presveden, e nie je ani zaleka tak vek, ako bola SVB, ktor bola 16. najvia banka v USA. Jednoznane tam zlyhal manament. Postupne sa dozvedme preo. o sa ete ukzalo ako problm? SVB bola jedna z bnk, ktor a do svojho krachu naplno vyuvala prcu z domu. udia pracovali z Havaja, Floridy, Kalifornie, odkia chceli. Ke mte tak kultru a vznikne problm typu nezahedovan rokov riziko a nemte ani loveka, ktor to m na starosti, lebo SVB ho vye pol roka nemala, nie je v zujme nikoho iniciova Zoom call, kde sa tieto problmy bud riei. Keby udia pracovali priamo v banke, viac by sa bavili aj neformlne. Tto tma by zrejme prila na pretras. S aj v Eurpe banky, ktor maj prli vea dlhodobch dlhopisov a prli vea vkladov, ktor u nepodliehaj poisteniu? Urite sa aj v Eurpe njdu tak banky. Regultori teraz na to vemi prsne pozeraj. Ale pochybujem, e sa njde banka, v ktorej s oba tieto problmy naraz. Ak by aj bola, bola by prsnejie regulovan, musela by ma tunejie kapitlov vanke, ako mala SVB. o sa tka dlhopisov - na porovnanie v bankch na Slovensku tvoria dlhopisy v priemere 11 percent aktv, v SVB to bolo skoro 60 percent. Ak je ponauenie z prpadu SVB? Je ich viac. Manamentom bnk tento prpad pripomenul dleitos riadenia rokovho rizika a diverzifikcie vkladov. Banky si musia lepie uvedomova, e m maj vy podiel nepoistench vkladov, tm s viac vystaven riziku, e zafka vietor a vklady sa zo da na de vyparia. Regultori musia viac sledova prve podiel nepoistench vkladov v banke a zamyslie sa nad tm, i by banky s ich vysokm podielom nemali spa prsnejie podmienky. A mono ete jedno pouenie. V Kalifornii, kde SVB psobila a kde bola aj regulovan, vemi dbaj na nefinann aspekty ako environmentlny vplyv bnk i podiel verov meninm. To s veci, na ktor regultori mu dba, ale urite by mali viac dba na to, aby banka mala zabezpeen rokov riziko. Je prpad SVB stle vekou tmou v USA? Z reakcie trhov sa me zda, e ilo skr o krtku epizdku. Pevne verm, e SVB aj Credit Suisse bud tak krtkodob epizdky, ako hovorte. Ale urite sa o tom bude hovori aj dlhie, pretoe Fed pristpil k niektorm krokom, ktor boli bezprecedentn. Naprklad rozril poistenie na vetky vklady a zaviedol nov mechanizmus na poskytovanie verov bankm. Urite sa bude hovori aj o tom, i by nieo podobn mohli urobi Eurpania, ak by sa nieo podobn stalo v Eurpe. Do akej miery limitovalo Eurpsku centrlnu banku pri nedvnom rozhodovan o rokoch dianie na bankovom trhu? Je si urite vedom sasnch problmov v Spojench ttoch, o sa tka finannej stability. Poda ma urobila sprvne rozhodnutie v tom, e oddeuje cenov stabilitu od finannej stability a bude pouva rzne nstroje na to, aby sa jej podarilo dosiahnu svoje ciele v oboch tchto smeroch. Eurpska centrlna banka zvila kov, refinann sadzbu o 50 bzickch bodov na 3,5 percenta. Bude vo zvyovan rokov pokraova alej? Osobne to oakvam, kee problm inflcie v Eurpe ete nie je zaleka plne zaehnan. Boj s inflciou je pre ECB priorita slo jedna. ie predpokladte, e banky na Slovensku pravdepodobne ete zvia roky na hypotky? Je na individulnom rozhodnut kadej komernej banky, za akch podmienok bude poskytova hypotekrne very. Ale banky, prirodzene, musia prihliada na trhov podmienky. Krtkodob rokov sadzby, ktor stanovuje ECB, pjdu pravdepodobne ete tento rok hore. To potom bude vytvra tlak aj na sadzby na hypotky. Z viacerch odbornch kruhov je pou upozornenie, e finann trhy u ovea viac ako v nedvnej minulosti zana zaujma kvalita a zdravie verejnch financi. Je to zdvihnut varovn prst aj pre slovensk verejn financie, ak nechceme, aby piky ttu vrazne zdraeli? rokov sadzby s dnes sce vyie, ale kad krajina m dlhopisy rznej maturity (splatnosti, pozn. E). Problm vych rokovch sadzieb sa dostane do ttneho rozpotu a vtedy, ke je dlh refinancovan. Sce u rokov sadzby narstli, ale ete sa to nestalo zsadnm problmom pre verejn financie. Ale urite sa o tom v najblich mesiacoch bude hovori viac. U mme za sebou pandmiu, ktor si vyadovala vyie fiklne nklady, a teraz je u na mieste konsolidcia verejnch financi. V naom parlamente sa teraz pr mesiacov pred vobami predkladaj asto narchlo rzne poslaneck nvrhy, ktor zvyuj vdavky. Nemte aj vy obavu, e ke to takto pjde alej, meme si plne rozbi verejn financie? To, o sa deje, je pomerne normlne v predvolebnom obdob. Title: ubo Pstor: Slovakia is still threatened by recession, it now has one main problem (hnonline.sk)
text: ubos Pastor: Slovakia is still threatened by recession, it now has one main one Problem (hnonline.sk) May 26, 2023 Professor of Finance and NBS Bank Board member ubos Pastor describes the challenges and his expectations for the Slovak and foreign economies. He also advises what we should do to make our higher education more attractive. In connection with the migration of qualified people between countries, we know two phenomena, the so-called brain drain, i.e. the emigration of highly qualified people abroad, and brain gain, when such people return to their country of origin and bring with them new skills or capital. You also left Slovakia as a young man, you settled in the USA, but without the experience you gained abroad, whether at work or in academia, you might not be able to help Slovakia in the way you help. How do you look at it? I partly belong to both phenomena, but in my case I would call the overall effect brain gain. I have spent more than 25 years in the USA, I learned something there and I am very happy to share it with people here in Slovakia. We are also asking about this because this topic has been coming to the fore in Slovakia in recent weeks. There is a lot of talk about brain drain or leaving highly skilled workforce abroad. The solution to this problem has also been set as one of the priorities by the new government of experts. What effects do you think this phenomenon has on the economy? In my opinion, it is a natural phenomenon that people leave and come. No one blames Slovak or Swiss hockey players for going to play in the NHL. Switzerland is a rich country, yet they go to the USA to play because they have better conditions for what they are passionate about. I also think that it is okay for Slovak students to go to study at a good university abroad. In Slovakia, however, we would need more students from other countries to come to study with us. Whether from Ukraine, Poland or any other countries. To this end, it is necessary for us to raise the level of our higher education. We don't have to be ashamed of the fact that our students go to the best schools in the USA or Great Britain, but we could do something about the fact that they are leaving en masse for education in the Czech Republic as well. We could easily turn the situation around so that more Czech students come to us. So the effort should be to keep our university students here, so that they do not leave, for example, to Brno or Prague, where they usually end up staying After studying? I'd rather turn it around. We should not prevent people from leaving. This happened under the previous regime, that people were prevented from going abroad. It is more important to create conditions for them to want to return and for people from other countries to want to come to us. We need to create a quality environment for business, science, research or innovation that will attract them here. What do you think certain specific solutions could look like, how to attract them?  We discussed this in the context of the recovery plan at the NBS about two years ago. It would be very useful to create centers of excellence in Slovakia. We don't have to be the best at everything, we need to choose a few areas that belong to the future. This can be, for example, a certain aspect of battery production or cybersecurity. Something at this level and in it to get among the best, so that people from neighboring countries who want to to study one of these areas, they headed to us. We cannot compete with China or the United States in some large areas, but we can find one or two niche areas, pour resources into them, attract the best Slovaks at the beginning, later foreign experts and try it this way.  area, for example, we should focus on the automotive industry, which is currently a very strong component of our Economy? That's where I would probably start. The automotive industry is currently in the stage of transition to electric vehicles. By 2035, the European Union is committed to switching to them. With this However, a number of problems need to be solved during the transition, whether it is the charging infrastructure or the improvement of various aspects of batteries. Another area may be artificial intelligence, which is currently developing very rapidly, we have made a big leap forward in the last six months. Perhaps there would be a sub-area in that area where Slovak scientists were able to compete with the rest of the world.
text_original: ubo Pstor: Slovensku stle hroz recesia, m teraz jeden hlavn problm (hnonline.sk) 26. mj 2023 Profesor financi a len Bankovej rady NBS ubo Pstor opisuje vzvy a svoje oakvania pre slovensk, ale aj zahranin ekonomiku. Tie rad, o by sme mali robi, aby nae vysok kolstvo bolo atraktvnejie. V svislosti s migrciou kvalifikovanch ud medzi krajinami poznme dva fenomny, takzvan brain drain, teda emigrciu vysokokvalifikovanch ud do zahraniia, a brain gain, ke sa takto udia vrtia do krajiny pvodu a prinaj so sebou nov zrunosti alebo kapitl. Vy ste tie zo Slovenska odili ako mlad, usadili ste sa v USA, avak bez tch sksenost, ktor ste nadobudli v zahrani, i u pracovne, alebo na akademickej pde, by ste mono nemohli pomha Slovensku takm spsobom, ako pomhate. Ako sa na to pozerte? Sasti patrm k obom fenomnom, ten celkov efekt by som vak vo svojom prpade nazval brain gain. V USA som strvil u vye 25 rokov, nieo som sa tam nauil a vemi rd sa o to podelm aj s umi tu na Slovensku. Ptame sa na to aj preto, e v poslednch tdoch sa na Slovensku tto tma dostva do popredia. Vea sa rozprva o odleve mozgov i odchode vysokokvalifikovanch pracovnch sl do zahraniia. Rieenie tohto problmu si ako jednu z priort stanovila aj nov vlda odbornkov. Ak m poda vs tento fenomn vplyvy na ekonomiku? Poda ma ide o prirodzen jav, e udia odchdzaj a prichdzaj. Nikto nevin slovenskch alebo vajiarskych hokejistov z toho, e chodia hrva do NHL. vajiarsko je bohat krajina, napriek tomu chodia hrva do USA, pretoe tam maj lepie podmienky na to, pre o maj ve. Takisto si myslm, e je v poriadku, ke slovensk tudenti id za tdiom na nejak dobr univerzitu v zahrani. Na Slovensku by sme vak potrebovali, aby aj k nm chodilo tudova viac tudentov z inch krajn. i u z Ukrajiny, z Poska alebo akchkovek alch ttov. S tmto cieom je nutn, aby sme zvili rove nho vysokho kolstva. Nemusme sa hanbi za to, e nai tudenti odchdzaj na najlepie koly do USA alebo Vekej Britnie, mohli by sme vak robi nieo s tm, e hromadne odchdzaj za vzdelanm aj do eska. Pokojne by sme mohli t situciu otoi, aby viac eskch tudentov prichdzalo k nm. Snaha by teda mala by v tom, aby sme si tu udrali naich vysokokolkov, aby neodchdzali naprklad do Brna i Prahy, kde nakoniec vinou ostan aj po tdiu? Skr by som to otoil. Nemali by sme brni uom v tom, aby odchdzali. To sa dialo za minulho reimu, e sa uom brnilo odchdza do zahraniia. Dleitejie je vytvori podmienky, aby sa chceli vrti a aby k nm chceli chodi aj udia z inch krajn. Potrebujeme tu vytvori kvalitn prostredie na podnikanie, vedu, vskum i inovcie, ktor ich sem pritiahne. Ako by mohli poda vs vyzera urit konkrtne rieenia, ako ich pritiahnu? V svislosti s plnom obnovy sme o tom v NBS hovorili u pribline pred dvoma rokmi. Vemi uiton by bolo vytvori na Slovensku centr excelentnosti. Nemusme by vo vetkom najlep, treba si vybra niekoko oblast, ktorm patr budcnos. Me s naprklad o ist aspekt vroby batri alebo kyberbezpenos. Nieo na takejto rovni a v tom sa dosta medzi najlepch, aby udia z okolitch ttov, ktor bud chcie tudova nejak z tchto oblast, zamierili prve k nm. My nememe konkurova ne alebo Spojenm ttom v nejakch vekch oblastiach, meme si vak njs jednu-dve niche oblasti, vrazi do nich prostriedky, na zaiatku pritiahnu najlepch Slovkov, neskr zahraninch expertov a sksi to touto cestou. V ktorej oblasti by to naprklad mohlo by, mali by sme sa sstredi na automobilov priemysel, ktor je v sasnosti vemi silnou zlokou naej ekonomiky? Tam by som asi zaal. Automobilov priemysel je momentlne v tdiu prechodu na elektrick vozidl. Do roku 2035 sa Eurpska nia zaviazala na ne prejs. Pri tomto prechode je vak potrebn doriei mnostvo problmov, i u nabjaciu infratruktru, alebo skvalitovanie rznych aspektov batri. alou oblasou me by umel inteligencia, ktor sa v sasnosti vemi rchlo rozvja, za posledn polrok sme urobili vek skok vpred. V tej oblasti by sa mono nala nejak podoblas, v ktorej by slovensk vedci boli schopn konkurova zvyku sveta.

Title: Choose reason, respect and responsibility (interview with professor ubo Pstor for Forbes)
text: To choose reason, respect and responsibility (interview with Professor ubos Pastor for Forbes) July 6, 2023 We talk about the world economy, China, investment and the upcoming elections with a member of the Bank Board of the NBS and a professor working in the USA by ubos Pastor. This question has been of interest to many people in recent months, at least those who have or want to have a mortgage loan: what rate they will receive. That is, of course, it depends on the decision of the European Central Bank. What is yours forecast? Will rates continue to rise in Europe? I think we are approaching the top. There will be at least one more increase in the summer. The question shifts from how high the central bank will go to speculation about how long it will stay at these elevated levels. The situation is similar in the USA, although there are rates two percentage points higher. So how long will rates stay at their current high levels? It will be at least a year, maybe two. However, it depends, of course, on what happens by then. We have seen that central banks are able to back down from their plans if necessary. If a new crisis comes, which we do not know about today, interest rates may go down very quickly. So mortgage interest rates will remain at elevated levels? Borrowers were used to much lower percentages. The level of interest rates that we have today is much more natural than that of previous years. Mortgages for one percent are not normal. And another question that many people are dealing with. Why do we have such high inflation in Slovakia? Its rate has already begun to fall. This year, it will be around ten percent, which is less than last year. The worst is behind us. The reason why it was more so in our country than in Western Europe is related to the geographical proximity to Russia and food. They form together with energy, a larger part of consumer expenditure in our country than in the countries of Western Europe. For this reason, inflation in the Baltic countries reached twenty percent. In recent years, we have seen a shift away from the economy towards other arguments - not only in the decision-making of companies, but also in political and public discourse. In the current election campaign, there is almost no talk about the economy in Slovakia. Why is that? You are right. The economy has receded into the background. Even in the US, where I live most of the time, culture wars are more frequent than debates about the economic situation. There is talk of guns and abortion or racial inequality. At the same time, no one is concerned with the fact that the US budget will show a deficit of perhaps as much as eight percent of GDP this year, in good times, when unemployment is 3.5 percent, which is close to an all-time low. What is the reason for this? Good question. Maybe it's because during the pandemic, people became interested in esoteric issues and are still waging frog-mouse wars about them. What would you say to Slovak voters? According to what they should do in September decide? I believe that they will choose reason, mutual respect, respect and economic responsibility. One of the topics of your academic thesis is bubbles in the financial markets. Can you summarize what you have come to? Why do bubbles form? First, we need to define what a bubble actually is. When you consider it to be a sharp rise and subsequent decline in stock prices, then this movement can cause all sorts of things. Most people He considers this to be a bubble. However, I consider it to be a period when asset prices are clearly and significantly overvalued compared to fundamentals. It is extremely difficult to determine in real time whether we are currently in a bubble. There is a well-known case when the US central banker Alan Greenspan warned of a possible bubble in 1996, and the stock markets then cheerfully continued to grow strongly for almost four years, until In the new millennium, they really fell. In the meantime, however, they have almost doubled. So when should we pay attention and worry about a bubble? Is there any signal? Even a person who has very good information and knowledge cannot define it exactly. The most useful signals include technological innovations and the companies that bring them, entering the market through IPOs, euphoria on the markets, when even small investors in large numbers buy, and a large volume of trades in the market. If we see a combination of these factors, we are more likely to be in a bubble. This description fits the period we had after the pandemic. Even today, there is a strong growth of stock markets. Are we in danger of a bubble again? So far, I don't see the markets being inflated in any way. They are still below the level of a year and a half ago, despite the inflation that we have had here in the meantime. However, the shares have risen by twenty percent in a year. Do we have a new bull market? Is such a designation justified? It's the right label. And it's also a pleasant surprise. When central banks began to raise interest rates, it was unclear to what extent they would slow down the economy. Many feared a significant recession. In the US, rates went up very quickly by about five percent.  In the past, such sharp rate hikes used to lead to a relatively deep recession. This time it didn't happen. The labor market is resilient, the economy is functioning. The market is now starting to be optimistic that the expected recession may not come after all. It's nice The surprise is that the sharp increase in rates has not yet brought a slump in the economy. However, the threat has not completely disappeared yet. The eurozone is in a technical recession. The economy is hovering around zero growth. We are stagnating, the question is whether we will keep the neck.  However, the NBS still expects a slight growth of the economy. Why do you consider the emergence of new companies and their IPOs to be a sign of a bubble? Whenever new technologies appear, new companies are created. It is not clear which of them will become the future leader. Out of five companies, there may be one. Today, its market price is undervalued, but it will grow in the future. Maybe one more will make a living company. It is currently valued fairly. However, three out of five companies will drop out because they will not be able to compete. Their price is highly overestimated today. Never in advance You don't know which of the companies will survive and which will close. So does it make more sense to buy the entire market than to look for a future winner? For a small investor who does not have very good information, it certainly is. So in the dilemma between passive and active asset management, are you on the passive side? If you are a regular investor who does not have a unique source of information, you certainly are. The vast majority of us do not have such information. Even a large number of professional fund managers cannot beat the market. Ordinary investors should therefore focus on passive investment. Does it make sense to watch the market for bargain purchases, or are you in favor of regular investing? When an amateur wants to time the market, he has little chance of succeeding. He would use his time better if he educated himself and worked on himself to earn and save more. So a better investment than timing the market is to devote yourself to yourself? Exactly. If you're able to earn more at work and save on the side, it's a better way to increase your return. Where did your hobby for economics come from? I grew up under socialism. I've been interested in mathematics since I was a child. When the revolution came, I was fifteen years old and I was in high school. At that time, the economic system changed completely. The market economy came. Everything was new, turbulent and difficult to understand for me, accustomed to the mathematical order. I was fascinated by learning about society at a time when it was changing dramatically. Gradually, I found out that my interest in society and rigorous research can be nicely combined in the study of economics. Where did you study? Secondary school at the Postova Grammar School in Kosice, university at the Faculty of Management of Comenius University in Bratislava and also a year at the University of Kansas. I have a doctorate from the Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania. Did you stay in the US after school? Yes. Immediately after my doctorate, I found a position at the University of Chicago, where I have been working for twenty-four years. It's like when a hockey player goes to the NHL. He doesn't do it because he likes it so much in the USA or Canada, but because the league there is worth it. What drives you forward? I'm a curious person who wants to leave something behind. What exactly do you mean by that? I feel a social responsibility. This is also the reason why I have been working at the National Bank of Slovakia as a member of the Bank Board for eight years. My academic research is also an effort to leave something. His outputs will stay here for a long time, at least I hope. What I like about academic work is creating lasting value in the form of professional publications, as well as learning of students, who are then successful in practice. Which of your theoretical works do you consider the most valuable? I will mention three areas. At the moment, my most cited work on liquidity is as risk factor in financial markets. Another topic is the impact of political uncertainty on the financial markets. And the latest topic is sustainable investing. Did you receive the Moskowitz Prize for it this year? Yes. One of my main results in this area is that the expected return of green investments should be slightly lower than the expected return on brown investments. This is true for two reasons. Which ones are they? People like to own green assets. They have a non-financial benefit from it, a good feeling. Thus, green assets are sold at a higher price, which causes them to have a lower expected return towards the future. The second reason is that green assets provide better hedging against climate risk. When a negative climate event occurs, Green stocks respond better than brown stocks. Because they have this advantage, they only need to offer a smaller expected return for the future. Brown stocks, on the contrary, have to offer more to compensate the investor for climate risk. We all know that our economy is changing towards sustainable energies. We will take more and more of them from the sun and wind, but since we all know this, this should already be reflected in asset prices. You mentioned the political risk. Does this also apply to the times we are living in right now? Exactly. Standard models in financial economics do not have an element of government making policy decisions. My work brought him there. I wrote about how Political decisions of governments are reflected in prices on financial markets. I showed that Government decisions, which are somewhat unpredictable, are reflected in asset prices at a premium. I have various empirical observations on this. So politically sensitive stocks offer a higher return? In times of higher political uncertainty, stock prices are lower to offer higher expected return to those who are willing to buy them. When you hold an asset in times of uncertainty, you demand a premium for it. Political risk is also such uncertainty. SLOVAK VS. THE AMERICAN SYSTEM How was your transition from a Slovak to an American school? Can a Slovak graduate get a foothold there without any problems? When I went from the best Slovak university to the average American one, I had the feeling that students in Slovakia were better. What do you think is the reason? I think that the students at Comenius University in Bratislava were and still are among the most talented in Slovakia. They succeeded not thanks to, but in spite of the system. Where do you see the biggest differences in education in the USA and Slovakia? Having lived in the United States for over a quarter of a century, I don't know if I'm able to to assess how the school system in Slovakia has changed since my studies. At that time, it was the case that the technical directions were mastered excellently, but there was less discussion. Essence education was a one-way transfer of information from the teacher to the pupils, their reception, memorization and subsequent reproduction. In the USA, students are first given an assignment to study something, then it is discussed and argued. To come to a conclusion, you also need to master the technical side. The American system is not weak in technical disciplines, but it is clearer about the goals it wants to achieve. Technical skills are not an end in themselves, but students should learn to use them in practice. They are a means to an end. Slovakia is stuck in the trap of a middle-income country. Can education help us get out of it? Definitely yes. In the past, we were catching up with the EU average, but in the last five years or so, the pace of catching up has almost stopped. If we want it to be restored, it will require greater investment in education and innovation. It is sad that we Slovak students go abroad in such high numbers. Unfortunately, we are not close to the world's top universities. If we could find at least one or two areas, in which we want to be world-class, something like flashlights or cybersecurity... People from Foreigners would come to us to study this one or two things. Would it require less cost? It would certainly require a lot of effort and costs, but there is at least some chance of success. We will not succeed in being in everything in the world. If we choose one thing in which we already have good prerequisites, we can get there. Slovakia has a historically strong base in technical directions. How would you characterize the current world economy? It seems that economic parameters are taking a back seat and politics is increasingly in the foreground. Yes, that's right. Until recently, we had a trend of globalization. Efficiency came first. When you found the best price of inputs in China, you bought there, when in Russia, you produced in this country. Today, businesses are much more careful about where they produce and where their resources come from. Countries such as Russia are no longer considered a reliable partner. Some are also wary of China. Today, companies are watching more closely which countries and regions their production and distribution channels run through, even at the cost of higher costs. What caused it? Can this shift away from globalisation be identified with the period of Donald Trump as US president? It's not just about Trump. Biden is also taking a hard line on China. The pandemic played its part, which enhanced national interests. Companies are looking for partners who are geographically close to them and politically related. Is the result of moving away from efficiency and taking into account other criteria a higher price? Yes. The Western world has decided to accept slightly lower production and distribution efficiency at the cost of greater stability. To some extent, this is also related to the inflation we have today. Do we have a parallel to this situation in history? In the past, it has already happened that development has deviated from the path of globalization. Almost always, these periods coincided with wars. Even today, we have a military conflict across the border. Can it escalate further? Is there a risk that it will spill beyond Ukraine's borders? This threat is certainly there. We have to believe that this will not happen. You mentioned China. What is its importance in global politics? China has grown sharply in several areas in recent years. In innovation, living standards, competitiveness. He is an increasing rival for the USA. Can these two powers live in mutual symbiosis, or is a conflict between them inevitable? We see the birth of a new Cold War here. On the one hand, there is the West, i.e. the USA and the Western Europe, on the other hand, Russia, whose importance has declined, and, above all, China, which is much more important. I therefore find it encouraging that at a recent meeting U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Beijing talked about stabilizing mutual relations. Can China compete with the West in the quality of production? China has made a huge step forward over the past decade. It is one of the leaders in the field of artificial intelligence, but also in electromobility and the entire ecosystem around it. It is a matter of months, not years, before Chinese electric cars begin to have an impact on the Western market. Of course, under the condition that they are not printed by any administrative barriers, such as an allegation of dumping. Where does Europe stand in this battle between China and the US? On one side is China and on the other is the West. We can also include Europe there. It would be great if we could work with China, even though we have different views on many areas, such as human rights. There are European countries such as Hungary and, until recently, the Czech Republic, which tried to be a bridge to Europe for China. What do you think about this policy? On the one hand, it is economically advantageous to cooperate with China, but Europe must clarify to what extent it wants it. These relationships are very fragile, especially given the the possibility of a war conflict in Taiwan. Everything that companies and states do today must be treated in this sense. They should know exactly what they will do an hour after China declares war on Taiwan. This is no longer just a hypothetical possibility. Although this I do not consider it likely in the next year, sooner or later to this event may occur. Every company that does business with China should take this into account. This is similar to when they became toxic in the case of Russian aggression in Ukraine All Russian assets? Something very similar. With the difference that China is a much more important partner for the West than Russia was. Ties with it will be much more difficult to intersect. So the orientation towards China is short-sighted? I wouldn't say so. You have to be very careful. On the one hand, companies want to do business with China, more than 1.4 billion people live there, the country is achieving huge economic growth and a lot of innovations are taking place there. On the other hand, we have to be able to to respond to a possible military conflict. What does this mean for Slovakia? We can consider it a business opportunity? I think that some of the outages that Western companies will incur could be patched up by Slovakia. We could be a friendly and responsible business partner. We are geographically close, although more expensive than China. Who is UBOs PaSTOR A prominent Slovak economist, currently a professor at the University of Chicago Booth School of Business. His research in the field of financial economics focuses mainly on capital markets and collective investment. In Slovakia, he is a member of the Bank Board National Bank of Slovakia. He has published more than thirty professional papers, which have won many awards. For his teaching activities, the University of Chicago awarded him the McKinsey Award for Excellence in Teaching and the Faculty Excellence Award. This year he received the prestigious Moskowitz Prize for his work on sustainability and the impact of climate change on the value and profitability of investments. He is a graduate of the Faculty of Management of Comenius University in Bratislava and the University of Pennsylvania. He received his Ph.D. in Finance from the Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania. (Source: Forbes, 06/07/2023, Peter Apolen, p. 104)
text_original: Voli rozum, repekt a zodpovednos (rozhovor s profesorom uboom Pstorom pre Forbes) 6. jl 2023 O svetovej ekonomike, ne, investovan a bliacich sa vobch hovorme s lenom Bankovej rady NBS a profesorom psobiacim v USA uboom Pstorom. Tto otzka zaujma v poslednch mesiacoch mnostvo ud, minimlne tch, ktor maj, alebo chc ma hypotekrny ver: ak sadzbu dostan. To sa, samozrejme, odvja od rozhodnutia Eurpskej centrlnej banky. Ak je vaa prognza? Bud sadzby v Eurpe ete rs? Myslm si, e sa blime k vrcholu. Ete minimlne jedno zvenie tam v lete bude. Otzka sa posva od toho, ako vysoko pjde centrlna banka, k dohadom o tom, ako dlho zostane na tchto zvench rovniach. Podobn situcia je v USA, hoci tam s sadzby o dva percentulne body vyie. Ako dlho teda sadzby zostan na sasnch vysokch rovniach? Bude to minimlne rok, mono dva. Zvis to vak, samozrejme, od toho, o sa dovtedy stane. Videli sme, e centrlne banky s schopn ustpi od svojich plnov, ak je to potrebn. Ak prde nov krza, o ktorej dnes ete nevieme, rokov sadzby mu s vemi rchlo dole. roky na hypotkach teda zostan na zvench rovniach? Dlnci boli zvyknut na ovea niie percent. rove rokovch sadzieb, ktor mme dnes, je ovea prirodzenejia ako t z uplynulch rokov. Hypotky za jedno percento nie s normlne. A alia otzka, ktor rieia mnoh udia. Preo mme na Slovensku tak vysok inflciu? Jej miera u zaala klesa. Za tento rok to bude okolo desa percent, o je menej ako vlani. To najhorie mme za sebou. Dvod, pre ktor to bolo u ns viac ako v zpadnej Eurpe, svis s geografickou blzkosou k Rusku a s potravinami. Tie tvoria spolu s energiami u ns viu as spotrebnch vdavkov ako v krajinch zpadnej Eurpy. Aj z toho dvodu dosiahla inflcia v baltickch krajinch dvadsa percent. V poslednch rokoch vnmame odklon od ekonomiky smerom k inm argumentom - nielen pri rozhodovan firiem, ale aj v politickom a verejnom diskurze. V aktulnej predvolebnej kampani sa na Slovensku o ekonomike takmer vbec nehovor. Preo je to tak? Mte pravdu. Ekonomika ustpila do zadia. Aj v USA, kde ijem vinu asu, s kultrne vojny astejie ako debaty o ekonomickej situcii. Hovor sa o zbraniach a potratoch i rasovej nerovnosti. Nikto sa pritom nezaober tm, e americk rozpoet tento rok vyke deficit mono a osem percent HDP, a to v dobrch asoch, ke je nezamestnanos 3,5 percenta, o je blzko historickho minima. m je to spsoben? Dobr otzka. Mono je to tm, e poas pandmie sa zaali udia zaujma o ezoterick otzky a ete stle o nich ved abomyie vojny. o by ste odkzali slovenskm voliom? Poda oho by sa mali v septembri rozhodova? Verm, e bud voli rozum, vzjomn repekt, ctu a ekonomick zodpovednos. Jednou z tm vaej akademickej prce s bubliny na finannch trhoch. D sa zostruni, k omu ste dospeli? Preo bubliny vznikaj? Najprv si musme definova, o to vlastne bublina je. Ke za u povaujete prudk rast a nsledn pokles cien akci, tak tento pohyb me zaprini velio. Vina ud poklad za bublinu prve toto. Ja vak za u povaujem obdobie, ke s ceny aktv jednoznane a vrazne nadhodnoten oproti fundamentom. Je pritom mimoriadne ak v relnom ase uri, i sa v bubline prve nachdzame. Znmy je prpad, ke americk centrlny bankr Alan Greenspan v roku 1996 upozoroval na mon bublinu a akciov trhy potom ete takmer tyri roky veselo pokraovali v silnom raste, a km v novom milniu naozaj klesli. Medzitm sa vak takmer zdvojnsobili. Kedy teda mme spozornie a obva sa bubliny? Je nejak signl? Ani lovek, ktor m vemi dobr informcie a znalosti, to nevie definova presne. Medzi najuitonejie signly patria technologick inovcie a firmy, ktor ich prinaj, dostvajce sa cez IPO na trh, eufria na trhoch, ke aj mal investori vo vekom nakupuj, a vek objem obchodov na trhu. Ak vidme kombinciu tchto faktorov, je via pravdepodobnos, e sme v bubline. Tento opis sed na obdobie, ktor sme mali po pandmii. Aj dnes je tu siln rast akciovch trhov. Hroz nm op bublina? Zatia nevidm, e by boli trhy nejako nafknut. Ete stle s pod rovou spred pol druha roka, a to napriek inflcii, ktor sme tu medzitm mali. Akcie vak za rok vzrstli o dvadsa percent. Mme tu nov b trh? Je takto oznaenie oprvnen? Je to sprvne oznaenie. A tie je to prjemn prekvapenie. Ke centrlne banky zaali zvyova rokov sadzby, nebolo jasn, do akej miery spomalia ekonomiku. Mnoh sa obvali vraznej recesie. V USA ili sadzby vemi rchlo hore zhruba o p percent. V minulosti takto razantn zvenia sadzieb zvykli vies k pomerne hlbokej recesii. Tentokrt sa tak nestalo. Trh prce je odoln, ekonomika funguje. Trh teraz zana by optimistick v tom, e oakvan recesia mono napokon neprde. Je to prjemn prekvapenie z toho, e prudk zvenie sadzieb zatia neprinieslo prepad ekonomiky. Hrozba vak ete plne nezmizla. Eurozna sa nachdza v technickej recesii. Ekonomika sa potca okolo nulovho rastu. Sme v stagncii, otzne je, i iju udrme. V NBS vak stle oakvame mierny rast ekonomiky. Preo povaujete za nznak bubliny vznik novch firiem a ich IPO? Vdy, ke sa objavia nov technolgie, vznikaj nov firmy. Nie je pritom jasn, ktor z nich sa stane budcim ldrom. Z piatich firiem je tak mono jedna. Dnes je jej trhov cena podhodnoten, no v budcnosti bude rs. Uiv sa mono ete jedna alia spolonos. T je aktulne ohodnoten frovo. Tri firmy z piatich vak odpadn, pretoe nebud vedie konkurova. Ich cena je dnes vysoko nadhodnoten. Nikdy vopred neviete, ktor z firiem preije a ktor skonia. M teda v zmysel kpi cel trh, ne hada budceho vaza? Pre malho investora, ktor nem vemi dobr informcie, urite no. Pri dileme medzi pasvnou a aktvnou sprvou aktv ste teda na pasvnej strane? Ak ste ben investor, ktor nem uniktny zdroj informci, urite no. Vek vina z ns takto informcie nem. Ani vek as profesionlnych manarov fondov pritom nedoke porazi trh. Ben investori by sa teda mali orientova na pasvne investovanie. M zmysel sledova trh z dvodu vhodnch nkupov, alebo ste za pravideln investovanie? Ke chce amatr asova trh, nem vek ancu uspie. Lepie by vyuil svoj as, keby sa vzdelval a pracoval na sebe, aby si zarobil a odloil si viac. Lepia investcia ne asova trh je teda venova sa sebe? Presne tak. Ak ste schopn viac zarobi v prci a uetri si bokom, je to lep spsob, ako si zvi vnos. Kde sa zrodila vaa zuba pre ekonomiku? Vyrastal som ete za socializmu. Odmalika ma zaujmala matematika. Ke prila revolcia, mal som ptns rokov a bol som na strednej kole. plne sa vtedy zmenil ekonomick systm. Prila trhov ekonomika. Vetko bolo nov, brliv a pre ma, zvyknutho na matematick poriadok, ako pochopiten. Fascinovalo ma ui sa o spolonosti v ase, ke sa dramaticky menila. Postupne som zistil, e mj zujem o spolonos a o rigorzne bdanie sa daj pekne spoji v tdiu ekonmie. Kde ste tudovali? Stredn kolu na Gymnziu Potov v Koiciach, vysok kolu na Fakulte manamentu Univerzity Komenskho v Bratislave a tie rok na univerzite v Kansase. Doktort mm z Wharton School na Pensylvnskej univerzite. Po kole ste zostali v USA? no. Hne po doktorte som si naiel miesto na Chicagskej univerzite, kde psobm u dvadsatyri rokov. Je to ako ke ide hokejista do NHL. Nerob to preto, e by sa mu a tak pilo v USA alebo v Kanade, ale preto, e tamojia liga za to stoj. o vs enie dopredu? Som zvedav lovek, ktor chce za sebou nieo necha. o konkrtne tm mte na mysli? Ctim spoloensk zodpovednos. Aj to je dvod, kvli ktormu som u osem rokov inn v Nrodnej banke Slovenska ako len bankovej rady. Snahou nieo zanecha je aj mj akademick vskum. Jeho vstupy tu ostan nadlho, aspo dfam. Na akademickej prci sa mi pi vytvranie trvalch hodnt v podobe odbornch publikci, ako aj uenia tudentov, ktor s potom spen v praxi. Ktor z vaich teoretickch prc povaujete za najcennejiu? Spomeniem tri oblasti. Momentlne je najcitovanejou moja prca o likvidite ako rizikovom faktore na finannch trhoch. alou tmou je vplyv politickej neistoty na finann trhy. A najnovou tmou je udraten investovanie. Za u ste dostali tento rok Moskowitzovu cenu? no. Jednm z mojich hlavnch vsledkov v tejto oblasti je, e oakvan vnos zelench investci by mal by o osi ni ako oakvan vnos z hnedch investci. Plat to z dvoch dvodov. Ktor s to? udia radi vlastnia zelen aktva. Maj z toho nefinann itok, dobr pocit. Zelen aktva sa teda predvaj za vyiu cenu, o spsobuje, e maj ni oakvan vnos smerom do budcnosti. Druhm dvodom je to, e zelen aktva poskytuj lepie zabezpeenie proti klimatickmu riziku. Ke prde k negatvnej klimatickej udalosti, zelen akcie reaguj lepie ako hned. Pretoe maj tto vhodu, sta im dnes ponknu men oakvan vnos do budcnosti. Naopak, hned akcie musia ponknu viac, aby kompenzovali investora za klimatick riziko. Vetci vieme, e naa ekonomika sa men smerom k udratenm energim. oraz viac ich budeme bra zo slnka a vetra, no kee to vetci vieme, u by to malo by premietnut v cench aktv. Spomnali ste politick riziko. Plat to aj pre dobu, ktor prve ijeme? Presne tak. tandardn modely vo finannej ekonmii v sebe nemaj prvok vldy, ktor rob politick rozhodnutia. Moja prca ho tam priniesla. Psal som o tom, ako sa politick rozhodnutia vld odraj v cench na finannch trhoch. Ukzal som, e rozhodnutia vld, ktor s do istej miery nepredvdaten, sa v cench aktv odzrkaduj prmiou. Mm na to rzne empirick pozorovania. Politicky citliv akcie teda ponkaj vy vnos? V ase vyej politickej neistoty s ceny akci niie, aby mohli ponknu vy oakvan vnos tm, ktor s ochotn ich kpi. Ke drte aktvum v ase neistoty, poadujete za to prmiu. Takou neistotou je aj politick riziko. SLOVENSK VS. AMERICK SYSTM Ak bol v prechod zo slovenskej do americkej koly? Doke sa tam slovensk absolvent bez problmov uchyti? Ke som preiel z najlepej slovenskej univerzity na priemern americk, mal som pocit, e tudenti na Slovensku boli lep. o je poda vs dvodom? Myslm si, e tudenti na Univerzite Komenskho v Bratislave boli a dodnes patria medzi najtalentovanejch na Slovensku. Uspeli nie vaka, ale napriek systmu. Kde vidte najvie rozdiely v kolstve v USA a na Slovensku? Kee u vye tvrstoroie ijem v Spojench ttoch, neviem, i som schopn posdi, ako sa zmenil kolsk systm na Slovensku od mojich tdi. Vtedy to bolo tak, e technick smery boli zvldnut vborne, menej sa vak diskutovalo. Podstatou vzdelvania bol jednosmern prenos informci od uitea k iakom, ich prijmanie, zapamtanie a nsledn reprodukcia. V USA dostan tudenti najprv zadanie si nieo natudova, potom sa o tom diskutuje a argumentuje. Na to, aby ste dospeli k zveru, muste zvldnu aj technick strnku. Americk systm nie je slab v technickch disciplnach, m vak jasnejie v cieoch, ktor chce dosiahnu. Technick zrunosti nie s samoeln, ale tudenti sa ich maj naui vyuva v praxi. S prostriedkom na dosiahnutie ciea. Slovensko uviazlo v pasci krajiny strednch prjmov. Me nm vzdelanie pomc vymani sa z nej? Jednoznane no. V minulosti sme priemer E dobiehali, no v poslednch viac ako piatich rokoch sa tempo dobiehania takmer zastavilo. Ak chceme, aby sa obnovilo, bude si to vyadova vie investcie do vzdelvania a inovci. Je smutn, e nm slovensk tudenti v takch vysokch potoch odchdzaj do zahraniia. ia, nemme blzko k pikovm svetovm univerzitm. Keby sme si nali aspo jednu-dve oblasti, v ktorch chceme by svetov, nieo ako baterky alebo kyberbezpenos... udia zo zahraniia by k nm chodili tudova tto jednu-dve veci. Vyadovalo by si to menie nklady? Vyadovalo by si to urite vek silie a aj nklady, no je tu aspo nejak anca na spech. By vo vetkom svetov sa nm nepodar. Ke si vyberieme jednu vec, v ktorej mme u teraz dobr predpoklady, meme sa tam dosta. Slovensko m historicky siln zkladu prve v technickch smeroch. Ako by ste charakterizovali sasn svetov ekonomiku? Title: udovt dor: The Unbearable Ease of Debt (HN Online)
text: udovit Odor: The unbearable ease of indebtedness (HN Online) June 20, 2022 The fundamental problem is that in a monetary union, you can't have bailouts to deal with unsustainable debts and a budget at the same time. sovereignty at national level. Changes in interest rates are not a one-way street. After years of continuous reduction, there is a phase of gradual increase. With record levels of inflation, this is nothing surprise. And yet, it seems that some states are surprised that their public debt servicing costs are rising. There is no excuse only for the whims of the financial markets. Unfortunately, economic fundamentals are not rosy in many places. Debts are huge and the prospect of economic growth is unflattering. Despite the objectively very difficult period - the corona crisis and the war conflict - Life has been relatively easy for finance ministers in recent times. European rules for Fiscal responsibility was turned off, interest rates were ultra-low, and there were also no problems with the placement of government bonds on the market. A third to a half of the state debt has been parked in the ECB. In addition, a recovery plan has been approved, which makes it possible to stimulate economies without a direct burden on the debts of individual countries. High inflation, which reduces the real value of accumulated debts, also helps. It can be said that the support of economies through debt has been trouble-free in the past period. But the need to stabilize the crisis-stricken economies also had a downside: ignoring the issue of sustainability. A decade has passed since the euro crisis, but despite this, it has not been possible to eliminate the shortcomings in the basic pillars of the eurozone. As a result, Public management and economic development in one country still disproportionately affect stability in another. The fundamental problem is that in a monetary union, you cannot have rescue mechanisms to deal with unsustainable debts and budgetary sovereignty at the national level at the same time. This contradiction has not yet been convincingly resolved, which forced the ECB to promise "everything possible" to save the euro back in 2012. Many politicians are counting on the central bank to do the "dirty work" for them even now. They expect that in the event of any unexpected increases in the risk margin on government debt, a new ECB purchase program will come. It is possible to play this game for some time, but It is risky in the long run. Credit risk will not just disappear by selling it to the central bank, but will transform into inflation risk in the future. The greater the central bank's long-term holdings of government securities, the more serious these risks become. I know that I have a reputation as a budget ayatollah and I often talk about the need to reduce the shift of the debt burden to future generations. But in the euro area, we have already tried all possible alternative solutions, and it is time to treat the disease, not just alleviate the symptoms. All roads should not lead to Frankfurt, some should even lead to Rome. Source: - unbearable-lightness-of-indebtedness

Title: Commentary by udovt dor: Thirty years of catching up (hnonline.sk)
text: Commentary by udovit Odor: Thirty years of catching up (hnonline.sk) Jan 10, 2023 It is difficult to completely ventilate the stale air from socialism, and the mental attitude from the previous regime casts a very long shadow. Those born earlier will remember that Mikulas Dzurinda promised double salaries before the 1998 elections. We waited. A look back at the last 30 years reveals that if we adjust the statistics for price increases, our salaries and pensions are on average approximately Doubled. Such a high income is certainly not a small amount, but it's not a big deal either Super performance. Neither a snail, nor a tiger, rather maybe a hare. It turns out that the change economic regime is much more demanding than many, including foreign experts, they meant when the Berlin Wall fell. It is difficult to completely ventilate the stale air from socialism, and the mental attitude from the previous regime casts a very long shadow. Therefore, the road since the collapse of the federation has been quite bumpy with significant successes and falls. It would take a long time to analyze, but I will focus on three questions. Why do many still evaluate socialism positively? In addition to memory optimism, it is also about certainties. People like fixed points. Therefore, even though we are much richer, healthier, more educated, more environmentally responsible and even happier, the uncertainty in the form of losing a job or a roof over our heads haunts many. In addition, income disparities have also increased. We are still one of the most egalitarian countries, property comparison with our neighbor or classmates, however, does not have to come out to a draw. And this often leads to frustration. Was it the right step to divide the federation? I don't have a definite answer. However, I consider the main positive that neither side can make excuses for the other. The Czechs cannot blame the more backward Slovakia in the case of weaker economic results. No more balls strapped to the leg. Slovaks, on the other hand, can no longer claim that times are worse, because all decisions are made in Prague and the cake is divided unfairly. Economically, we have been catching up with the Czech Republic in the last 30 years, but this could easily have happened inside the federation as well. Where we are Have they made the biggest economic mistake in the last 30 years? From my point of view, it is education, research and development. Although we have many more university-educated citizens, we are lagging behind in terms of quality. You can start almost any social debate at the moment, in the end you usually agree that we need to make Slovakia an educated country, attractive for talent and innovation. Following Thirty will be very difficult without better education. A government in resignation usually only has the right to light and heat. Unfortunately, in terms of improving the innovation potential of Slovakia, it is not much more compared to what we have seen in recent decades Produce. It's time to change that. It is difficult to ventilate the stale air from socialism, and the mental attitude of the previous regime casts a long shadow.
text_original: Komentr udovta Odora: Tridsa rokov dobiehania (hnonline.sk) 10. jan 2023 Socializmom zatuchnut vzduch je ak plne vyvetra a mentlne nastavenie z predolho reimu vrh vemi dlh tie. Title: NBS Deputy Governor . dor: Not only prices but also wages will grow by double digits (index.sme.sk)
text: Lieutenant Governor N S . odor: Not only Prices, but also wages will rise by double digits (index.sme.sk) Jan 23, 2023 The purchasing power of the population will depend on energy prices, says udovit odor. The energy crisis is not a matter of one year. The problem is likely to persist next winter, or the next one. While this year the government is protecting households from increases in hundreds of percent, next year the state budget will receive a similar level of aid will not be able to allow. According to the Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia, udovit odor, it is therefore necessary to prepare for a gradual increase, while in 2025 we will pay about twice as much for energy as before. "No one expects a return to the pre-crisis level yet. It is unlikely, both due to the ongoing conflict in Ukraine and the transition to a green economy," says udovit oDOR in an interview for INDEX. In the interview you will read:  How will prices rise this year and when will they stop?  To what extent can salary increases be expected?  What impact does the ageing of Slovakia have on high employment?  What energy prices should we expect in the next two years?  Why can Slovakia have a problem borrowing further? We are in a very uncertain period. Predictions change from month to month. Is it possible to predict how the Slovak economy will fare this year? The uncertainty is quite high. Quite a lot depends on energy prices for households. This will subsequently affect the purchasing power of the population. If the invoices really succeeded maintained at the announced levels, the economy would narrowly avoid a recession and we could show at least some, albeit minimal, increase. Inflation predictions also changed several times last year. So what to expect? Unfortunately, double-digit inflation must be expected again at the beginning of the year. The better news is that it could start to decline at the end of this quarter and may even get below ten percent at the end of the year. In other words, the big price shock that we have been experiencing for several quarters in a row, gradually fades away. However, this does not mean that prices will not rise. They will still go up, but a little slower than, for example, at the end of 2022. In which area, apart from energy, will the price increase be felt the most? As energy is a cost item for both firms and service providers, their They pass on the price increase secondarily. Especially in the prices of their products and services, including food. Inflation last year caused a fall in living standards and real wages. Will this trend continue? If our inflation forecasts come true, a further decline in real wages may not occur. The labor market is relatively strong and companies have to raise wages to keep the best employees. Not only prices, but also wages are likely to rise at a double-digit pace. Only the situation of households whose members are not economically active will be worse. If do not work and receive social benefits, the stabilization of their standard of living depends only on overall medium-term valorisation of benefits. For the time being, it should be somewhere at the level of inflation, which will protect them at least from a deep slump. How real is the risk of a wage-inflation spiral, i.e. that the increase in salaries will again increase the price of goods and services? Not really. The prices of products and services are high enough to cut a large enough chunk of the increased wages, which will take away people's appetite for consumption. At the same time, lower demand will mean that companies will not have room for a sharp increase in wages in the coming periods. It is quite another thing if price increases result in a request for a sharp increase in the minimum wage by the unions. Although this would not trigger a wage-inflation spiral, the competitiveness of our economy would certainly suffer. And even compared to the surrounding countries. The crisis has not yet had a major impact on employment. Is it necessary to prepare for changes in the labor market? No, it is as if the energy shocks did not affect the labor market. And not only in Slovakia, but also in many other countries. Isn't it strange? It is, and it is not. What do you mean? We find it strange mainly because we are used to significant layoffs from previous crises. However, we currently have a headwind, and that is aging Population. Fewer and fewer people are of active age, which results in a problem with finding an adequate workforce. This trend will continue, and unemployment is unlikely to jump to 20 or 30 percent even during future crises. Rather, it will oscillate somewhere near single-digit numbers. Such a development is also positive in terms of financial stability. If you pay off your mortgage and still have a job, you can make ends meet. If a person loses their job, it is more difficult to pay off debts and people's problems are transferred to the financial sector. To what extent does the success of state energy measures against households affect the development of this year's economy? The development of prices for households was the biggest uncertainty in our forecast. Already in the autumn, we warned that if by chance no measures come and only the current regulatory framework from the Regulatory Office for Network Industries applies, inflation may exceed 20 percent in the short term. That is why we emphasized the need to take at least such measures that would price adjustments have been pushed down by half. Then the economy would avoid a recession. The current measures are even lower, which helps in the short term. From the long-term However, it has at least three very interesting risks. What? Once we keep consumer prices low against market prices and are not reflected in the real life of the end user, there is no incentive to save to a significant extent. This is especially true for middle and higher income categories, which, paradoxically, should feel the energy crisis more than the rest of the population. The second thing is that such a solution is not cheap for the state at all. We are not only protecting the most vulnerable, but also all other households. And last but not least, the price increase is not a one-time thing. Although market prices will no longer go as high as they did last year, they will still be higher than the currently valid final prices. Therefore, the increase in the price of energy commodities for households will continue next year. The aid is in billions of euros, part of which will probably be remediated by EU funds. How do you perceive it? One always has a bit of mixed feelings about it. On the one hand, it is good that we can compensate at least part of the fiscal costs from external sources and not increase the public debt further. On the other hand, we do not receive EU funds to push them into consumption, but to move towards digitization, innovation and green transition. Slovakia has a lot of needs in the investment area, and every euro we put into consumption is a lost opportunity to turn around our predominantly assembly economy activities with higher added value. Unfortunately, even the ending programming period proves that we have a bad system of drawing EU funds and then at the last minute we come up with various measures to spend money. For me, as an economist, the goal of "spending money" is incomprehensible. Rather, we should try to look for purpose and efficiency. This year, however, we have not only the old EU funds at our disposal, but also the recovery plan and the new programming period. Do you believe that we will be able to spend the money effectively? Not really. Even past experience shows that if we try to spend money on Last minute, efficiency goes by the wayside. Therefore, in the case of new EU funds, continuous drawing will be especially important in the recovery plan. The only positive thing is that in a more difficult year, we have the opportunity to pump another three percent of GDP into the economy. This should be what we care about the most in the case of spending EU funds. However, part of the energy measures will also be paid for by the state budget. What will it do to him? The temporarily authorized government is communicating aid in the amount of six billion euros. Our calculations speak of a slightly lower amount. Either way, it is a large package that increases the public deficit and debt. We even had to revise it in the December forecast compared to September Upwards. It is understandable that governments take crisis measures to help the population in times of crisis. However, someone has to pay for it, the money does not just fall from the sky. The repayment of the burden we create will remain with the next generations. This can be especially unpleasant if our debt does not decrease in the future. This is because it is still We are above the upper sanction band of the debt brake. Apart from energy, what has the biggest impact on the amount of debt? Several factors, including inflation. In the short term, this reduces the value of debt and increases tax revenues through higher prices. In the long term, however, it will make another hole in the budget, through compensatory measures, but also pension indexation, wage increases and new salaries of health workers. Is it possible for the government to drag energy measures in the coming years? Everything is possible if the market conditions are right. However, these cannot be relied on in the future. In addition, we have a debt of 60 percent, which is not a safe limit. Especially not if our population is aging at the current pace and the state's costs for pensions, health care and social care will only increase. What solutions are offered if the crisis continues next winter? It will probably not be possible to cut people off from help completely. That is why we expect the forecast to operate in some form next year as well. It should be about a billion euros. In 2025, winter should be without state aid. So what energy bills should people prepare for in the coming years? If we were to believe what they are currently saying about long-term electricity and gas prices markets, in 2025 we will probably pay twice the amounts compared to last year. No one expects a return to pre-crisis levels yet. This is unlikely, both due to the ongoing conflict in Ukraine and the transition to a green economy. Households should therefore prepare now. Preferably by saving effectively. Sometimes really small things are enough for every working family to be able to save at least 10 to 15 percent of their consumption. How risky is it for a country to borrow on the financial markets if our debt has been oscillating around 60 percent since the corona crisis? Central banks are also fighting inflation by raising interest rates. This translates into the costs of servicing the state debt. Government bonds can only be issued at higher interest rates, which further increases the burden on public finances. In addition, central banks stop buying government bonds, as they did during the coronavirus crisis or last year. This means that it may no longer be so easy for small euro area countries to place their bonds on favourable terms. We should therefore try to calm the financial markets. To show them that we have a plan on how to consolidate in the future. I don't mean a year-on-year jump in debt from 60 percent to 50 percent, but a credible approach to how we want to work towards a lower limit over time. Then the markets will believe and provide us with money on better terms. Can this move by central banks also be understood as a signal to national governments to consolidate? The primary goal is to depress inflation. But it is true that it can also be understood as a signal that the times of ultra-low interest rates are over for a certain period of time and governments should adapt to it. After all, if we live in a high-interest period that hurts us a lot, we should reduce expenses and increase income. Interest rates also increased for mortgages. Will they grow this year as well? You always need to add at least one to two percentage points to the increase set by the European Central Bank in order to get interest on mortgages. So I expect an increase of up to five percent. However, it all depends on the creditworthiness of the particular debtor. Can we expect a cooling in the real estate market? Yes. Even before the increase in interest rates, we warned that some of real estate are in a risk zone and some correction may occur. Therefore, also due to the current development, we expect a decline this year. You prepared your last forecast in great economic and political uncertainty. Is it even possible? Very difficult. Recently, we have had to work with variables that are very difficult to predict. I will only mention the government's decision-making in the case of energy prices. But even the development of a war or a pandemic is not easy to predict. I used to say that our crystal ball is foggy and we don't see things clearly. Forecasting is really much more complicated than it was five or six years ago. However, our task is also to give society at least some signal about what to expect. In my opinion, a well-argued scenario is always better than knowing nothing at all and flying a white flag. To be as accurate as possible, we collect a much larger amount of data. We have become pandemic, war, and recently energy experts.

Title: udovt dor: Is there another global financial crisis around the corner? (NBS Deputy Governor for Hospodrske noviny)
text: udovit Odor: There is another one around the corner Global financial crisis? (Vice-Governor of the NBS for Hospodarske noviny) Mar 21, 2023 An increase in interest rates is a completely standard development against which all institutions should be sufficiently protected. Over the past years, we have somehow become accustomed to the fact that one crisis alternates with another. That's why, when an American startup bank recently got down on its knees and a major Swiss bank made headlines shortly after, the markets began to panic. We are threatened by a similar scenario like after the collapse of Lehman Brothers? I don't think so. Smaller or larger earthquakes may come, but a devastating tsunami as in 2010 I don't expect 2008. The first good news is that the world has learned its lesson and is asking major banks for higher capital buffers and plenty of liquid assets. Tools are also available that can act as a capital buffer if necessary to prevent the fire from spreading further. Last but not least, central banks have mechanisms to provide the necessary liquidity in the event of a panic. The rest should be handled by better equipped mechanisms for bank recovery. In addition to the fact that banks are in better shape than before the financial crisis, the The mechanism is quite different. Years ago, it was mortgage securities that The value dropped to almost zero from evening to morning, the current tremors are not associated with such toxic material. After all, an increase in interest rates is completely a standard development against which all institutions should be sufficiently secured. Does this mean that everything is in the best order? Not really. Just because we are better protected from past crises does not mean that new risks cannot complicate things. I am afraid that we will have to add the word to our dictionaries "Dominance", in two flavors: financial and fiscal. What is it about? The American humorist Will Rogers once said that the greatest inventions of mankind are fire, the wheel and central banking. Considering that in crises everyone is waiting for central banks to save the world, he was not far from the truth. But they are not omnipotent Institutions. They cannot ensure the solvency of banks or, for example, the health of public Finance. However, it often happens that politicians and bankers do not solve the core of the problem, expecting the central bank to solve everything for them. We speak of financial or fiscal dominance when central banks are forced to extinguish these problems, partly resigning from their main mandate, to ensure low inflation. For example, not to increase interest rates so as not to complicate the situation for banks or governments. The latest interest rate hike in Europe is a good thing despite Credit Suisse's problems with the news that we do not have significant dominance yet. The author is the Deputy Governor of the NBS. Predsa zvenie rokovch sadzieb je plne tandardn vvoj, proti ktormu by mali by vetky intitcie dostatone zabezpeen. Znamen to, e vetko je v najlepom poriadku? Nie celkom. To, e sme lepie chrnen pred minulmi krzami, ete neznamen, e nov rizik nemu veci skomplikova. Obvam sa, e do naich slovnkov budeme musie prida slovo dominancia, a to hne v dvoch prchutiach: finannej a fiklnej. O o ide? Americk humorista Will Rogers raz povedal, e najvmi vynlezmi udstva s ohe, koleso a centrlne bankovnctvo. Ak si uvedomme, e v krzach vetci akaj na to, e centrlne banky zachrnia svet, nebol aleko od pravdy. Lene nie s vemohce intitcie. Nedoku zabezpei solventnos bnk alebo naprklad zdravie verejnch financi. asto sa vak stva, e politici a bankri nerieia jadro problmu, akajc, e centrlna banka vetko vyriei za nich. O finannej alebo fiklnej dominancii hovorme vtedy, ak s centrlne banky nten hasi tieto problmy, sasti rezignujc na svoj hlavn mandt, zabezpei nzku inflciu. Naprklad nezvi roky, aby nekomplikovali situciu bankm i vldam. Posledn zvenie rokov v Eurpe je napriek problmom Credit Suisse dobrou sprvou, e vrazn dominanciu zatia nemme.
