Title: Our economy lags far behind the West. According to dor from NBS, we invest little in innovation (Deputy Governor . dor, Radio Expres)
text: Our economy compared to the West is significantly lagging behind. According to odor from the NBS, we are investing little in innovation (Deputy Governor . odor, Radio Expres) Apr 3, 2023 Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator Lower prices in shops and services or moderate economic growth. This is what the National Bank forecasts for next year. Inflation is expected to slow to less than 7 %. However, we have already spent the money saved during the pandemic. So we are now supposed to be drawn by EU funds. How do we manage it all? How will our salaries grow, for example, in addition to prices? Won't populist proposals in parliament complicate it even more? And what can bank failures, market uncertainties, or the ongoing Russian war change the economy? We will talk about all this today here in the studio and we will talk about it directly with the Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia, udovit odor. Mr. Vice-Governor, hello, welcome to us. udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia Have a nice day. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator And so do we. Thank you very much for being here again after some time on the occasion of your next short-term prediction and actually also the medium-term one, as we are also talking about the following years. So I would probably start in a more general way, if you will allow me. According to the forecast, Slovakia's gross domestic product should grow by around one percent this year. It should be much better for next year and the next one, but I would go back to this one, because in the last prediction it should have been some 0.3 points, a percentage point better. Something has changed, or has it? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia No, I take it as good news that we did not have to change the forecast very significantly. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator So that's a slight correction, hey, by 0.3%? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia That's a really subtle correction, you can't even feel it for ordinary people, it's so little. But the good news is that in the meantime, between winter and spring, there were no such shocks that would force us to redraw the whole thing. And this is also important from the point of view of inflation, that although we have slightly increased the average inflation for this year, we are already seeing a little light at the end of the tunnel and we are already expecting single-digit inflation values at the end of the year, which will probably be pleasing several households, because the current high prices are nothing pleasant. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator Yes, it is incredibly, an incredible stress for family budgets and expenses of a daily nature, especially in the most common consumer basket, where it is extremely shown. I would get to that right away, but that's what I wanted to say, that the prediction says that in the next two years the economy should grow much faster, at a pretty solid pace of around three percent, or first 3.2%, then 3%. This is good news for the economy, fundamentally good? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia That's good news. It would be fundamentally good if we could go back to those a little bit higher growth than we had here before, I don't know, ten, fifteen years ago, when the economy grew by 4, 5, 6%. But unfortunately, so far, when we see how we are ready to grow faster and how we are catching up with Western countries, it is a bit of a snail's pace. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator Understand. But in any case, the 3%, at least in the old days, always meant that the economy was recovering, that it could create new jobs. In the context of employment, or unemployment, what does it look like today, versus the short-term outlook or the medium-term one? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia Exactly, you are right that these are already such numbers when the economy can really generate jobs, and this is also good news from our forecast that despite the fact that this year will not be so pleasant in terms of household consumption, we expect the number of jobs on the labor market to grow, which is very good, of course, From the point of view of the household as a whole, the character of the economy is changing a bit. Twenty years ago, when the crisis came, unemployment usually jumped up to 20%. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator That's what I just wanted to ask. Now we have seen several crises in a row, including the huge long-term covid crisis, and perhaps many experts were surprised that it did not shake the unemployment crisis or really significant numbers of people without work. udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia Yes, yes. That's, that's actually the big difference compared to what used to be here, and it's also a bit due to the fact that we're aging like Slovakia. The large population generations are actually already retiring, and this actually means that there is not such a big onslaught on the market. There are no new people coming who can't get a job, and that helps in those statistics. But it is also very good news from the point of view of financial stability, because after all, when there is a crisis and you lose your job, it is very difficult to pay off your debts, but if you are still employed, but maybe your real income is falling a little, you can still pay off your mortgage. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator So that's actually the good news even in those bad times, that we're holding on anyway, hey? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia Yes. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator This is about it. Well, but it's not entirely in the topic, but I still can't help but think that it's not a bit of our problem that we don't have problems with employment, because yes, even today, it actually turns out that we can't fill a lot of jobs. Maybe the situation in Ukraine helps a little, paradoxically, that many Ukrainians are employed in our country. How is it that what your data says in this matter? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia It is quite interesting that from the latest numbers, when we see what the new workers are like, quite a lot comes from abroad, but not only from Ukraine. Quite interesting that we saw, for example, such an exotic country of India in the first quarter that quite a lot employees came. This, of course, is also related to other sectors, such as IT. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator I wanted to ask why, why exactly? Clear. udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia This is, this is interesting news, and this is, this is good from the point of view of the future, because the aging is only at the beginning. This will have a very, very unpleasant phase, when even the number of people in Slovakia will decrease and the number of workers will drop significantly, but because we will retire, but not unemployed. Then we will need an external workforce. People may perceive it in such a way that when you see the care for the elderly, they usually go there from us in Austria. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator That's right, Slovak, Slovak nannies. udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia And we will have this problem in 20, 30 years, that we will need from somewhere for our health care and care for the elderly. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator So we will also have to discount them, because today the moods in society are different. We often see this in politicians, where they build their agenda on it, that they reject anything from abroad, including the workforce. So it will be more essential for us to get those people into the economy, so that there is someone to pay taxes, pay and everyone, all those social systems. udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia But if we want a functional social and pension system, someone will have to pay And so we will have to be more open to some kind of labor migration. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator I'll get directly to inflation in a moment, but, Mr. Vice-Governor, maybe, maybe on the one hand worrying, maybe not, because we can't predict how the deputies of the National Council of the Slovak Republic will behave, at least until early parliamentary elections in September, but do you also monitor the behaviour and moods in the National Council of the Slovak Republic when making your predictions, of course, materialized in specific, specific parliamentary proposals, which, however, could perhaps also threaten the stability of public finances, your predictions, our wallets? Do you also base that on that? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia Yes, of course, the forecasts are not good, and there is also a package of proposals In a parliament with very negative possible consequences, which is not exactly the best news for such a small country and with that debt level of 60%. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator Feel free to tell me, Mr. Vice-Governor, which of those proposals do you consider to be such, which seriously threaten our public finances, public debt, public finance deficit? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia Well, all of them, which have a price tag in the hundreds of millions of euros, are, of course, unpleasant from the point of view of public finances, and it is all the worse that, and I assume that politicians will realize a little bit that when the new government comes, the new government will have to do something about it, that is why increase the problem that we will have to solve from, from September or October after the formation of a new government. And it was also very unpleasant for me that we went backwards by leaps and bounds in the Value for Money project, that it started to be said again that, I don't know, it can be analyzed even then. And it's like buying shoes in a store and then sitting down in the evening at the Internet and starting to compare shoes. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator That you didn't buy them expensively. udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia Expensive. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator And you'll find out that yes, probably. udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia You will find out that yes, that it makes absolutely no sense and there was no one in parliament, not even 1 MP, who would actually stand up for the Value for Money project, while we know that those analysts there do not decide where to build the highway. They just count the individual Alternatives. Politicians always decide. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator Exactly, exactly. That's not politics. Yes, definitely. Well, then it seems that many of those economists who worked either in the UHP or in the institute Ministry of Finance, they left there. Some of them even went into politics. Well well, but from that point of view, only for our listeners, we see Igor Matovi's proposals for 500 bonuses for, for voting in the elections or the proposal of 100 for people who have not received anti-inflationary aid, but also for such things where deputies of the National Council amendment to a completely different law at the end of last year, for example, they abolished our the fees that we have for public radio and television, by the way, which, I don't know how many, have perhaps not changed for 15 years, were the EUR 4.62, but without compensating for the shortfall in any way. Well, this is probably not a responsible economic policy. udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia That's right, I'll give you just 1 example. Actually, before the previous elections With great fanfare, it was abolished that the retirement age would not be tied to the life expectancy. Then came the Recovery Plan, and again with great fanfare, we They introduced the same thing that we had here, and we call it a reform. And that's just a tax for the fact that Before the elections, we usually behave in an extremely populist way and without They realized what is coming, that in a year, but maybe in a few quarters, when we will really have to behave much more responsibly. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator But you say we are, I understand it, of course. On the other hand, our politicians, whom we elect there, have it on their T-shirt, so let's say, let's say that yes, that through us, but the fact is that politicians also do not respect the recommendations of the Budget Council responsibility, which is established by the Constitution in connection with the law on the debt brake, which is also a topic in itself, because the results of our economy actually say that we should go into those sanction zones, that the whole thing should actually be slowed down. Can we do that, can we manage it, or do politicians rely on the fact that there will be a new government and the rules will not apply to it because it is new? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia There are rules for the new government, except for two or three such severe sanctions that do not apply for the first 2 years. So it doesn't mean that the government won't be affected, but means that they will not have to comply with those severe sanctions right from the start, e.g. that A balanced budget does not have to prepare it for next year. But that doesn't mean it won't catch up with them afterwards. So definitely and more important from my point of view is to behave Responsibly not because some law prescribes it to us, but because with this, with this level of debt of 60% for such a small country as we are and such an aging country, it is already quite a risky thing. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator Understand. But in order to move forward, I don't want to touch on every proposal now, on the one hand, we don't have time for it and it probably wouldn't be effective either, but In connection with inflation, which I will ask about in a moment, it is said, for example, and this is repeated in cycles from politicians, so let's reduce VAT on specific selected types of food, on all foodstuffs, on gastronomy, I don't know what. You, as an economist, Mr. Vice-Governor, what is your view on this? Does the VAT reduction automatically mean that I, as the end consumer, will have my goods cheaper by that percentage? This was shown, for example, with gastronomy, when they received a special, reduced 10% VAT? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia I don't even have to say my opinion. All we have to do is show the numbers and the numbers are completely Clear. This means that the more VAT has decreased, the more the margin of merchants has increased. No, no, no, that they haven't fallen since January, but they have risen by the second most significant pace in the European Union in gastronomy. And this despite the fact that we have reduced VAT. So what we all say, that this is really not a good measure from the point of view of the consumer, has been confirmed almost 100%. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator Interesting, but this is just a comment that whether anyone expected something else from it, because the representatives of the restaurant themselves have said before that they will not use the reduced VAT to reduce their prices, but on the contrary to cover the losses it has brought them, brought about the covid pandemic, high energy prices and the like. So they probably didn't even have the expectations that it would have such an effect that they would suddenly be a cheaper daily menu or I don't know what. udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia Yes, they themselves do not, but many politicians say that let's reduce VAT on those goods, on other goods, because then it will be cheaper in stores, which is absolutely rarely true in special situations. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator In short, it usually doesn't work that way. udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia Yes. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator Well, well, the standard of living is also related to this, Mr. Vice-Governor, because Eurostat has shown that in the last two to three years, which were affected by both the pandemic and the energy crisis and the Russian war, the standard of living in Slovakia has decreased more than in other Member States of the European Union. Does it fit and why, why with us? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia As a matter of principle, of course, the pandemic was very negative, when we had some drop in living standards, but we got out of it relatively quickly, and now that we have seen the Ukrainian war, we have not seen much of it in the consumption statistics. So it's not quite like we have a 2, 3 year drop in living standards here. For example, consumption for the last quarter was extremely good at the end of last year, and this was also related to the fact that there were savings that were there. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator From the covid, actually, of course. udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia So now it will actually become clear at what pace consumption will go, because people are already completely down with the savings rate, at a historic minimum. That is, we have never postponed so little and from this title I expect it to go a little higher again and it will slow down ours consumption in the near future. But the good news is that despite the fact that we expect double-digit inflation this year, and salaries could be roughly double-digit. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator I'll get to that too, well, well, it's good that you're talking. Okay, a notice for a few questions further. It's just that it's not directly related to that, but I'm again interested in your point of view, or whether, or if the National Bank has such data or is investigating it, because as far as the standard of living is concerned, and especially from our point of view, catching up with the average of the European Union countries, there are different numbers. There is a number that we are at sixty-seven percent, which is a major decrease, because we have perhaps been approaching ninety for some time. Other figures speak of eighty percent of the standard of living of the Union. How, how, how do you follow it? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia So we are watching it, of course, and we have been pointing out for a long time that there are some discrepancies in the statistics, that what economists sometimes say is really true, that it is partly to be attributed, that the name is not used in exactly the same methodology everywhere. But if we were to abstract from this and look at our catch-up without these effects, it would still be relatively slow. Although we would be better off than many countries, it would not be true that we would be almost at the tail, but it is still true that Lately, we have not been able to catch up with the West. And this is not surprising, because in fact, the economy needs a new model to move at a certain economic level Catching up. We can no longer build on cheap labor. In the meantime, the salaries They have grown up in our country. We cannot build only on importing some technology, attracting some investments. They are still helping us, but we would need to switch to an economy that is driven forward by ideas and not only, not just cheap labor. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator So our politicians do not come up with such proposals in their policies that would move us forward in this way, or slowly, that we are so late, for example, compared to the Czech Republic? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia Compared to the Czech Republic, when we compare what prerequisites we have for the knowledge-based economy compared to the Czech Republic, it is still miserable or very weak, and even when we take the V4, so compared to the one in Finland or Austria, for example, it is still very backward. So we are in a bad situation in the V4 and the V4 is still bad. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator By comparison in the EU. udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia In the EU, so, unfortunately, we are doing very little to really The economy was built, they built on education. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator And what is it that we do little for? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia Yes, yes. We do little because, for example, we are very weak in investments in innovation or research and development. We give as very little, the least almost from the surrounding countries, and besides, even the little that goes there, goes quite scattered into various projects and we don't choose the raisins, we don't reward the best, but rather we want to give everyone at least something. As if it is still true that the grey average wins here in Slovakia. udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia Yes, yes, exactly. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator Well, that's not the case, it's not exactly ideal news. Only a completely partial thing, it actually applies to everything. What do you think, Mr. Vice-Governor, about the proposal to introduce the right to cash into the Constitution of the Slovak Republic in a situation where the whole world is going in the opposite direction, when all those payments and the movement of money are actually going online, and in addition, the European Central Bank and the European Union are pushing for it? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia So this concerns us, of course, because we put banknotes into circulation. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator Exactly, exactly. udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia And no one has a plan to restrict it in any way, that people shouldn't have access to it, so. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator Isn't it based on, hey, that you were going to stop paper money? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia Not at all, not at all, not at all. The point is, I mean, if we don't deal with the essential things, then We need something to attract the media and this is perhaps something that someone can attract attention to. But in terms of the fact that there would be a risk that you would come to the store and not be able to pay cash, so it's like nonsense. No one is planning anything like that. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator Therefore, let's put it completely aside and go back to inflation. The National Bank, Just as you said a moment ago, it talks about a gradual decline in inflation, i.e. the prices of goods and services. This year you predict it at 10.5%, next year 6.7%, in 2025 already below 5% to 4.8%. Well, compared to the current inflation, if I caught it correctly, for March 14.8%, so this is really good news. Why should the development be like this and how, how is it certain that it will be like this? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia So we are, we have said right from the beginning that the shock that will come from the outside in energy prices and food prices is so self-destructive that it will destroy itself in the sense that of course it will raise costs for people and thus they will consume less in the end As a result, and when they consume less, companies cannot raise prices in stores because there is no demand. So this is exactly what is happening. We can see that consumption will fall in a while, and on the other hand, of course, it cannot be expected that energy and food prices will rise significantly again. If you look now at where they are in the world on world markets, they are somewhere where they were before the war. So if there is no second war now, an escalation of the war or something unpleasant, it will gradually translate into our prices, and I would say that in such a situation In principle, this is 95% certain. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator Surely the development should be such that plus-minus? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia The development should be like this. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator How does it compare to the countries of the European Union, especially the eurozone, which pay with the euro as we do? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia We, we are worse off, and because our households are, of course, not as financially advanced as in many other countries, and therefore they have to pay for these goods and services such as energy and food to give much more money from their salary. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator From what they get, I understand. udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia And therefore, when inflation is high for these goods, it actually has a greater impact in our country, because we spend much more money on these things than a Frenchman or a Frenchman or a Frenchman German. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator Nevertheless, even the rise in prices, adjusted for these variable items such as food and energy, was it a record, wasn't it? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia Yes, yes, because gradually, of course, it translates into other prices, because you have costs, i.e. that the company has energy costs, so it needs to be reflected in the final prices. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator Naturally. udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia This brings us back to the structure of our economy, that if you have an economy where energy actually plays a relatively large role in costs, because you don't have a lot of added value, then in such an economy, when you have research and development, you probably don't need a lot of diesel or energy to work, I don't know, in white coats somewhere, and then the development is not so dramatic. But when you work at the assembly line and operate the machines, of course those energies are absolutely crucial. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator So all this means that yes, it will fall on us even more, even though we are not the top performers either, after all, the Baltic countries, Hungary, those average inflations are many times higher. udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia Yes, but it must be said that the prices for households reacted almost immediately, while in our country the regulated prices usually react only from 1 January. This means that the prices were stable in our country all last year. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator Yes. udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia Many, and that's why inflation didn't jump as high as they did. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator I understand, I understand. Well, it is true that food, now let's talk back about Slovakia, are they the driving force behind it all? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia Yes, unfortunately, they also brought us a negative surprise at the beginning of the year. We expected that inflation might start to fall earlier. Food caused that this was not the case. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator In this context, how do you react to the action of chains in Slovakia, as if under some patronage of Minister Vlan, that they capped the prices of about 400 types for 3 months Food? And again, critics immediately spoke up, whether it was not just theirs marketing action and whether it will not hesitate the cartel, which he should look at Antimonopoly Office. How does the National Bank see it? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia So I personally expect almost no effect on inflation from this. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator This is only for our listeners, that from our point of view, i.e. those who pay for at the box office, negatively. udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia And precisely because these are only selected goods and services, and in any case, we expect food inflation to gradually fall, because the prices on the markets are already relatively low. Of course, companies are not in the sector, I would say non-profit organizations. So when they go for some of their profitability, then yes, they can cap some commodities and that will help a certain group of people who buy those commodities, but on average I do not assume that this means that all food prices will go down. In other words, they will compensate for what they cap. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator Somewhere else. And trade analysts also point out that the capped price for the consumer does not mean that it is automatically the lowest price of, say, goods in a specific segment, because there may still be lower prices, discount promotions and I don't know what else. Well, now we have to go with a proper shopping list and tick it off there, that what the prices looked like a week ago and how they look today. Can this somehow affect what we are hearing now, the surplus of grain from Ukraine, which has been Is it reaching the European market? Farmers, including some Slovak farmers, are already asking Brussels to reintroduce those tariffs, and I don't know what, which were temporarily abolished precisely because of the situation in Ukraine. Can this somehow stir up food prices or? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia It can, of course. As soon as the production is there, because there were fears that then Ukraine will not be able to supply grain to world markets, and what would it really mean. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator On the contrary, it would raise prices, clearly. udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia And now it has the opposite effect. This means that this is good news for us as consumers. Of course, this is not entirely pleasant for the farmer for whom it is competition, but for us as consumers and from the point of view of inflation, it is good news. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator Okay, with two or three questions to the banks, Mr. Vice-Governor. First again From the point of view of us, those end consumers, will interest rates continue to rise now? Will a mortgage or new housing be available to ordinary people at all? udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia So, of course, when you see inflation, which has already started to fall in the world, but is still high, central banks will raise interest rates a bit. Probably not extreme anymore, but we can expect mortgages to become more expensive, of course. Branislav ZaVODSKy, moderator So also their repayment. udovit oDOR, Vice-Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia Their repayment will also become more expensive. Fortunately, we have many of those mortgages fixed for a certain period. This means that it will not immediately affect all debtors at once, because they still have the lower, lower rates fixed for 5, some up to 10 years. But it certainly means a dampening of the real estate market, which in turn can also cause stagnation or a further decline in real estate prices. Ako, ako, ako to sledujete vy? udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska Tak my to sledujeme, samozrejme, a dlhiu dobu poukazujeme, e s tam nejak nezrovnalosti v tatistikch, e naozaj je pravda to, o niekedy hovoria ekonmovia, e sasti to treba pripsa, e nie plne rovnakou metodikou sa to meno vade. Ale keby sme aj od tohto abstrahovali a pozerali by sme sa na to nae dobiehanie bez tchto efektov, tak stle by to bolo ako pomerne pomal. Boli by sme sce na tom lepie ako mnoh krajiny, neplatilo by, e by sme boli takmer na chvoste, ale stle plat to, e v poslednom obdob nevieme dobieha zpad. A to nie je prekvapujce, lebo vlastne pohyb po istej rovni ekonomickej u t ekonomika potrebuje nejak nov model dobiehania. U, u nemme stava na lacnej pracovnej sile. Medzitm u tie platy u ns vyrstli. Nemme stava len na tom, e dovezieme nejak technolgie, prilkame nejak investcie. Stle nm pomhaj, ale potrebovali by sme prejs na t ekonomiku, ktor pohaj dopredu mylienky a nielen,nielen lacn pracovn sila. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Nai politici teda v tch svojich politikch neprichdzaj s takmito nvrhmi, ktor by ns takto posvali alebo pomaly, e tak mekme napr. oproti esku? udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska Oproti esku, ke porovnme, ak mme my vbec predpoklady pre t znalostn ekonomiku oproti esku, tak to je stle mizern alebo vemi slab a ale ete, ke zoberieme V4, tak oproti napr. takmu vo Fnsku alebo Raksku to je ete stle vemi zaostal. Take my sme na tom zle vo V4 a V4 ete je zle na tom. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Vrmci porovnania v E. udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska V E, take, bohuia, my robme vemi mlo pre to, aby sme, aby sme naozaj ekonomiku stavalo, stavali na vzdelanosti. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor A o je to to, o robme mlo preto? udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska no, no. Robme mlo to, e napr. v investcich do inovci alebo vskumu a vvoja sme vemi slab. Dvame ako vemi mlo, najmenej takmer z okolitch krajn a okrem toho aj to mlo, o tam ide, ide dos roztrsen do rznych projektov a nevyberme si tie hrozienka, neodmeujeme tch najlepch, ale radej chceme kadmu da aspo nieo. Akoby stle platilo, e ten ed priemer vaz tu na Slovensku. udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska no, no, presne tak. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor No tak to nie je, nie je plne idelna sprva. Len plne iastkov vec, ono sa to vlastne tka vetkho. o hovorte, pn viceguvernr, na ten nvrh zavies prvo na hotovos do stavy Slovenskej republiky v situcii, ke cel svet ide akoby opane, ke vetky tie platby aj ten pohyb peaz vlastne prechdza na, na online a navye do toho tla aj Eurpska centrlna banka aj Eurpska nia? udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska Tak to sa ns tka, samozrejme, lebo my dvame do obehu bankovky. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Presne tak, presne tak. udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska A nikto nem pln to nejakm spsobom obmedzova, e udia by nemali ma prstup k tomu, take. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Nevychdza to z toho, hej, e ste sa chystali stopn papierov peniaze? udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska Vbec, vbec, vbec nie. Ide, idem o to, e ke nerieime podstatn veci, tak potrebujeme niem zauja mdi a toto je mono nieo, m niekto vie zauja. Ale z hadiska toho, e by to hrozilo, e, e prdete do obchodu a neviete zaplati hotovosou, tak to je ako nonsens. Nikto ni takho neplnuje. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Preto to dajme aj plne bokom a pome teda nasp k tej inflcii. Nrodn banka, takisto ako ste pred chvokou povedali, hovor o postupnom klesan inflcie, teda cien tovarov a sluieb. Tento rok to predikujete na 10,5 %, na budci rok 6,7 %, v roku 2025 u pod 5 % na 4,8 %. No oproti tej aktulnej inflcii, ak som sprvne zachytil, za marec 14,8 %, tak to s naozaj e dobr sprvy. Preo ten vvoj m by takto a ako, ako je to ist, e bude tak? udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska Tak my sme, my sme hne od zaiatku hovorili, e ten ok, ktor prde zvonka v cench energi a cench potravn, je tak sebadetrukn, e sm seba zni v tom zmysle, e samozrejme to dvihne nklady uom a tm pdom menej spotrebuj v konenom dsledku a ke menej spotrebuj, tak firmy nemu dvha ceny v obchodoch, lebo nen tam dopyt. Take presne toto sa deje. Vidme za chvu, e t spotreba poklesne a oproti tomu, samozrejme, ned sa aka, e op by narstli ceny energi a potravn vrazne. Ke sa pozriete teraz, kde s vo svete na svetovch trhoch, tak s niekde tam, kde boli pred vojnou. Take ak teraz neprde nejak druh vojna, eskalcia vojny alebo nieo neprjemn, tak postupne sa to pretav do naich cien a povedal by som, e v takom prpade je to v zsade na 95 % ist. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Ist, e ten vvoj by mal by tak, e plus-mnus? udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska Vvoj by mal by tak. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Ako to vyzer v porovnan s krajinami Eurpskej nie, najm teda eurozny, ktor, ktor platia tak ako my eurom? udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska My, my sme na tom horie a z toho titulu, e u ns domcnosti s, samozrejme, nie tak finanne vyspel ako v mnohch inch krajinch, a preto musia prve na tieto tovary a sluby ako energie a potraviny dva ovea viac peaz z toho svojho platu. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Z toho, o dostan, rozumiem. udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska A preto, ke inflcia je pri tchto tovaroch vysok, tak a vlastne u ns to m v vplyv, lebo my dvame presne na tieto veci ovea viac peaz ako nejak Francz alebo Nemec. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Napriek tomu aj ten rast cien, oisten o tieto premenliv poloky ako potraviny a energie, bol rekordn, i? udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska no, no, lebo postupne sa to, samozrejme, pretavuje aj do inch cien, lebo mte nklady, tzn., e firma m na energiu nklady, tak to potrebuje premietnu aj do koncovch cien. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Samozrejme. udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska Toto op sa dostvame k tej truktre naej ekonomiky, e ak mte tak ekonomiku, kde vlastne tie energie zohrvaj relatvne vek lohu v nkladoch, lebo nemte vek pridan hodnotu, tak v takom, ke mte vskum a vvoj, tak asi nepotrebujete vea nafty ani energie, aby ste robili, ja neviem, v bielych ploch niekde a potom ten vvoj nie je tak dramatick. Ale ke robte pri pse a obsluhujete stroje, tak samozrejme tie energie s plne kov. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor ie toto vetko potom znamen, e no, na ns to padne ete viac, i ke nie sme tie premianti, ve pobaltsk krajiny, Maarsko, tie tie priemern inflcie s ete nsobne vyie. udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska no, ale treba poveda, e u nich tie ceny pre domcnosti zareagovali takmer okamite, km u ns tie regulovan ceny vinou reaguj a od 1. janura. Tzn., e u ns cel minul rok boli stabiln tie ceny. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor no. udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska Mnoh, a preto t inflcia nevyskoila tak vysoko ako u nich. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Rozumiem, rozumiem. No plat ale teda, e potraviny, teraz sa bavme sa nasp o Slovensku, s tm ahom toho vetkho? udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska no, bohuia, priniesli pre ns aj negatvne prekvapenie zaiatkom roka. My sme akali, e u, u skr mono zane klesa inflcia. Potraviny spsobili, e, e tomu tak nebolo. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Ako v tej svislosti reagujete na t akciu reazcov na Slovensku akoby pod nejakm patrontom ministra Vlana, e zastropovali na 3 mesiace ceny asi 400 druhov potravn? No a op sa ozvali sa pritom hne kritici, i to nie je len ich nejak marketingov akcia a i to nezavha kartelom, na ktor by sa mal pozrie Protimonopoln rad. Ako to vid Nrodn banka? udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska Tak to ja osobne neakm takmer iadny efekt na inflciu z tohto. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor To len pre naich posluchov, e z nho pohadu, teda tch, o platme pri pokladniach, negatvne. udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska A prve preto, lebo tak to s len vybran tovary a sluby a tak i tak oakvame, e postupne inflcia potravn klesne, lebo u tie ceny na trhoch s relatvne nzke. Samozrejme, firmy nie s v sektore, povedal by som, e neziskovch organizci. Take ke id za nejakou svojou ziskovosou, tak no, mu niektor komodity zastropova a to pome istej skupine ud, ktor kupuje tie komodity, ale v priemere nepredpokladm, e to zna, e vetky ceny potravn pjdu dole. Inak povedan, to, o zastropuj, bud kompenzova. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Niekde inde. A analytici obchodu zas upozoruj aj na to, e zastropovan cena pre spotrebitea ete neznamen, e to je automaticky najniia cena povedzme tovaru v konkrtnom segmente, lebo ete s tam mono niie ceny, zavov akcie a neviem, o vetko. No tak musme teraz chodi asi s nejakm zoznamom poriadnym nkupnm a si to tam odkrtva, e, e ako tie ceny vyzerali pred tdom a ako dnes. Me toto nejak ovplyvni to, o teraz povame, ten, ten prebytok obilia z Ukrajiny, ktor sa dostva na eurpsky trh? Ponohospodri, vrtane aj niektorch slovenskch, u iadaj Brusel, aby nasp zaviedol tie cl a ja neviem, o, ktor boli doasne zruen prve pre t situciu, ktor na Ukrajine je. Me toto nejak zamiea cenami potravn alebo? udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska Me, samozrejme. Akoe akonhle t produkcia tam je, lebo boli obavy, e potom Ukrajina nebude mc dodva obilie na svetov trhy a o by akoe naozaj znamenalo. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Zdvihlo by naopak ceny, jasn. udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska A teraz to m opan efekt. Tzn., e pre ns ako spotrebiteov je to dobr sprva. Samozrejme, pre toho farmra, pre koho je to konkurencia, to nie je plne prjemn, ale pre ns ako spotrebiteov a z hadiska inflcie to je dobr sprva. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor No dobre, s dvoma, tromi otzkami k bankm, pn viceguvernr. Najskr op z pohadu ns tch koncovch spotrebiteov, bud sa teraz ete zdraova roky? Bude vbec pre bench ud dostupn hypotka, nov bvanie? udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska Tak, samozrejme, ke vidte inflciu, ktor ete sce u zaala klesa vo svete, ale je stle vysok, tak ete centrlne banky zvia roky troku. U nie asi nejak extrmne, ale mme oakva, o zdra, samozrejme, aj hypotky. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Aj ich splcanie teda. udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska Aj ich splcanie zdra. Naastie, my mme mnoh tie hypotky zafixovan na ist obdobie. Tzn., e nedopadne to hne na vetkch dlnkov naraz, lebo maj ete zafixovan tie niej, niie sadzby na 5, niektor a na 10 rokov. Ale znamen to urite utlmenie trhu nehnutenost, o zase me vyvola aj stagnciu, prpadn ete al pokles cien nehnutenost. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor U sa to aj ukazuje v niektorch reginoch Slovenska. Vimol som si vau sprvu, najm v bratislavskom. udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska no, no, no. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor A toto by mohlo potom sa ukza aj na inch miestach, e zle asi, ako predtm rstli tie nehnutenosti? udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska no, no, no a o zase spsob, e asom potom tie byty mu by zas dostupnejie pre tch, pre tch ud, ale pre centrlnu banku je v tomto ohade najdleitejia momentlne t inflcia, lebo inflcia dopad na kadho a inflcia vlastne vm zoberie z platu peniaze a mono je lepie ma o osi menej dostupn hypotku, ako stle vysok inflciu. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor ie vyie percent znamenaj menej peaz na trhu a tm pdom, tm pdom zniovanie cien v obchodoch a v slubch? udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska no. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor A kde nrodn bankri aj centrlni vidia t najidelnejiu hranicu inflcie, aby nejakm spsobom nezasahovali, a teraz myslm ani na tie extrmne nzke a, neviem, nejak nulov roky, ale ani na takto, no nechcem poveda, e 3,7 je extrmne vysok, ale ak niekto mal na hypotke, ja neviem, nieo cez jedno percento, no tak to u je akoby 300 % navye k tomu. udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska no, no. Tak my sme vtedy hovorili, e to s akoe extrmne nzke a nezvyajne nzke, aj dokonca v Eurpe mloktor krajina mala tak nzke sadzby na hypotkach. Take tie asy s na ist dobu pre a treba rta s tm, e vlastne tie rovne, ktor s teraz na hypotkach, o ja viem, okolo tch tyroch percent, ete, ete porast chvu a a potom me, me by nejak stabilizcia. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Kde to me ma strop? To sa d poveda, e? udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska ako, ako poveda. Ke zoberieme na zklade toho, o dnes akaj trhy od centrlnych bnk a + tie banky s akmi marami operuj, tak ja neviem, 5 % je urite nieo, o si viem predstavi. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Rozumiem, a t pvodn otzka, e o je t idelna hranica inflcie, ak tak vbec nieo v ekonomike existuje? udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska Okolo toho je extrmne vea debt. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Viem si to predstavi. no, no. udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska Vinou sa zhoduj ekonmovia, e nieo okolo tch dvoch percent je tak relatvne rozumn miera. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor A to ste hovorili, e tak o p rokov teoreticky by sme sa mohli k tomu dopracova, hej? udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska no, urite nie, nie v najblich dvoch rokoch. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Rozumiem. No ve to sme u napokon aj hovorili o tch 6,7 na budci rok a 4,4 alebo koko to tam bolo, 4,6 v 2005-tom. No na zver teda, ja som si to zmerne nechal, e rozmam, e i to bude dobr sprva pre ns, pn viceguvernr dor. No ako toto cel teda ovplyvuje nae peaenky, ale najm nae prjmy? Ako bud vyzera tento aj budci rok nae prjmy prve vo vzahu k inflcii? udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska Minul rok bol vemi zl, lebo platy nedokzali rs tak rchlo ako bola inflcia. Tzn., e sme vedeli menej toho kpi z naich platov v obchodoch. Tento rok bude tak prelomov z naich predpokladov. Tzn., e pribline oakvame tak ist nrast platov ako nrast inflcie. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor To je to je tch 10 plus-mnus percent? udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska To je tch plus-mnus 10 %. Samozrejme, to neznamen pre kadho, ale v priemere pre ekonomiku je to dobr sprva a vrti sa na nejak relny rast platov, na t trajektriu sa mme u budci rok. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Ale to u je takto predikcia, e u budci rok by sme mohli vidie, e nm bud platy rs rchlejie ako tie roky, ke mm by takto plne, e ako ceny v obchodoch? udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska no, no. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor No o to me, o tomu, o tomu me zabrni, aby to tak nebolo? udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska Samozrejme, t vojna je nevyspytaten. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor To je to, o sme hovorili, no. udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska Ale okrem toho teraz boli tak obavy z alej nejakej bankovej a finannej krzy. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor No na to som sa presne chcel pta. Videli sme banku v Sillicon Valley spolu s ou 2 menie banky padli. Problmy Credit Suisse, najvej, najvej sn eurpskej, ak nie svetovej banky. udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska no, ale vidte, e nateraz sa situcia upokojila. To aj preto, lebo banky po tej finannej krze musia operova s vmi rezervami. Tzn., e s ovea stabilnejie ako predtm a nehovoriac o slovenskch bankch. Slovensk banky s vemi tak konzervatvne. Robia ten star biznis model, e zoberiem vklady a dm nejak hypotky a in very. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor no. udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska A menej, menej robia ten biznis model ako robili napr. Sillicon Valley banka alebo Credit Suisse. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor e vea investova do rizikovch rznych operci, obchodov. udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska Take z toho pohadu sa d pokojne spva. Banky u ns s plne bezpen. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Sn to vedia aj niektor politici, aby ns nevyzvali potom robi nejak, nejak arapaty alebo nieo. No dobre. Uvidme. No tak musme koni, pn viceguvernr, ale teda mme to ukoni s tm, e by sme mohli, tak hovorm to vemi tak opatrne, jemne, e s do lepch asov konene po rokoch. udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska no. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor No, tak to je, myslm, e tak /nezrozumiten/ so vetkmi rizikami, o ktorch ste hovorili, ktor nm tu hrozia. udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska Tak opatrne, no. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Mme to, mme to, ako sa hovor, na zreteli, samozrejme. Vemi pekne akujem, e ste boli, e sme mohli hovori. Budem sa tei, ke prdete znovu, pn viceguvernr, lebo vak tie veci sa bud, samozrejme, posva a vyvja. udovt dor, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska. akujem vemi pekne a pekn de ete. udovt DOR, viceguvernr Nrodnej banky Slovenska akujem za pozvanie. Pekn de. Branislav ZVODSK, modertor Dovidenia.

Title: Who wants value for money? (Deputy Governor udovt dor for Hospodrske noviny)
text: Who wants value for money? (Deputy Governor udovit odor for Hospodaske noviny) Apr 18, 2023 Column Opinions and analyses  If I buy expensive shoes in the store, I usually don't sit down at the computer in the evening compare which other shoes I could have bought.  Bit by bit we are backing up. There are fewer and fewer who really care about long-term financial health of the country and that scarce tax revenues are spent efficiently and with the greatest value for society.  The fact that value for money matters to almost no one anymore takes away the hope of many that better times ahead. As they say, no one can give you as much as I can promise. At the same time, promises are the basic tool of political struggle. The fact that these are often just empty words released into the air is illustrated by nothing better than the construction of motorways in Slovakia. Just counting all the dates on billboards to complete the connection between the west and east of the country would take quite a long time. There is no shortage of excuses. Of course, the inability to design, build cheaply and efficiently is not to blame, nor is it the slowness of state authorities. They clearly have butter on their heads analysts who spend 30 days assessing whether the section is reasonably planned and whether it is accidental There is no better and more effective solution. At least that's the conclusion that politicians came to in parliament, which approved a change in the law and moved the assessment of the Value for Money Unit to a later stage of the project. After all, it can be analyzed even then, they say. Sure, but for what? If I buy expensive shoes in the store, I usually don't sit down at the computer in the evening to compare which other shoes I could have bought. The saddest thing about the story is that no one stood up for a timely and comprehensive assessment in the parliamentary debate and no one was found who would vote against the transformation of analysts into partial statisticians. Common sense was not defended even by high representatives of the government office or the Ministry of Finance. I'm certainly biased, as I'm a co-creator of a value for money project. However, the problem is much more serious than this one specific example. Bit by bit we are backing up. There are fewer and fewer who really care about the long-term financial health of the country and that scarce tax revenues are spent efficiently and with the greatest value for the company. In the past, you could hear at least loud protests of those who voted for the state budget Match. Now they have often come up with ideas on how to give away as much as possible from the money of future generations. The flood will follow us. A few months before the elections, the ring is free and I'm worried about what other "creative" ones Ideas worth hundreds of millions of euros can pass through parliament. What else should be free of charge in this country and what various new benefits should be introduced or those existing across-the-board increased. Who will give more? But this feast will certainly not be free. Let's not deceive ourselves. At the final one, they kick us out of the bar. But before that, we will still have to pay the bill. If no one else, the financial markets can show us a stopwatch. In this case, however, it is usually sudden and painful. I would not like us to test their tolerance threshold. Politics is often about symbols. The fact that the value for money has almost No one cares, it takes away the hope of many that better times await us. Then let's not be surprised that young people are leaving in droves. Source Article:
text_original: Kto chce hodnotu za peniaze? (viceguvernr udovt dor pre Hospodrske noviny) 18. apr 2023 Rubrika Nzory a analzy  Ak si kpim v obchode drah topnky, veer si zvyajne nesadnem k potau porovnva, ktor in boty som si mohol kpi.  Ksok za kskom cvame. Je oraz menej takch, ktorm skutone zle na dlhodobom finannom zdrav krajiny a na tom, aby vzcne daov prjmy boli vynakladan efektvne a s najvou hodnotou pre spolonos.  Fakt, e na hodnote za peniaze u takmer nikomu nezle, berie mnohm ndej, e ns akaj lepie asy. Ako sa hovor, nikto vm nevie da toko, koko ja viem sbi. Suby s pritom zkladnm nstrojom politickho boja. e asto ide len o przdne slov vypusten do vzduchu neilustruje ni lepie ako vstavba dianic na Slovensku. U len spota vetky dtumy na bilbordoch pre dobudovanie prepojenia medzi zpadom a vchodom krajiny by trvalo pomerne dlh dobu. O vhovorky nie je ndza. Ako inak, na vine nie je neschopnos projektova, lacno a efektvne stava ani pomalos ttnych orgnov. Maslo na hlave maj jednoznane analytici, ktor 30 dn posudzuj, i je sek rozumne naplnovan a i nhodou neexistuje aj lepie a efektvnejie rieenie. Aspo k takmu zveru prili politici v parlamente, ktor odshlasili zmenu zkona a posudzovanie tvaru hodnoty za peniaze posunuli do neskorej fzy projektu. Ve analyzova sa d aj potom, hovoria. Jasn, len na o? Ak si kpim v obchode drah topnky, veer si zvyajne nesadnem k potau porovnva, ktor in boty som si mohol kpi. Na prbehu je najsmutnejie, e vasn a komplexn posdenie v parlamentnej rozprave nik nezastal a nikto sa nenaiel, kto by hlasoval proti premene analytikov na iastonch tatistov. Zdrav rozum neobhajovali ani vysok predstavitelia radu vldy i ministerstva financi. Iste som zaujat, kee som spolutvorca projektu hodnoty za peniaze. Problm je vak ovea vnej, ne tento jeden konkrtny prklad. Ksok za kskom cvame. Je oraz menej takch, ktorm skutone zle na dlhodobom finannom zdrav krajiny a na tom, aby vzcne daov prjmy boli vynakladan efektvne a s najvou hodnotou pre spolonos. Voakedy bolo pou aspo hlasn protesty tch, ktor za ttnu kasu zodpovedaj. Teraz neraz oni prichdzali s npadmi, ako o najviac rozda z peaz budcich generci. Po ns potopa. Pr mesiacov pred vobami je ring von a obvam sa toho, ak alie kreatvne npady za stmiliny eur mu prejs parlamentom. o vetko by malo by ete akoe zadarmo v tejto krajine a ak rzne nov dvky by mali by zaveden alebo tie existujce plone zven. Kto d viac? Lene tto hostina urite nebude zadarmo. Neklamme samch seba. Pri zverenej ns z baru vyhodia. Ale predtm ete budeme musie zaplati et. Ak nikto in, tak finann trhy nm mu ukza stopku. V takom prpade to vak bva nhle a bolestiv. Nerd by som bol, aby sme testovali ich prah tolerancie. Politika je asto o symboloch. Fakt, e na hodnote za peniaze u takmer nikomu nezle berie ndej mnohm, e ns akaj lepie asy.
