Title: It is fair to say that there are no easy times ahead, says NBS Chief Economist Horvth (+ video, Dennk E)
text: It is fair to say that we are not facing easy times, says NBS Chief Economist Horvath ( video, Dennik E) June 24, 2022 When we look at the further development of the economy, it will not be a glory, says Michal Horvath, Chief Economist of the National Bank of Slovakia . Inflation will remain high, the purchasing power of the population will be weak and problems in industry will persist. "The coming quarters will be weak in terms of growth. The economic downturn has probably already occurred in this quarter," he says. Horvath goes on to say in the interview:  The biggest unknown is whether there will be major outages in gas supplies, which could put us in a deeper recession.  Food prices will also rise by the end of the year compared to today's levels;  The new EU member states currently have higher inflation, which is an interesting phenomenon.  Due to high inflation, he pays more attention when there are some discounts in stores. According to the latest forecast of the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS), we will have double-digit inflation not only this year, but probably also next year. Why Do you expect such a high price growth next year? This is due to the development of energy prices. However, double-digit inflation next year is behind assuming that the government does not take more fundamental measures. We already know that they say on the agreement with gas suppliers. Such measures could prevent double-digit inflation next year. If we fail in this area, according to market prices, it looks like gas prices should go up by 130 percent next year, which will lead to double-digit inflation numbers. Thus, the estimate that average inflation should be higher than 11% next year does not yet take into account the agreement of Economy Minister Richard Sulik with the SPP on gas prices for households. So? We have not yet taken this into account. That was fresh information that came after we finalized the prediction. That just sums up the whole situation we are in. The situation on world markets is changing very quickly, as well as various measures, proposals are coming from different sides, some need to be taken more seriously, others less. In such an environment, it is very difficult to make predictions that will survive the horizon of the moon. Let us remind you that in May, according to statistics, we had year-on-year inflation of almost 13 percent. This is the highest number since 2000. When do you think inflation will peak in our country? Next year in January? Yes, we expect inflation to peak at the beginning of next year. Again, this is related to regulated energy prices. This year, we have energy prices for households fixed at some level and they have already grown. The increase reflects developments on global markets up to October last year. And when we take into account the market development since then and the measures taken by the government, this will translate into a jump in prices from January. When we look at other things, such as food or goods that we import from abroad, their price growth should peak sometime towards the end of the year and then it should calm down. When we talked recently, you said that food prices would be the number one topic in the autumn. Do you still think so? Will food be even more expensive? I still think so. Food prices are rising rapidly, but we expect pressures to continue culminate. So in the rest of the year, they will also rise compared to today's levels. Year-on-year increases will be higher than we have now. Is it also related to the fact that Ukraine has a problem with grain exports due to the war? Naturally. We have been observing problems with the development of energy and food prices for a long time, it started last year around this time. At that time, there were other reasons behind it, but precisely in this According to predictions at the time, the situation should have calmed down. However, the war in Ukraine has completely shuffled the cards and the situation has completely changed both in the development of energy prices and in the development of food prices. We have been noticing that it is more expensive for several months. Personally, you have changed something in your behavior, some habits, maybe you don't go to a restaurant that often, Maybe you have a larger financial reserve or invest more? I have to say that I probably notice more than before when there are some discounts in stores. As if I started to be a little more careful about spending. Fortunately, I belong to the A category of people who know how to save from their income, and that's why I can currently see that I have less left in my account at the end of the month. So I save less than in the past. By the way, when we look at the data, it fits quite well with the population as a whole. Before the pandemic crisis, we saved about 8 to 9 percent of income on average, and recently it has been about 5 percent. These are total numbers, of course, people are different. I think that even in my case, the point is that I haven't changed those habits that much. Rather, I sometimes spend more of my savings. Do you often ask your friends when the price growth will slow down? Naturally. I tell them that it will be even more difficult this year and next year. Before I came here, I was just talking to my mother and she was asking about the price development Energy. By the way, she is working to manage the household more efficiently with heating. Unfortunately, I had to tell her that the prices were already high, but They are likely to grow significantly. What would have to happen for inflation not to rise so sharply? What could slow it down? The development of energy and food prices on world markets is crucial. It would be good if the situation there at least stabilized and prices might even fall. Already in the last weeks, we watched as if the price of gas was gradually falling slightly and returning "only" to three times the levels compared to last year. But Russia's actions have caused prices to shoot up again. So there must be a calming of both the state of war and the global raw material markets, and then we can move on to more normal times. Inflation will mainly affect low-income groups, people who are on benefits in material need. Is the package of measures for families with children a good help? Does the government help the socially disadvantaged enough? We looked at it more from a macroeconomic point of view, what it will do to household consumption and to the growth of gross domestic product. It turns out that without this measure, we would see a noticeable decline in household consumption next year. With these measures, as it means quite a significant support for household wallets, such a decline might not occur. However, a similar effect would be generated by other measures, not just this particular package. The Council for Budget Responsibility has calculated that this is not exactly a targeted form of assistance. Although some money also reaches some of the deprived, public finances are in poor condition and we are not here to distribute significant resources widely. Problem The package is also about the fact that it establishes long-term obligations, it is not a temporary measure, but a permanent increase in expenditure that is not covered. It is legitimate to discuss what the level of support for families should be, about tax reform. That's perfectly fine, but when We are talking about changes in the long-term setting of these policies, so it should be financed somehow. Do you think it is okay that the government presented a package without financial backing? Alternatively, you agree with what the State Secretary of the Ministry recently said Marcel Klimek, that the package is covered in the budget, but there is no money yet for higher salaries of teachers and health workers? One thing is whether it will be covered within some numbers that are currently drawn in the budget for the next year or two. What the Council for the Defence of the European Union has said is also essential to me. budgetary responsibility, that these measures create permanent obligations in public finances for the future, and we do not have them covered. This worsens the long-term sustainability of public finances, and at some point in the future we will have to look for additional resources for these measures. It is good that when we make a change in family policy, there should be a discussion beforehand where we can find resources for it. Even without measures for families, the government must put together a consolidation package worth about half a billion euros, according to the calculations of the Budget Council. How do you as an economist Do you see the proposal that the government would increase, for example, the tax on gambling, alcohol and the levy for companies from regulated industries? From the position of the National Bank of Slovakia, we are not trying to give recommendations to the government, especially not in the area of how it should set the tax mix. As an economist, I can say that usually raising taxes on things that are particularly harmful to the environment, or where there is little likelihood of a change in behaviour after a tax increase, is less harmful and can create room for either a reduction in other taxes or some sensible spending. Are you disturbed by the amount of Slovakia's debt, which is above 60 percent of GDP, or is it still in some standard? Given what we have been through as an economy after the pandemic, and the fact that we are now here We have a war situation beyond our borders, the current numbers don't bother me that much. Rather, I would like to see a credible plan to get us to lower levels of debt in the future as a small open economy, which is still in the eyes of foreign investors on the border somewhere between an advanced and an emerging economy. We cannot keep the debt at these levels for a long time, we have to go lower and there We need a plan. Positive things are also happening in this area. I am referring to the introduction of expenditure limits, which should increase the sophistication and calculability of budget plans. But at the moment, we do not see a qualitative change in the preparation of the budget. Let's go back to inflation. Do you think it is already certain that the European Central Bank will start raising interest rates in July? It is more of a question for the governor. Market expectations are such that this will happen, even the latest statement by the European Central Bank (ECB) gives very little room for this not to happen. Rather, at the moment, the focus is on what will happen in September, whether interest rates will then increase by half a percent or by a different value. The communication from the ECB is also such that if nothing fundamental changes in the development of inflation, but also in the development of risks in the future, then rates should be raised by half a percent already in September. The US central bank has raised its interest rates earlier and repeatedly. After a long time, the ECB will probably do this in July, it is expected to increase them by 0.25 percentage points. However, inflation is high both in the United States and in Europe. So what's the difference? Does the ECB really have more time? Two things are important. One is that the nature of inflation in the euro area and in the United States has been different for a long time. In the United States, also due to the huge stimulus that the economy received from fiscal policy, inflation affected a much wider range of goods and services, not only energy and food. At the same time, wages there grew very quickly, and the risk that inflation would last longer, be higher, would be reflected in wages and then again in prices, was significantly higher. That is why they started acting earlier. There is even a He discusses whether it was too late anyway. In the eurozone, this story has been around for a very long time About items that the central bank cannot influence much, such as food. Recently, we have begun to see that this is spilling over to other goods and services to a greater extent. The second point is that the eurozone went into this episode of rising inflation from the position that inflation has been very low for a long time. Too low from the point of view central bankers. For a long time, it has not been able to meet the two percent inflation target not from above, but from below. So, to some extent, the ECB wanted inflation expectations to move upwards, because they were too close to zero and thus to negative values, which we want to avoid. When we look at market expectations for the next 5 to 10 years, it currently looks like the markets expect inflation in the euro area at the level of two percent. So it's where it should be, there are no signs that inflation began to rush uncontrollably to higher values. The interest rate trajectory that markets are currently expecting ensures that markets should return to targeted Values. What part of inflation does the ECB really have an impact on? We are seeing that inflation is becoming more and more global. To some extent, the inflation that we see in the eurozone and in our country is something that spills over to us from the United States. Or due to the measures in the United States, global pressures on the prices of raw materials or the prices of some components are also transferred to our inflation, and therefore if it is subdued the US economy and inflation in the United States, it should also dampen inflation in our country. But it is clear that we cannot make an excuse that the Americans will do it for us or that we are completely out of control. At the euro area level, the ECB's measures can navigate inflation back to the target. Even within the eurozone, there are differences in the inflation rate of the member states. The countries in the south of Europe have a slightly lower it, we are among the countries that have it higher. Is it for energy? It is an interesting phenomenon that the new member states currently have higher inflation and it also affects a wider range of goods and services. Of course, in southern countries, gas is less heated, and they come out of this situation better even where energy is available. produced from nuclear fuel. In Eastern European countries, we see that rising energy prices, as well as the prices of imported goods, are very quickly reflected in prices for consumers. An important part of the story is that there is a lot of tension in the labor market. There is a shortage of labor and wages are growing rapidly. Companies are facing pressure from all sides. They have more expensive energy, more expensive raw materials, they can't afford to save a little on wages because they wouldn't be able to hire people. We have this mix of influences that means that Foreign prices are getting into prices for domestic consumers unusually quickly. Let's go back to your forecast. According to her, nominal wages should grow by an average of 8 to 9% this year and next. However, real salaries will fall in this And probably next year as well. However, unemployment should not grow, work should not decrease. Will our standard of living fall? I guess it's fair to say that it could have been significantly better. It is true that in the forecast we expect that this situation will not have such a negative impact on the labour market. When we look at the numbers, there is a stable unemployment rate and a slightly rising one employment. When it comes to employment, it is important to realize that we are still below pre-pandemic levels and positive news in employment has already increased this year. Occurred. The next period will be quite lukewarm. What do you mean by that? Weakening economy, weak purchasing power, problems will continue to persist in international trade and this will affect production in Slovakia. This will mean that businesses will not hire as much as they would in other circumstances. Perhaps the good news is that we do not expect employment to fall significantly. We labor shortage, people who lose their jobs for some reason will to be able to find it somewhere else, because there is a lack of it. It is important to realize that we are already feeling the impact that our population is ageing and more people are retiring than are entering the labour market. We have to deal with this as well. That is why we say that there will be enough work even in the near future. When you talk to companies, what do they deal with the most? Expensive energy or shortage skilled workforce? When we talked to them at the turn of February and March, we also tried to ask them about the development of costs, expected inflation and wage developments. What resonated the most was the shortage of labor across industries, from IT companies to furniture companies, sugar factories and the like. Although the war was still very fresh at that time, several They indicated that as soon as a larger influx of refugees starts, they will have no problem employing them. It's not just a cyclical development, that we now have a shortage of labor, it's a long-term problem and it's going to get worse as we age. From the interviews With companies, it follows that this is also a barrier to greater economic growth in the long run. They face the dilemma of whether to invest in Slovakia or abroad, and if they expand their operations, whether they will find people with the necessary qualifications. As a rule, the answer is no, and if they are multinationals, they start looking elsewhere in the region. People who came to us from Ukraine due to the war still have trouble finding a job that matches their qualifications? Available data indicate that there is still a situation where they are more likely to be employed in less qualified positions. The good news for the industry is that they can also be employed, for example, as machine operators. The services that are now opening up after the pandemic are also helped by the availability of labor from Ukraine. What is usually the case in such a situation is that the refugee population is employed rather disproportionately to what it has qualification structure. There is probably also a language problem, which could probably be solved quickly in this case. But apparently the demographic situation is such that women with children prevail there. It is likely that the availability of services for children and caring for the elderly at retirement age also affects what kind of work these people can find. Is there a problem with the lack of qualified workforce across the country, or does it apply mainly to western Slovakia? According to what the companies said, the problem was everywhere - from Kosice, through zilina, Sere, simply everywhere. The data also confirms this. Let's go back to the price increases. People also see it through more expensive loans. Interest rates on mortgages have already reached 2.5 to 3 percent. Will they be even higher in a year or two? Can we also have 5 percent interest? When we look at the outlook for the key ECB interest rates, they are currently expected to rise somewhere above 2 percent next year. Domestic components must then be added to this - banks' costs, risk and profit margin. I would not like to speculate on specific levels, but this can easily be made up of 4 percent. If we didn't have the euro, would mortgages be even more expensive? I'm also asking because for example, in the Czech Republic, mortgage interest rates are much higher, and The central bank has already raised its key rate several times. This is a very difficult question. Basically, you are asking that if we had a separate monetary policy, what would we do. We can see that in the Czech Republic, Poland and in Hungary, central bank interest rates are already significantly higher than in the euro area. I don't want to comment on their policy, maybe they even "overreacted" a bit. These countries went into the pandemic crisis with a high inflation rate and a relatively fast pace of wage growth. At that time, Slovakia was more like the eurozone. It would probably be true that some There would be differences in mortgage prices in any case, and in this particular case, the euro helps us that interest rates do not rise so quickly. Many people are now wondering whether it is better to use the free money in the account to pay off part of the mortgage or to invest the money instead. How do you think they should think? I wouldn't want to get into financial consulting. It's a very interesting question, I solve it myself and I solve it with a combination of things. Partly by reducing debt. If you have some money that you won't need in the long run, gradually investing in the stock markets in a broad portfolio makes sense. The investment horizon is important. So when you ask what they should do now, the question is when they will need the money. If they don't need them, if you spread it over time, investing in stocks is still interesting. Although the nearest period will bring losses, when we look at the 5- to 10-year horizon, it should return. According to your forecast, the growth of the economy will slow down below two percent. What is it like The probability of a scenario that we will fall into a recession? The important thing is whether there will be major outages in gas supplies. This is probably the biggest unknown until the next period. If such a situation occurred, we would also feel economic downturn and we could get into a deeper recession. When we look at the further development of the economy, it will be no glory, the weak purchasing power of the population, as well as the ongoing problems in industry, will mean that the coming quarters will be weak in terms of growth. The decline has probably already occurred in this quarter. Still We don't have numbers, but the April and May data for industry will also be weak. The next period will also be a period of growth, which would otherwise be disappointing. A longer view is still quite nice. So let's hope that 2024 will be a better year. Then you expect inflation to be significantly lower. Why? When the influence of energies wears off, we should return to its normal values. Let's hope that the situation on world markets will not escalate further. Will the average consumer feel in the near future how prices are rising from month to month, perhaps even by leaps and bounds, or will month-on-month inflation moderate? The jump will be felt at the beginning of next year, when regulated prices will be rearranged. Month-on-month price increases are currently very fluctuating. At the turn of the year, we had an increase in food prices by six percent, now in May we had a month-on-month inflation of a total of 1.5 percent, which is the highest price increase in May in history. Even if we make predictions and put values that would look like crazy in the historical context, the situation can still surprise us. There will still be an increase in inflation in the coming months, but it should start to turn around at the turn of the year.
text_original: Je frov poveda, e ns neakaj ahk asy, hovor hlavn ekonm NBS Horvth (+ video, Dennk E) 24. jn 2022 Ke sa pozrieme na al vvoj ekonomiky, nebude to iadna slva, hovor hlavn ekonm Nrodnej banky Slovenska Michal Horvth. Inflcia bude naalej vysok, kpyschopnos obyvatestva slab a problmy v priemysle bud pretrvva. Najbliie tvrroky bud z hadiska rastu slab. K poklesu ekonomiky u pravdepodobne dolo v tomto tvrroku, hovor. Horvth v rozhovore alej vrav:  Najvia neznma je, i djde k vm vpadkom v dodvkach plynu, o by ns mohlo dosta do hlbej recesie.  Ceny potravn do konca roka ete porast aj oproti dnenm rovniam;  Nov lensk krajiny E maj momentlne vyiu inflciu, o je zaujmav fenomn.  Pre vysok inflciu si viac vma, ke s v obchodoch nejak zavy. Poda najnovej prognzy Nrodnej banky Slovenska (NBS) budeme ma dvojcifern inflciu nielen v tomto roku, ale zrejme aj v budcom. Preo oakvate tak vysok rast cien ete aj v budcom roku? Je to dan vvojom cien energi. Dvojcifern inflcia v budcom roku je vak za predpokladu, e vlda neprijme zsadnejie opatrenia. U vieme, e sa hovor o dohode s dodvatemi plynu. Takto opatrenia by v budcom roku mohli zabrni dvojcifernej inflcii. Ke neuspejeme v tejto oblasti, poda trhovch cien to vyzer tak, e ceny plynu by mali s budci rok hore o 130 percent, o povedie k dvojcifernm inflanm slam. Take v odhade, e v budcom roku by priemern inflcia mala by vyia ako 11 %, nie je ete zohadnen dohoda ministra hospodrstva Richarda Sulka s SPP o cench plynu pre domcnosti. Tak? Ete sme to nezohadnili. To bola erstv informcia, ktor prila po tom, ako sme sfinalizovali predikciu. To len vystihuje cel situciu, v ktorej sa nachdzame. Vemi rchlo sa men aj situcia na svetovch trhoch, aj rzne opatrenia, prichdzaj nvrhy z rznych strn, niektor treba bra vnejie, in menej. V takomto prostred je vemi ak robi predikcie, ktor preij horizont mesiaca. Pripomeme, e v mji sme mali poda tatistikov medziron inflciu takmer 13 percent. To je doteraz najviac od roku 2000. Kedy bude poda vs inflcia u ns vrcholi? V budcom roku v januri? no, rtame s tm, e vrchol by inflcia mala dosiahnu zaiatkom budceho roka. Op to svis s regulovanmi cenami energi. V tomto roku mme ceny energi pre domcnosti zafixovan na nejakej rovni a ony u narstli. Nrast odzrkaduje vvoj na svetovch trhoch do oktbra minulho roka. A ke sa zohadn trhov vvoj odvtedy a k tomu opatrenia vldy, premietne sa to do skokovho zvenia cien od janura. Ke sa pozrieme na ostatn veci, naprklad na potraviny alebo tovary, ktor dovame zo zahraniia, ich cenov rast by mal vrcholi niekedy ku koncu roka a potom by sa to u malo upokojova. Ke sme sa nedvno rozprvali, povedali ste, e na jese bud tmou slo jeden ceny potravn. Stle si to myslte? Bud potraviny ete drahie? Stle si to myslm. Ceny potravn rchlo rast, ale oakvame, e tlaky bud ete vrcholi. Take vo zvyku roka ete porast aj oproti dnenm rovniam. Medziron nrasty bud vyie, ako mme teraz. Svis to aj s tm, e Ukrajina m pre vojnu problm s vvozom obilia? Samozrejme. Problmy s vvojom cien energi a potravn sledujeme u dlhie, zaalo sa to vlani zhruba v tomto ase. Vtedy za tm boli in dvody, ale prvee v tomto obdob sa u situcia mala poda vtedajch predikci upokojova. Vojna na Ukrajine vak plne zamieala karty a situcia sa aj vo vvoji cien energi, ale aj vo vvoji cien potravn plne zmenila. To, e je drahie, vnmame u niekoko mesiacov. Osobne ste nieo na svojom sprvan zmenili, niektor zvyky, mono nechodte tak asto do retaurcie, mono mte viu finann rezervu alebo viac investujete? Musm poveda, e si asi viac ako predtm vmam, ke s v obchodoch nejak zavy. Ako keby som si zaal trochu viac dva pozor na manie. Naastie patrm do kategrie ud, ktor vedia zo svojho prjmu uspori, a preto momentlne vidm, e na te mi na konci mesiaca zostva menej. Take sporm menej ako v minulosti. Ke sa, mimochodom, pozrieme na daje, tak to celkom sed aj na populciu ako celok. Pred pandemickou krzou sme v priemere sporili zhruba 8 a 9 percent prjmu, v poslednom obdob je to zhruba 5 percent. To s celkov sla, samozrejme, udia s na tom rzne. Myslm si, e aj v mojom prpade ide o to, e a tak som tie zvyklosti nezmenil. Skr niekedy viac mam zo svojich spor. Znmi sa vs asto ptaj, kedy sa rast cien spomal? Samozrejme. Hovorm im, e tento rok aj budci rok to bude ete ak. Predtm, ako som sem priiel, som akurt hovoril so svojou mamou a ona sa ptala na vvoj cien energi. Mimochodom, pracuje na tom, aby efektvnejie hospodrila v domcnosti s vykurovanm. Bohuia som jej musel poveda, e ceny s u vysok, ale pravdepodobne ete vrazne porast. o by sa muselo sta, aby inflcia tak prudko nerstla? o by ju dokzalo spomali? Kov je vvoj cien energi a potravn na svetovch trhoch. Bolo by dobr, keby sa tam situcia aspo stabilizovala a ceny ete mono aj poklesli. U v poslednch tdoch sme sledovali, ako keby cena plynu postupne mierne klesala a vracala sa iba na trojnsobn rovne oproti minulmu roku. Ale kroky zo strany Ruska spsobili, e ceny op vystrelili. Take mus nasta upokojenie aj vojnovho stavu, aj na svetovch trhoch so surovinami, a potom meme prejs do normlnejch asov. Inflcia zasiahne najm nzkoprjmov skupiny, ud, ktor s na dvkach v hmotnej ndzi. Je balk opatren pre rodiny s demi dobr pomoc? Pomha vlda socilne slabm dostatone? My sme sa na to pozreli skr z makroekonomickho hadiska, o to sprav so spotrebou domcnost a s rastom hrubho domceho produktu. Vychdza to tak, e bez tohto opatrenia by sme budci rok videli citen pokles spotreby domcnost. S tmito opatreniami, kee to znamen dos citen podporu pre peaenky domcnost, by k takmu poklesu nemuselo djs. Podobn efekt by vak generovali aj in opatrenia, nielen tento konkrtny balek. Rada pre rozpotov zodpovednos prertala, e to nie je prve adresn forma pomoci. Sce nejak peniaze sa dostvaj aj k niektorm odkzanm, ale verejn financie s v zlom stave a nie sme tu nato, aby sme rozdvali vraznejie zdroje zoiroka. Problm s balkom je aj ten, e zaklad dlhodob zvzky, nie je to doasn opatrenie, ale trval zvenie vdavkov, ktor nie je kryt. Je legitmne diskutova o tom, ak by mala by miera podpory pre rodiny, o daovej reforme. To je plne v poriadku, ale ke hovorme o zmench v dlhodobom nastaven tchto politk, tak to by malo by aj nejako financovan. Je poda vs v poriadku, e vlda predloila balek bez finannho krytia? Prpadne shlaste s tm, o nedvno povedal ttny tajomnk ministerstva financi Marcel Klimek, e balk je v rozpote kryt, len nie s zatia peniaze na vyie platy uiteov a zdravotnkov? Jedna vec je, i sa to vykryje v rmci nejakch sel, ktor s momentlne v rozpote nakreslen na najbli rok, dva. Podstatn je pre ma aj to, o hovorila Rada pre rozpotov zodpovednos, e tieto opatrenia zakladaj trval zvzky vo verejnch financich do budcnosti a tie nemme kryt. Zhoruje to dlhodob udratenos verejnch financi a niekedy v budcnosti budeme musie na tieto opatrenia hada alie zdroje. Je dobr, aby v prpade, ke robme zmenu v rodinnej politike, prebehla predtm diskusia, kde na to njdeme zdroje. Aj bez opatren pre rodiny mus vlda zostavi poda prepotov rozpotovej rady konsolidan balek za pribline pol miliardy eur. Ako sa vy ako ekonm pozerte na nvrh, e by vlda zvila naprklad da z hazardu, z liehu a odvod pre firmy z regulovanch odvetv? Z pozcie Nrodnej banky Slovenska sa nesname dva vlde odporania, osobitne nie v oblasti, ako by mala nastavova daov mix. Ako ekonm mem poveda, e obyajne zvenie dan na veci, ktor s kodliv najm pre ivotn prostredie alebo kde je mal pravdepodobnos zmeny sprvania po zven nejakej dane, je menej kodliv a me to vytvori priestor bu na znenie inch dan, alebo na nejak rozumn vdavky. Vyruuje vs vka dlhu Slovenska, ktor je nad 60 percentami HDP, i je to ete v nejakej norme? Vzhadom na to, o sme si ako ekonomika po pandmii preli, a na to, e teraz tu mme vojnov situciu za naimi hranicami, mi sasn sla a tak neprekaj. Skr by som rd videl dveryhodn pln, ako sa dostaneme na niie rovne dlhu v budcnosti ako mal otvoren ekonomika, ktor je ete aj v oiach zahraninch investorov na rozhran niekde medzi vyspelou a rozvjajcou sa ekonomikou. Nememe dlhodobo dra dlh na tchto rovniach, musme s niie a tam potrebujeme pln. V tejto oblasti sa dej aj pozitvne veci. Mm na mysli zavedenie vdavkovch limitov, o by malo zvi premyslenos, vypotatenos rozpotovch plnov. Ale momentlne ete kvalitatvnu zmenu v zostavovan rozpotu nevidme. Pome ete sp k inflcii. Je u poda vs ist, e Eurpska centrlna banka zane v jli dvha rokov sadzby? Je to skr otzka na guvernra. Trhov oakvania s tak, e k tomu djde, aj posledn vyhlsenie Eurpskej centrlnej banky (ECB) dva vemi mal priestor, e by k tomu nedolo. Skr momentlne je pozornos zameran na to, o sa udeje v septembri, i sa rokov sadzby vtedy zvia o pol percenta alebo o in hodnotu. Aj komunikcia zo strany ECB je tak, e ak sa ni zsadn vo vvoji inflcie, ale ani vo vvoji rizk do budcnosti nezmen, tak by sa sadzby mali zvi o pol percenta u v septembri. Americk centrlna banka u skr a opakovane zdvihla svoje rokov sadzby. ECB to po dlhom ase urob zrejme v jli, ak sa, e ich zvi o 0,25 percentnho bodu. Inflcia je vak vysok aj v Spojench ttoch, aj v Eurpe. V om je teda rozdiel? M ECB naozaj viac asu? Dleit s dve veci. Jedna je, e charakter inflcie v eurozne a v Spojench ttoch bol dlho in. V Spojench ttoch aj vzhadom na obrovsk stimuly, ktor ekonomika dostala z fiklnej politiky, inflcia zasahovala podstatne ir okruh tovarov a sluieb, nelo tu len o energie a potraviny. Zrove mzdy tam vemi rchlo rstli a riziko toho, e inflcia bude trva dlhie, bude vyia, bude sa premieta do miezd a potom nsledne zase do cien, bolo podstatne vyie. Preto aj skr zaali kona. Dokonca sa tam diskutuje, i to aj tak nebolo prli neskoro. V eurozne bol ten prbeh vemi dlho o polokch, ktor centrlna banka nevie vemi ovplyvni, ako s naprklad potraviny. V poslednom ase zaname sledova, e sa to vo vraznejej miere prelieva aj do ostatnch tovarov a sluieb. Druh bod je, e eurozna ila do tejto epizdy rastcej inflcie z pozcie, e mala inflciu dlhodobo vemi nzku. A prli nzku z pohadu centrlnych bankrov. Dlhodobo sa jej nedarilo plni dvojpercentn inflan cie nie zhora, ale zdola. ECB teda do istej miery chcela, aby sa inflan oakvania prestavili smerom nahor, lebo sa pohybovali prli blzko nuly a tm aj zpornch hodnt, omu sa chceme vyhn. Ke sa pozrieme na trhov oakvania na obdobie alch 5 a 10 rokov, momentlne to vyzer tak, e trhy oakvaj inflciu v eurozne na rovni dvoch percent. Take je to tam, kde by to malo by, nie s nznaky toho, e by sa inflcia zaala nekontrolovane hrn do vych hodnt. Trajektria rokovch sadzieb, ktor trhy momentlne oakvaj, zabezpeuje, e by sa trhy mali vrti k cielenm hodnotm. Na ak as inflcie m ECB relne dosah? Sledujeme, e inflcia je oraz viac globlneho charakteru. Do istej miery inflcia, ktor vidme v eurozne aj u ns, je nieo, o sa prelieva k nm zo Spojench ttov. Alebo vplyvom opatren v Spojench ttoch globlne tlaky aj na ceny surovn alebo ceny niektorch komponentov sa prenaj aj do naej inflcie, a teda ak sa bude tlmi americk ekonomika a inflcia v Spojench ttoch, malo by to tlmi aj inflciu u ns. Ale je jasn, e sa nememe vyhovori na to, e Ameriania to spravia za ns alebo e to mme plne mimo kontroly. Na rovni eurozny opatrenia ECB doku navigova inflciu sp k cieu. Aj v rmci eurozny s rozdiely v tom, ak maj lensk krajiny inflciu. tty na juhu Eurpy ju maj o nieo niiu, my patrme ku krajinm, ktor ju maj vyiu. Je to pre energie? Je to zaujmav fenomn, e momentlne nov lensk krajiny maj vyiu inflciu a dotka sa aj irieho okruhu tovarov a sluieb. Samozrejme, v juanskch krajinch sa menej kri plynom a z tejto situcie vychdzaj lepie aj tam, kde sa energia produkuje z jadrovho paliva. Vo vchodoeurpskych krajinch sledujeme, e rastce ceny energi, ale aj ceny dovanch tovarov sa vemi rchlo premietaj do cien pre spotrebiteov. Dleitou sasou prbehu je aj to, e na trhu prce je vek naptie. Je nedostatok pracovnej sily a mzdy rchlo rast. Firmy tu elia tlakom zo vetkch strn. Maj drahie energie, drahie suroviny, nemu si dovoli, e troku uetria na mzdch, lebo by nevedeli najma ud. Mme takto mix vplyvov, ktor znamenaj, e zahranin ceny sa nezvyajne rchlo dostvaj do cien pre domcich spotrebiteov. Vrme sa ete k vaej prognze. Poda nej by nominlne mzdy mali rs v priemere o 8 a 9 % tento a budci rok. Relne platy vak klesn v tomto a zrejme aj v budcom roku. Nezamestnanos by vak nemala rs, prce by nemalo ubda. Bude naa ivotn rove klesa? Asi je frov poveda to, e to mohlo by podstatne lepie. Je pravda, e v predikcii oakvame, e na trh prce nebude ma tto situcia a tak negatvny vplyv. Ke sa pozrieme na sla, je tam stabiln miera nezamestnanosti aj mierne rastca zamestnanos. Pri zamestnanosti je dleit uvedomi si, e stle sme ete pod predpandemickmi rovami a pozitvne sprvy v zamestnanosti sa u v tomto roku udiali. To najbliie obdobie bude dos tak vlan. o tm myslte? Slabncu ekonomiku, slab kpyschopnos, naalej bud pretrvva problmy v medzinrodnom obchode a to bude dolieha na produkciu na Slovensku. To bude znamena, e firmy nebud najma toko, ako by najmali za inch okolnost. Mono dobr sprva je, e nertame s tm, e by zamestnanos vrazne klesala. Mme nedostatok pracovnej sily, udia, ktor z nejakho dvodu prdu o prcu, si ju bud vedie njs niekde inde, lebo je jej nedostatok. Treba si uvedomi, e u ctime vplyv toho, e nae obyvatestvo starne a viac ud odchdza do dchodku, ako prichdza na trh prce. Aj s tmto sa musme bori. Preto hovorme, e prce bude dos aj v najbliom obdob. Ke hovorte s firmami, o najviac rieia? Drah energie alebo nedostatok kvalifikovanej pracovnej sily? Ke sme sa s nimi rozprvali na prelome februra a marca, snaili sme sa ich pta aj na vvoj nkladov, oakvan inflciu a vvoj miezd. o najviac rezonovalo, bol prve nedostatok pracovnej sily a to naprie odvetviami, od IT firiem po nbytkrske podniky, cukrovary a podobne. Hoci bola vojna v tom ase ete vemi erstv, viacer naznaovali, e len o sa spust v prlev uteencov, nebud ma problm zamestnva. Nejde len o cyklick vvoj, e teraz mme nedostatok pracovnej sily, je to dlhodob problm a bude to ete horie vzhadom na to starnutie. Z rozhovorov s firmami nm vyplva, e je to aj barira vieho rastu ekonomiky v dlhom horizonte. elia dileme, i investova na Slovensku alebo v zahrani a ak rozria prevdzku, i njdu ud s potrebnou kvalifikciou. Spravidla je odpove nie a ak ide o nadnrodn spolonosti, zan hada inde v regine. udia, ktor k nm prili z Ukrajiny vinou vojny, maj stle problm njs si prcu, ktor zodpoved ich kvalifikcii? Dostupn dta naznauj, e stle pretrvva situcia, e sa skr zamestnaj v menej kvalifikovanch pozcich. Dobr sprva pre priemysel je, e sa doku zamestna naprklad aj ako opertori strojov. Aj slubm, ktor sa po pandmii teraz otvraj, pomha to, e je dostupn pracovn sila z Ukrajiny. Naalej plat, o zvykne by v takej situcii, e uteeneck populcia sa zamestnva skr neprimerane tomu, ak m kvalifikan truktru. Je tam asi aj jazykov problm, o by sa asi v tomto prpade dalo rchlo vyriei. Ale zrejme aj demografick situcia je tak, e tam prevauj v zsade eny s demi. Pravdepodobne aj dostupnos sluieb pre deti a opatrovanie starch ud v dchodkovom veku ovplyvuje to, ak prcu si t udia vedia njs. Je problm s nedostatkom kvalifikovanej pracovnej sily naprie krajinou, i sa to tka najm zpadnho Slovenska? Poda toho, o vraveli firmy, bol ten problm vade - od Koc, cez ilinu, Sere, jednoducho vade. Dta to aj potvrdzuj. Pome ete sp k zdraovaniu. udia ho vidia aj cez drahie very. roky na hypotky sa u dostali k 2,5 a 3 percentm. Bud o rok i o dva ete vyie? Meme ma aj 5-percentn roky? Ke sa pozrieme na vhad kovch rokovch sadzieb ECB, momentlne sa oakva ich nrast niekde nad 2 percent v budcom roku. K tomu si potom treba prirta domce komponenty - nklady bnk, rizikov a ziskov maru. O konkrtnych rovniach by som nerd pekuloval, ale z tohto sa hravo vyskladaj aj 4 percent. Keby sme nemali euro, boli by hypotky ete drahie? Ptam sa aj preto, e naprklad v eskej republike s roky na hypotky o dos vyie a tamojia centrlna banka zvyovala svoju kov sadzbu u niekokokrt. To je vemi zloit otzka. V zsade sa ptate na to, e keby sme mali samostatn menov politiku, o by sme robili. Vidme, e v eskej republike, v Posku aj v Maarsku s rokov sadzby centrlnych bnk u podstatne vyie ako v eurozne. Nechcem komentova ich politiku, mono trochu aj prereagovali. Tieto krajiny ili do pandemickej krzy u s vysokou mierou inflcie, pomerne rchlym tempom rastu miezd. Slovensko sa v tom ase podobalo skr na euroznu. Zrejme by platilo, e nejak rozdiely v cench hypotk by v kadom prpade boli a v tomto konkrtnom prpade nm euro pomha, e roky nm tak rchlo nerast. Vea ud riei teraz to, i je lepie von peniaze na te poui na splatenie asti hypotky, alebo peniaze radej investova. Ako by poda vs mali uvaova? Nechcel by som sa pa do finannho poradenstva. Je to vemi zaujmav otzka, sm ju rieim a rieim ju kombinciou vec. Sasti zniovanm zadlenia. Pokia m lovek nejak peniaze, ktor dlhodobo nebude potrebova, postupn investovanie na akciovch trhoch do nejakho irokho portflia dva zmysel. Dleit je investin horizont. Take ke sa ptate, o by mali teraz robi, otzka je, kedy bud peniaze potrebova. Ak ich nepotrebuj, ke si to lovek rozlo v ase, investcie do akci s stle zaujmav. Aj ke najbliie obdobie prinesie straty, ke sa pozrieme na 5- a 10- ron horizont, malo by sa to vrti. Poda vaej prognzy sa rast ekonomiky spomal pod dve percent. Ak je pravdepodobnos scenra, e spadneme do recesie? Dleit je, i djde k vm vpadkom v dodvkach plynu. To je asi najvia neznma do alieho obdobia. Ak by k takejto situcii dolo, tak by sme poctili aj pokles ekonomiky a mohli by sme sa dosta do hlbej recesie. Ke sa pozrieme na al vvoj ekonomiky, nebude to iadna slva, slab kpyschopnos obyvatestva, aj pretrvvajce problmy v priemysle bud znamena, e najbliie tvrroky bud z hadiska rastu slab. K poklesu u pravdepodobne dolo v tomto tvrroku. Ete nemme sla, ale aj aprlov a mjov daje za priemysel bud slab. Aj alie obdobie bude obdobm rastov, ktor by za inch okolnost bolo sklamanm. Dlh vhad je stle pomerne fajn. Take dfajme, e rok 2024 u bude lep rok. Vtedy rtate s tm, e inflcia bude vrazne niia. Preo? Ke odznie vplyv energi, mali by sme sa u vraca k jej benm hodnotm. Dfajme, e situcia na svetovch trhoch nebude alej eskalova. Bude ben spotrebite v najbliom obdob cti, ako ceny rast z mesiaca na mesiac mono a skokovo, alebo sa medzimesan inflcia zmierni? Skokov nrast pocti zaiatkom budceho roka, ke sa prestavia regulovan ceny. Medzimesan nrasty cien s momentlne vemi rozkvan. Na prelome roka sme mali nrast cien potravn o es percent, teraz v mji sme mali medzimesan inflciu celkovo 1,5 percenta, o je historicky najvy nrast cien v mji. Aj ke robme predikcie a dme si tam hodnoty, ktor by v historickom kontexte vyzerali ako uleten, tak ns situcia stle doke prekvapi. Nrast inflcie v alch mesiacoch ete bude, ale na prelome rokov by sa to malo zaa ota.

Title: The supply on the domestic market is disastrous, says Horvth from NBS. Therefore, they look for talents abroad. (Forbes interview)
text: The offer on the domestic market is catastrophic, says Horvath from the NBS. Therefore, they are looking for talents abroad. (Interview for Forbes) Aug 4, 2022 Peter Apolen When assembling its analytical team, the National Bank of Slovakia decided to turn to the international market. "At some point, foreign expertise is necessary," explains MICHAL HORVaTH, Director of the Department of Economic and Monetary Analysis. When you started as the head of the analysis department at the NBS two years ago, one of the Your ambition was to complete the analytical team. To what extent do you like it? Managed? Building the analytical team is part of broader changes at the NBS, as we strive to create a modern and open central bank that actively participates in the discussion on the domestic scene, but also at the level of the euro area. We have the ambition to bring a deeper view and build expertise in selected areas. We also needed to adapt the team to that goal and the content of his work. What exactly is it about? We needed to shift the emphasis of communication from a descriptive perception of what was happening to deeper analyses. At the same time, we had to build a unit from the ground up that deals with eurozone issues. For these new needs, we needed to find new colleagues to complement and strengthen the otherwise very experienced and high-quality existing core analytical staff. New colleagues are from different parts of the world. There are 30 people in the team in total. How many of them are from abroad? These are four analysts and analysts from Italy, Spain, Ukraine and Bangladesh. In addition, the head of research from Germany recently arrived. I am very glad that this is happening. This has changed the way the analytical team works, and it also affects the culture in the bank as a whole. What specific projects do your colleagues from abroad work on? For example, one colleague uses innovative methods to examine the extent to which our economy is hypothermic or whether it is overheating. This is important for our estimate of inflation, but also for assessing the health of public finances. The second colleague is involved in finding the origin of slow productivity growth based on data from individual companies. The new colleagues who arrived in the spring are working on a better understanding of how the political decisions in Frankfurt affect the financial conditions of people and companies in the Slovakia, their decisions, including developments in the real estate market. These are all important things for Slovakia and the knowledge gained can also be interesting internationally. You mentioned the new communication agenda of the national bank. What exactly is it about? We are making significant changes, for example, in our publications, both in terms of their number and language. We want to be more understandable to ordinary people. Therefore, we say fewer numbers and dry information, and we put emphasis on the story and consequences for life in Slovakia. We intend to continue in this. Although service is crucial for the domestic economy, we have larger gaps in the international context. Internationally, we need to build a stronger brand and that takes a longer time. However, we have given a signal that we are building an executive team that is expected to create a good reputation for the institution. How does the search for experts on the foreign market work? These are probably not classic job advertisements. The job market for economists is global and relatively well organized. If you want to go for quality, you have to take part in it. Experts are usually only available at one time of the year. It is when they finish their doctoral studies and look for new ones. Menus. The season culminates with an international conference in the USA, which takes place in winter. That's when interviews are conducted and new contracts are concluded. Outside of this period, the market Relatively dead. So does the job offer and demand meet at this conference? There are associations of economists that explicitly organize labor fairs. People from quality schools are available there. By the way, several colleagues from We found and hired Slovakia on the global market. Quality and well-founded economists who are looking for a job simply proceed in this way. On the other hand, even an institution that looks for employees in this way gains a stamp of quality. In retrospect, we met with a positive response for the fact that the NBS was present at this meeting. We have sent a signal that we are serious. How do you manage to incorporate people with a foreign knowledge background into Slovak conditions? I observe with interest how our foreign colleagues work on issues related to the specifics of the Slovak economy. They perceive them in an international dimension, so in a different context than us locals. We need this to a healthy extent. It is confirmed that it is useful to involve foreign expertise and thus move things forward. What motivates foreign experts to apply for a job at the NBS? We try to make their stay in our team beneficial. The absence of too much hierarchy in the NBS offers them the opportunity to do things that have a strong impact and that are visible on the outside. We offer them the chance to work within the structures of the Eurosystem. In other central banks would not have such opportunities so easily. With us, they get a chance to participate in projects that we publicly communicate or move forward within the European structures. We want them to have the opportunity to create something interesting, and when they move on, whether to another central bank or to an academic environment, they can boast about it in the CV. For me as a manager, it is a challenge to create such conditions. Do foreign economists need to go through the same administrative procedures as other workers from abroad? Yes, that's right. It depends a lot on where a person comes from. If it's from the EU, it's no problem. For example, if the employment agreement was reached in the middle of March, At the beginning of April, a person can start work. However, there are serious problems with countries outside the EU. The process is very lengthy and costly. In the end, the burden is always borne by the employer. We cannot expect the candidate to cover it all on his own. In the best case, the process takes six or seven months and the costs are in the order of in thousands of euros. Already when submitting an application to the Foreign Police, a person must have Slovakia, the address where he will live. So he must have rented something, even though the apartment remains empty for several months. Another example of bureaucracy is the requirement for the advertisement to hang on the notice board of the Labour Office for twenty days. These are highly professional positions that we have previously unsuccessfully filled for even a year. However, if we want to employ people from third countries, we need to to demonstrate to the local labour office in this way that there is no suitable candidate in Slovakia. How do you assess the Slovak labor market? Is it not able to offer the bank enough experts? From the employer's point of view, we have our specific needs. When we publish an ad through classic channels, the people who contact us are somewhere completely different in terms of knowledge than we would need. Once in a while, it happens to us that someone who is just returning from abroad notices the offer. In this way, we have gained several colleagues in the past, but we cannot rely on it. Thus, the need to go to the global market results from the fact that the supply on the domestic market is disastrous. We could also go the way of educating recent graduates, and we are doing that to a certain extent. They are mostly graduates of mathematical, not economic schools. We give them an economic dimension only in our country. However, many times we need ready-made people. However, you mentioned that you also found Slovaks on the foreign labor market. What is their profile? Since the beginning of my tenure, twelve people have joined the team, including foreigners. Only one new person did not study abroad. We have colleagues with PhD degrees from universities in the USA, Great Britain, Germany, Italy, the Czech Republic or Estonia. In the biographies, we can find high-quality European workshops of economic education such as the London School of Economics, Pompeu Fabra University, Nottingham, Bonn a podobne. You yourself studied and worked abroad. What is the view of a Slovak returning home? What is his motivation? There are several reasons and, of course, not only professional ones. From a work point of view, my current position is linked to various activities that I have done in the past. I co-founded the Council for Budget Responsibility, which is an example of building an independent public institution from the ground up. I also represented Slovakia in European structures. At universities, in addition to research in the field of monetary and budgetary policy, I really enjoyed working with young talents. These things came together in a vision that was presented to me by Governor Peter Kazimir and Deputy Governor udovit odor. What impresses you more when you're choosing a person? Formal education or real experience? I take a good education as the very foundation. That's the first filter. Then we will see, What interesting things the man was doing. Education is not so much about the name of the school, but rather about what program a person studied. Whether he will be able to fulfill what we expect from him. I think that the European quality of education can offer us interesting Tenderers. Unfortunately, we lack this in Slovakia. We hire people who have already created something. For example, two of our colleagues have worked on specific projects at the European Central Bank. We were interested in their topics because they are important for Slovakia. In other cases, we will be interested in their independent scientific activity. However, the same criteria apply to Slovaks whom we hire on foreign markets. It's a very similar story. Can Slovakia offer sufficiently attractive conditions to qualified people? I don't think this applies in general. Large companies, as well as startups operating in Slovakia, may be able to offer interesting projects and the possibility of self-realization to people with foreign experience. But it bothers me that there are fewer opportunities in public administration. So we are only talking about islands of positive development. Fortunately, the National Bank has a special position in this. However, changes can never be implemented without support from above. If we did not have the support of the management, we would not be able to go in this direction. There are many institutions in Slovakia that have similar potential. What about remuneration? Is it competitive? When we talk about analytical positions, people move here regardless of nationality in the international market. Remuneration must therefore be competitive. In the past, the bank benefited from the fact that many Slovaks returned home, for example, because of their family. However, we cannot rely on this in the long term. That's why we needed to go to the global market. Why do you think the domestic system does not produce enough quality experts? The problem is, for example, that our university system is very closed. There is little internationalization, universities are not exposed to serious competition, they also survive Despite the mass departure of young people to go to school abroad. Even in Slovakia, we have skilled scientists, but it is often true that they are successful in spite of the system, not because of the him. As a country, we should be able to offer people a vision of a good life and interesting job application. It would help us attract foreign workers strength, but also to keep the home team.
