(Rozhovor pre Forbes) 4. aug 2022 Peter Apolen Nrodn banka Slovenska sa pri zostavovan analytickho tmu rozhodla obrti na medzinrodn trh. V istom momente je zahranin expertza nevyhnutn, vysvetuje riadite odboru ekonomickch a menovch analz MICHAL HORVTH. Ke ste pred dvomi rokmi ako f odboru analz v NBS nastupovali, jednou z vaich ambci bolo dobudova analytick tm. Do akej miery sa vm to podarilo? Budovanie analytickho tmu je sasou irch zmien v NBS, ke sa sname tvori modern a otvoren centrlnu banku, ktor sa aktvne zapja do diskusie na domcej scne, no aj na rovni eurozny. Mme ambciu prina hlb pohad a budova expertzu vo vybranch oblastiach. Tomu cieu sme potrebovali prispsobi aj tm a obsah jeho prce. O o konkrtne ide? Potrebovali sme presun draz komunikcie z popisnho vnmania toho, o sa deje, smerom k hlbm analzam. Zrove sme museli od zkladov vybudova jednotku, ktor sa venuje otzkam eurozny. Pre tieto nov potreby sme potrebovali njs novch kolegov, aby tak doplnili a posilnili inak vemi sksen a kvalitn existujce jadro analytickho tbu. Nov kolegovia s z rznych ktov sveta. Dovedna je v tme 30 ud. Koko z nich je zo zahraniia? Ide o tyroch analytikov a analyticky z Talianska, panielska, Ukrajiny a Banglada. Nedvno navye priiel f vskumu z Nemecka. Som vemi rd, e sa to deje. Zmenil sa tm spsob, akm analytick tm pracuje, a vplva to aj na kultru v banke celkovo. Akm projektom konkrtne sa vai kolegovia zo zahraniia venuj? Jedna kolegya naprklad pomocou inovatvnych metd skma, do akej miery je naa ekonomika podchladen, alebo i sa prehrieva. Toto je dleit pre n odhad vvoja inflcie, ale aj pre posdenie zdravia verejnch financi. Druh kolegya sa podiea na hadan pvodu pomalho rastu produktivity na zklade dajov individulnych firiem. Nov kolegovia, ktor prili na jar, pracuj na lepom pochopen toho, ako menovo- politick rozhodnutia vo Frankfurte vplvaj na finann podmienky ud a firiem na Slovensku, na ich rozhodnutia, vrtane vvoja na trhu nehnutenost. Vetko s to pre Slovensko dleit veci a zskan poznatky mu by zaujmav aj medzinrodne. Spomnali ste nov komunikan agendu nrodnej banky. O o konkrtne ide? Robme vznamn zmeny naprklad v naich publikcich, tak z pohadu ich potu, ako aj jazyka. Chceme by zrozumitenej benm uom. Hovorme preto menej sel a suchch informci a draz kladieme na prbeh a dsledky pre ivot na Slovensku. V tomto mienime pokraova. Hoci je servis pre domcu ekonomiku kov, v-medzinrodnom kontexte mme vie medzery. Medzinrodne si potrebujeme budova silnejiu znaku a to trv dlhiu dobu. Dali sme vak signl, e budujeme vkonn tm, od ktorho sa oakva, e bude tvori dobr meno intitcie. Ako prebieha hadanie expertov na zahraninom trhu? Pravdepodobne nejde o klasick pracovn inzerty. Pracovn trh s ekonmami je globlny a pomerne dobre organizovan. Ke chce lovek s za kvalitou, mus sa ho zastni. Experti s dostupn spravidla len v jednom obdob roka. Je to vtedy, ke konia svoje doktorandsk tdium a obzeraj sa po novch ponukch. Sezna vrchol medzinrodnou konferenciou v USA, ktor sa kon v zime. Vtedy sa robia pohovory a uzatvraj nov zmluvy. Mimo tohto obdobia je na trhu pomerne mtvo. Na tejto konferencii sa teda stretva pracovn ponuka a dopyt? Existuj asocicie ekonmov, ktor organizuj vyslovene vetrhy s pracovnou silou. S na nich dostupn udia z kvalitnch kl. Mimochodom, aj viacerch kolegov zo Slovenska sme nali a najali na globlnom trhu. Kvalitn a fundovan ekonmovia, ktor si hadaj prcu, jednoducho postupuj takto. Na druhej strane aj intitcia, ktor si had zamestnancov tmto spsobom, zskava pun kvality. Sptne sme sa stretli s pozitvnou odozvou za to, e NBS bola na tomto hu prtomn. Vyslali sme signl, e to myslme vne. Ako sa vm dar zapracova ud so zahraninm vedomostnm backgroundom do slovenskch pomerov? So zujmom pozorujem, ako nai zahranin kolegovia pracuj na otzkach, ktor sa tkaj pecifk slovenskej ekonomiky. Vnmaj ich v medzinrodnej dimenzii, take v inch svislostiach ako my domci. Toto v zdravej miere potrebujeme. Potvrdzuje sa, e je uiton zapoji zahranin expertzu a posun tak veci dopredu. o motivuje zahraninch expertov, aby sa uchdzali o prcu v NBS? Sname sa, aby bol pobyt v naom tme pre nich prnosn. Absencia prlinej hierarchie v NBS im ponka monos robi veci, ktor maj siln dopad a ktor navonok vidno. Ponkame im ancu pracova v rmci truktr eurosystmu. V inch centrlnych bankch by sa k takmto prleitostiam tak jednoducho nedostali. U ns dostan ancu podiea sa na projektoch, ktor verejne komunikujeme i posvame alej v rmci eurpskych truktr. Chceme, aby mali monos vytvori nieo zaujmav, a ke sa posun alej, i u do inej centrlnej banky, alebo do akademickho prostredia, mohli sa tm pochvli v ivotopise. Pre ma ako manara je vzva takto podmienky vytvori. Potrebuj zahranin ekonmovia absolvova rovnak administratvne procedry ako in pracovnci z cudziny? no, je to tak. Vemi zle na tom, odkia lovek pochdza. Ak z EU, nie je to iadny problm. Naprklad ak dohoda o pracovnom pomere padla uprostred marca, u zaiatkom aprla me lovek nastpi do prce. Vne problmy s vak pri krajinch mimo EU. Proces je vemi zdhav a finanne nkladn. Bremeno vdy napokon zna zamestnvate. Nememe oakva, e si to kandidt vykryje cel sm. V najlepom prpade trv proces es i sedem mesiacov a nklady s rdovo v tiscoch eur. U pri podvan iadosti na cudzineckej polcii mus ma lovek na Slovensku adresu, kde bude bva. Mus ma teda nieo prenajat, hoci byt zostva ete niekoko mesiacov przdny. alm prkladom byrokracie je poiadavka, aby inzert visel dvadsa dn na nstenke radu prce. Ide pritom o vysoko odborn pozcie, ktor predtm nespene obsadzujeme hoci aj rok. Ak vak chceme zamestna ud z tretch krajn, musme na miestnom rade prce tmto spsobom demontrova, e na Slovensku nie je vhodn kandidt. Ako hodnotte slovensk pracovn trh? Nedoke banke ponknu dostatok odbornkov? Z pohadu zamestnvatea mme svoje pecifick potreby. Ke zverejnme inzert cez klasick kanly, udia, ktor sa nm ozv, s vedomostne niekde plne inde, ako by sme potrebovali. Raz za as sa nm stane, e si ponuku vimne niekto, kto sa prve vracia zo zahraniia. Takto sme v minulosti zskali niekokch kolegov, no nememe sa na to spolieha. Potreba s na globlny trh teda vyplva z toho, e ponuka na domcom trhu je katastroflna. Mohli by sme s aj cestou vchovy erstvch absolventov a aj to do istej miery robme. S to vinou absolventi matematickch, nie ekonomickch kl. Ekonomick rozmer im dvame a u ns. Veakrt vak potrebujeme hotovch ud. Spomnali ste vak, e ste na zahraninom pracovnom trhu nali aj Slovkov. Ak maj profil? Od zaiatku mjho psobenia prilo do tmu dvans ud vrtane cudzincov. Len jeden nov lovek netudoval v zahrani. Mme tak kolegov s PhD titulom z univerzt v USA, Vekej Britnii, Nemecku, Taliansku, eskej republike alebo Estnsku. V ivotopisoch njdeme kvalitn eurpske dielne ekonomickho vzdelania ako London School of Economics, Universitat Pompeu Fabra, Nottingham, Bonn a podobne. Vy sm ste tudovali a psobili v zahrani. Ak je pohad Slovka, ktor sa vracia domov? Ak m motivciu? Je to viac dvodov a, samozrejme, nielen profesionlnych. Z pracovnho hadiska moja sasn pozcia nadvzuje na rzne aktivity, ktor som robil v minulosti. Spoluzakladal som Radu pre rozpotov zodpovednos, o je prklad budovania nezvislej verejnej intitcie plne od zkladov. Zastupoval som tie Slovensko v eurpskych truktrach. Na univerzitch ma okrem vskumu v oblasti menovej a rozpotovej politiky vemi bavila prca s mladmi talentmi. Tieto veci sa pospjali do vzie, ktor mi predostreli guvernr Peter Kazimr a viceguvernr udovt dor. o na vs urob v dojem, ke si vyberte loveka? Formlne vzdelanie i relna sksenos? Dobr vzdelanie beriem ako pln zklad. To je prv filter. Potom sa pozrieme, o zaujmav ten lovek robil. Pri vzdelan nejde ani tak o cveng mena koly, ale skr o to, ak program lovek tudoval. i bude vedie splni to, o od neho oakvame. Myslm si, e eurpska kvalita vzdelania nm doke ponknu zaujmavch uchdzaov. To nm, ia, na Slovensku chba. Najmame ud, ktor u nieo vytvorili. Dvaja nai kolegovia naprklad pracovali na konkrtnych projektoch v Eurpskej centrlnej banke. Ich tmy ns zaujali, pretoe s pre Slovensko dleit. V inch prpadoch ns oslov ich samostatn vedeck innos. Rovnak kritri vak platia aj pre Slovkov, ktorch na zahraninch trhoch najmame. Je to vemi podobn prbeh. Doke Slovensko ponknu kvalifikovanm uom dostatone atraktvne podmienky? Nemyslm si, e to plat veobecne. Vek firmy, ale aj startupy psobiace na Slovensku mono vedia ponknu zaujmav projekty a monos sebarealizcie aj uom so zahraninmi sksenosami. No trpi ma, e vo verejnej sprve je tch prleitost menej. Hovorme tu teda len o ostrovekoch pozitvneho vvoja. Nrodn banka m v tom, naastie, osobitn postavenie. Zmeny sa vak nikdy nedaj realizova bez podpory zhora. Ak by sme nemali podporu vedenia, nemohli by sme sa vyda tmto smerom. Na Slovensku je pritom vea intitci, ktor maj podobn potencil. Ako je to s odmeovanm? Je konkurencieschopn? Ke hovorme o analytickch pozcich, udia sa tu pohybuj bez ohadu na nrodnos na medzinrodnom trhu. Odmeovanie teda mus by konkurencieschopn. V minulosti banka profitovala z toho, e sa mnoh Slovci vracali domov naprklad kvli rodine. Na to sa vak nememe dlhodobo spolieha. Preto sme potrebovali s na globlny trh. Preo poda vs domci systm neprodukuje dostatok kvalitnch expertov? Problm je naprklad v tom, e n univerzitn systm je vemi uzavret. Je tu mal internacionalizcia, univerzity nie s vystaven seriznej konkurencii, prevaj aj napriek hromadnmu odchodu mladch ud na koly do zahraniia. Aj na Slovensku mme ikovnch vedcov, no asto plat, e s spen napriek systmu, nie vaka nemu. Mali by sme by ako krajina schopn ponknu uom vziu dobrho ivota a zaujmavho pracovnho uplatnenia. Pomohlo by nm to lka zahranin pracovn silu, no aj udra t domcu.

Title: Slovakia is one of the countries with higher inflation, but people have barely felt the increase in energy prices so far. (hl. economist M. Horvth, Dennk N)
text: Slovakia is one of the countries with higher inflation, but people have barely felt the increase in energy prices so far. (chief economist M. Horvath, Dennik N) Oct 21, 2022 Inflation in Slovakia exceeded 14 percent in September, and eight countries in the European Union, such as the Czech Republic, Hungary, and the Netherlands, had higher price growth than Slovakia. They grew rapidly, especially food prices, next year inflation will be pushed up by energy prices. Michal Horvath, chief economist at the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS), says that the difference between countries is in the share of energy in the consumer basket, and the way in which their prices are regulated also plays an important role. In other countries, the transfer of energy price increases to household bills is much faster, and this is already happening to a large extent there. In Slovakia, we will feel it by leaps and bounds in January 2023. In its baseline scenario, the NBS estimates that average inflation will reach 18 percent next year. It was based on the fact that gas, electricity, heat for households would go up by about 100 percent. Horvath says that among other analysts, The consensus is that they will rise by 50 percent, so inflation would reach 13 percent. What is it really like will, to a large extent, depend on the amount and form of compensation for expensive energy. "Personally, I quite like the German model, where people have a certain level of consumption at a price artificially set by the government, and everything beyond that depends on the development of world markets." In the interview, he continues:  During the recovery from the pandemic, the number of self-employed persons and income per self-employed person grew.  Markets expect the European Central Bank's key rate to climb to three percent by the middle of next year.  Mortgage interest rates have gone up, but the competition in this area continues.  So far, we do not see signs of such a slump in the real estate market as can be seen, for example in the Netherlands, where prices are already falling. When we talked to each other before the summer, you estimated that food would be the topic in the fall, because they would continue to rise rapidly in price. So September inflation Actually, it wasn't even surprising? A little bit yes, although the structure of inflation in recent months is no surprise. We expected it to be maybe some tenths lower, but this is precisely because food prices are rising rapidly and energy prices are spilling over faster and more intensively into a wider range of goods and services. As a result, inflation is a bit ahead of the curve expected developments. In our last forecast, we looked at why we In the past, it happened that the numbers were significantly different than we expected. In the prices of goods and services, we see an unprecedented development in the historical context and we have already included this in our forecasts, and therefore the surprises are smaller. I very much hope that one day we will talk about the fact that we are starting to adjust our forecasts downwards. When you talk about higher prices of goods and services, do you mean building materials, electronics, prices in restaurants? What exactly? Goods and services in the broadest sense of the word. Historically, for example, we have seen that the development of prices of services largely copied the development of wages in a given segment, but since the beginning of the year we have observed that it is detached from wage development. Obviously, the prices of energy, rents, but also higher prices of goods inputs are already significantly influencing the development of prices and services. In your recent forecast, you said that the upward pressure on prices comes from the self-employed sector. What did you mean? During the recovery from the pandemic, we have seen that the number of self-employed people is also growing, but also income per self-employed person. Apparently, many jobs that were in the past a form of permanent employment are in the form of trades in the new post-pandemic era. This leads to the fact that their income is perhaps higher than in the past. But we also see it abroad, something similar is happening in the Czech Republic, but also in America. People who act In gastronomy, restaurants, i.e. from the point of view of the pandemic in high-risk sectors, they began to ask for a "risk premium" for the fact that they can lose their jobs at any time and help will not necessarily be in place. So, according to your analyses, profit margins remained constant in companies, but margins were increased by sole traders, which created additional pressure on inflation? When it comes to companies, we looked at a sample of 10 thousand companies, and there are certainly cases where companies benefit from the development after the pandemic and since the beginning of the war. In the case of self-employed people, we do not have such detailed data, but to some extent I would understand higher incomes as a risk margin for operating in a more uncertain world after the pandemic from their point of view. What do company managers tell you about energy? We talked to them last autumn and this spring, and they are increasing prices because their costs are rising. It's not that they're expanding margins. People from the service sector have warned us that input prices there are rising quite significantly beyond wage costs, and even if they do nothing else but reflect the normal margin in prices, the result is the inflationary development we are seeing. Do you already see companies hindering investments in Slovakia? For several years now, we have seen that investments always surprise us negatively and we expect that this could turn around. Companies have been complaining for a long time that investments often do not come to the Slovakia precisely because they cannot justify to parent companies, investors or themselves where they can find people who would take the idea further. It is also about state aid. Companies tell us that other countries are much more systematic and support the transition to greener technologies, for example, faster. Now a big outcry has been heard from the corporate sector, because the German government has announced help to local companies and our companies operate in a competitive environment. It was unfair of the German government And it was expected that it would be better to have a European solution. But it was also a good illustration of the fact that in many key areas, aid from other countries is often more accessible and faster. The topic now is mainly energy prices. The European Commission is proposing price caps for gas and the government is also preparing compensation for expensive energy. Does this change your inflation estimate in any way? Yes and no. We have known for a long time that some measures will probably be taken, but we have no idea what they are. In the main scenario of our autumn forecast, we tried to include all the information known at the time, statements, publicly communicated commitments from the previous management Ministry of Economy. But on the day we published the forecast, we learned that there would be other measures in the end. What was your prediction based on? We counted on gas, electricity, heat for households to go up by about 100 percent, and the result was our estimate of 18 percent inflation for next year. But this is conditional on the adjustment of regulated prices. We know that if the existing formulas were followed and the government did nothing, electricity would increase by 400 percent and gas and heat by 200 percent. The result would be inflation somewhere around 35 percent. But we also know that it won't be like this, we just have no idea how it will be in the end. A consensus has been formed among other analysts that it will be around 50 percent, and the Prime Minister also mentioned something like this in connection with electricity prices. What would inflation be like then? If energy prices for households were to rise by 50 percent, we would be at an inflation level of around 13 percent. Unfortunately, even today, when we talk, the situation is the same as two years ago months and we don't know how they will eventually increase. This has a major impact on what the purchasing power of the population, how consumption in the economy will develop. Now, of course, we know that there will be a compensation package in the amount of 3.5 percent of GDP, but we do not know to whom and how it will be financed, whether there will be extraordinary taxes. We suspect that something will be used from the structural funds, maybe something will go to the debt, but we don't know that either. By the way, the fact that part of the aid will also be financed from EU funds is a very sad admission that we cannot use EU funds for their original purpose. For example, the government mentions that unspent EU funds will be used for energy checks for households. What do you think the government's help should look like? We have been repeating for a long time that the measures are to be temporary and targeted. The solution will probably be a combination of direct support to citizens, but also price adjustments. It is probably not politically feasible and perhaps not even economically correct for household bills to be adjusted exactly according to the formula we have, i.e. they would rise sharply, it would only compensate them. It is important that The measures continued to maintain the incentive to save energy. Personally, I quite like the German model, where people have a certain level of consumption at a price artificially set by the government, and everything beyond that depends on the development of world markets. We should come to something like this in Slovakia, perhaps even in the case of companies and households. But we are not part of these discussions. In Slovakia, We encounter the fact that in order to design aid well, we need good data and administration. The past is catching up with us that we have not sufficiently built the state's capacities in this area. How much the European agreement on energy prices can influence decision-making European Central Bank (ECB), how much will it raise interest rates next week? The ECB is interested in the development of energy prices to the extent that it is then transmitted to a wider range of goods and services over a longer period of time, as well as to wage requirements, let's say over a two-year horizon, and how it changes the behaviour of companies. So what is important is what these adjustments mean for the inflation outlook in the euro area. Is the ECB now mainly worried about the development of prices of goods and services? It can be seen that inflation is affecting an increasingly wide range of goods and services. The concern is that core inflation, which is adjusted for the impact of administered prices, will not remain at higher levels for a long time. Of course, everyone is aware that there are still many temporary elements, including post-pandemic ones, and expensive ones are also reflected in the prices of goods and services Energy. At the end of October, the ECB will decide on further rate hikes. The prevailing opinion on the market is that the base interest rate will increase again by 0.75 percentage points to 2 percent. What do you think about it? In principle, the markets have a 0.75 percentage point increase in the base rate included in their prices. According to market rates, we can say that the markets expect the ECB's base rate to climb somewhere around 3 percent by the middle of next year Year. This should ensure that inflation returns to two percent. It must be said that long-term expectations in the euro area are still close to two percent. In the eyes of the markets, the ECB still has the credibility to achieve the inflation target by raising rates and other forms of monetary policy tightening. Is the rise in mortgage interest rates in line with the rise in ECB interest rates? This would also deserve a deeper analysis. Interest rates have gone up, of course, but the competition in this area continues. But the cost of financing is also rising for banks, so mortgage interest rates have risen. This will also affect the situation of households next year depending on how much they have left for consumption. How is the ECB now helping governments with increasingly expensive loans? The portfolio of government bonds that the ECB has purchased is still being reinvested and is maintaining it at the level it has achieved. When some bonds are currently due, he buys new ones instead. There is already a discussion about ending the reinvestments, and whether the bank will also start actively reducing its portfolio. There are differences in the level of inflation between EU countries. In September, 8 countries had higher inflation than Slovakia, in addition to the Baltic countries, the Czech Republic, Hungary, Poland, Bulgaria and the Netherlands. What do this group of countries have in common? One thing is the share of energy in the consumer basket, which is quite different in different countries. The regulatory framework plays an important role. Although Slovakia is one of the countries with higher inflation, the population has barely felt the increase in energy prices so far, while in others countries, the transmission of higher prices is much faster. In the Czech Republic, the part of the energy price that is derived from the raw material itself is updated every month. Can we have higher inflation next year than they have in the Czech Republic? Naturally. The regulatory framework in our country is set in such a way that prices react with the annual delays, which is quite rare in the EU. In other countries, the transmission of energy prices is much faster and it is already happening to a large extent there. In Slovakia, we will feel it by leaps and bounds in January and will affect prices for households until the end of next year. The question of whether it is well set up would deserve a society-wide discussion. What energy is produced from also plays an important role. They also have nuclear weapons elsewhere power plants and the price of electricity on the local market agreed in long-term contracts is still cheaper there than elsewhere where it is purchased internationally. Inflation in post-communist countries is generally higher than elsewhere in the euro area. Why is that? In Eastern European countries, we see that the pass-through of imported inflation to consumer prices are significantly stronger than elsewhere, so we also have high core inflation. If we take net inflation, i.e. excluding energy, food and fuel, we also have inflation somewhere around 10 to 11 percent. Although in other countries they are also afraid that a similar increase could occur with some delay. In eastern countries, this is also to some extent related to the extraordinary tension on the labor market. But companies in our country probably have less room to cope with cost pressures without increasing prices. Any reserves after the pandemic must have been very low. When will inflation peak in Slovakia? There will probably be a jump at the beginning of next year, when regulated prices are adjusted. There it should peak somewhere and then gradually decrease. There will probably not be a steep descent, as we hoped maybe half a year ago. So next year, inflation will be driven mainly by expensive energy or other Goods and services?  next year, it is clearly energy. It is also necessary to realize that we have Secondary pressures from energy prices on the part of producers and goods and services that come to us coming from abroad, will also put pressure on inflation and will fade away relatively slowly. How will high price growth affect the real estate market? I would characterize the current development on the real estate market as a slowdown, which was to some extent to be expected. So far, we have not registered signs of such a slump as can be seen for example, in the Netherlands, where the market has clearly turned around after a very dynamic two years and prices are falling there. What happened differently in the Netherlands than in our country?  In the Netherlands, there was much more talk about overvaluation than in Slovakia and other countries. Countries. In Slovakia, we also have a problem with the supply of real estate, it is growing slowly and has a long-term impact on the market situation. You were the first member of the Budget Council. In the draft budget for next year, there is a 3.4 billion reserve for compensation of expensive energy, which sharply increases the budget deficit. Is it okay that the deficit should exceed eight billion euros next year, or 6.4 percent of GDP? What bothers me more is that I have no idea what will happen next. There is no plan to long-term consolidation of public finances. An important pillar was supposed to be spending limits, which were no longer put into practice. In addition, there are no European rules for the next period. Everyone suspects that they will be turned on, but no one knows in what form. This is a problem for the entire eurozone. This opacity and the long-term unanchoredness of public finances must be added to other risks to inflationary developments. In the face of such a crisis, I think it is normal for the government and the public sector to intervene in the form of support for various groups that may be hurt by this situation. From a principled point of view, this is fine. Even in the case of covid, we saw that large amounts were allocated and the actual drawdown was ultimately significantly lower also due to the capacity of the state. We take it as a shot amount. As an economist, are you worried about the risk that there will be a provisional budget next year? As an economist, it bothers me. This is a period when it will be necessary to help the economy, people, companies. If we go by this year's budget, a lot of funds In real terms, it will be low. There would be a risk that the government would behave pro-cyclically, throttle at a time when it should rather help. text_original: Slovensko patr medzi krajiny s vyou inflciou, ale udia nrast cien energi doteraz ledva poctili. (hl. ekonm M. Horvth,Dennk N) 21. okt 2022 Inflcia na Slovensku previla v septembri u 14 percent, vy rast cien ako Slovensko malo v Eurpskej nii osem krajn, naprklad esk republika, Maarsko, ale aj Holandsko. Rchlo rstli najm ceny potravn, v budcom roku bud inflciu tlai nahor ceny energi. Hlavn ekonm Nrodnej banky Slovenska (NBS) Michal Horvth vrav, e rozdiel medzi krajinami je v podiele energi na spotrebnom koi, dleit lohu zohrva aj spsob, akm sa reguluj ich ceny. V inch krajinch je prenos zdraovania energi do tov domcnost ovea rchlej a u sa to tam do vekej miery deje. Na Slovensku to skokovo poctime v januri 2023. NBS vo svojom zkladnom scenri odhaduje, e priemern inflcia v budcom roku dosiahne 18 percent. Vychdzala z toho, e plyn, elektrina, teplo pre domcnosti pjdu hore o pribline 100 percent. Horvth hovor, e medzi inmi analytikmi sa vytvoril konsenzus, e stpnu o 50 percent, inflcia by tak dosiahla 13 percent. Ak naozaj bude, do vekej miery zvis od vky a formy kompenzci drahch energi. Mne osobne sa celkom pozdva nemeck model, kde maj udia ist mieru spotreby za cenu umelo stanovenou vldou a vetko nad to zvis od vvoja na svetovch trhoch. V rozhovore alej vrav:  Poas zotavenia po pandmii rstol poet ivnostnkov aj prjem na jednho ivnostnka.  Trhy oakvaj, e sa zkladn sadzba Eurpskej centrlnej banky vyplh k trom percentm do polovice budceho roka.  roky na hypotky ili hore, ale konkurenn boj v tejto oblasti naalej trv.  Zatia na realitnom trhu nevidme znmky takho prepadu, ak vidno naprklad v Holandsku, kde u ceny padaj. Ke sme sa spolu rozprvali pred letom, odhadovali ste, e na jese bud tmou potraviny, lebo bud alej rchlo zdraova. Take septembrov inflcia vs vlastne ani neprekvapila? Trochu no, aj ke truktra inflcie v poslednch mesiacoch nie je iadnym prekvapenm. akali sme, e to bude mono o nejak desatinky niie, aleje to prve tm, e ceny potravn rast rchlo a ceny energi sa rchlejie a intenzvnejie prelievaj do irieho okruhu tovarov a sluieb. Vsledkom je, e inflcia trochu predbieha oakvan vvoj. V naej poslednej predpovedi sme sa pozreli na to, preo sa nm v minulosti stvalo, e sla boli podstatne in, ako sme akali. V cench tovarov a sluieb vidme v historickom kontexte nevdan vvoj a to sme u zahrnuli do naich predpoved, a preto aj prekvapenia s menie. Vemi dfam, e raz budeme hovori o tom, e zaname upravova nae predpovede smerom dole. Ke hovorte o vych cench tovarov a sluieb, mte na mysli stavebn materily, elektroniku, ceny v retaurcich? o presne? Tovary a sluby v najirom slova zmysle. Historicky sme naprklad videli, e vvoj cien sluieb do vekej miery koproval vvoj miezd v danom segmente, no od zaiatku roka sledujeme, e je odtrhnut od mzdovho vvoja. Zjavne ceny energi, njmov, ale aj vyie ceny tovarovch vstupov u vrazne ovplyvuj vvoj cien a sluieb. V nedvnej prognze ste uviedli, e tlak na rast cien prichdza zo sektora ivnostnkov. Ako ste to mysleli? Poas zotavenia po pandmii sme evidovali, e rastie aj poet ivnostnkov, ale aj prjem na jednho ivnostnka. Zrejme vea pracovnch miest, ktor v minulosti boli formou stleho zamestnania, je v novej postpandemickej re formou ivnost. To vedie k tomu, e ich prjmy s mono vyie ako v minulosti. Ale vidme to aj v zahrani, nieo podobn sa deje v eskej republike, ale aj v Amerike. udia, ktor psobia v gastre, retaurcich, ie z pohadu pandmie v rizikovch sektoroch, si zaali pta rizikov prirku za to, e mu kedykovek prs o prcu a pomoc nie nutne bude na mieste. Take poda vaich analz ziskov prirky zostali kontantn vo firmch, ale mare zvyovali ivnostnci, z oho vznikol al tlak na inflciu? Pokia ide o firmy, pozerali sme sa na vzorku 10-tisc firiem a iste sa njdu prpady, ke firmy benefituj z vvoja po pandmii a od zaiatku vojny. V prpade ivnostnkov tak podrobn daje nemme, ale do istej miery by som vie prjmy chpal ako rizikov maru za to, e z ich pohadu funguj v neistejom svete po pandmii. o vm hovoria manari firiem o energich? Hovorili sme s nimi vlani na jese aj tto jar a ceny zvyuj, lebo im rast nklady. Nejde o to, e roziruj mare. udia z oblasti sluieb ns upozornili, e ceny vstupov tam nad rmec mzdovch nkladov rast dos vrazne, a aj ke ni in nespravia, len do cien premietnu ben maru, vsledok je inflan vvoj, ktor vidme. Vidte u, e by firmy brzdili na Slovensku investcie? U niekoko rokov vidme, e investcie ns vdy negatvne prekvapia a akme, e by sa to mohlo obrti. Firmy sa dlhodobo sauj, e investcie asto neprichdzaj na Slovensko prve preto, e nevedia materskm spolonostiam, investorom alebo sami sebe odvodni, kde njdu ud, ktor by mylienku potiahli alej. Je to aj o pomoci ttu. Firmy nm hovoria, e in krajiny ovea systematickejie a rchlejie podporuj naprklad prechod na zelenie technolgie. Teraz bol pou vek vkrik z firemnho sektora, pretoe nemeck vlda ohlsila tamojm podnikom pomoc a nae firmy funguj v konkurennom prostred. Bolo to nefr od nemeckej vldy a akalo sa, e by bolo lepie ma eurpske rieenie. No bola to aj dobr ilustrcia toho, e v mnohch kovch oblastiach je pomoc inch ttov asto dostupnejia a rchlejia. Tmou s teraz najm ceny energi. Eurpska komisia navrhuje cenov stropy pre plyn a kompenzcie drahch energi pripravuje aj vlda. Men to nejako v odhad inflcie? Aj no, aj nie. U dlhie vieme, e sa zrejme prijm nejak opatrenia, ale netume ak. Do hlavnho scenra naej jesennej prognzy sme sa snaili zahrn vetky vtedy znme informcie, vroky, verejne komunikovan zvzky od predolho vedenia ministerstva hospodrstva. Ale v de, ke sme zverejnili prognzu, sme sa dozvedeli, e nakoniec bud in opatrenia. Z oho vychdzala vaa predpove? Rtali sme s tm, e plyn, elektrina, teplo pre domcnosti pjdu hore o pribline 100 percent a vsledkom toho bol n odhad 18-percentnej inflcie na budci rok. Ale to je podmienen pravou regulovanch cien. Vieme, e keby sa ilo poda existujcich vzorcov a vlda by ni nespravila, tak by elektrina narstla o 400 percent a plyn a teplo o 200 percent. Vsledkom by bola inflcia niekde okolo 35 percent. Ale vieme aj, e takto to nebude, len netume, ako to nakoniec bude. Medzi inmi analytikmi sa vytvoril konsenzus, e to bude okolo 50 percent a tak nieo spomenul aj premir v svislosti s cenami elektriny. Ak by bola potom inflcia? Keby ceny energi pre domcnosti stpli o 50 percent, sme na rovni inflcie okolo 13 percent. Bohuia, aj dnes, ke sa rozprvame, je situcia rovnak ako pred dvomi mesiacmi a nevieme, ako sa nakoniec zvia. To m zsadn vplyv na to, ak bude kpna sila obyvatestva, ako sa bude vyvja spotreba v ekonomike. Teraz u, samozrejme, vieme, e bude balek na kompenzcie vo vke 3,5 percenta HDP, len nevieme, komu a ako sa to bude financova, i bud aj mimoriadne dane. Tume, e sa nieo pouije zo trukturlnych fondov, mono nieo pjde aj na dlh, ale to takisto nevieme. Mimochodom, to, e sa bude as pomoci financova aj z fondov E, je vemi smutn priznanie, e nevieme vyerpa eurofondy na ich pvodn el. Vlda naprklad spomna, e sa nevyerpan eurofondy pouij na energoeky pre domcnosti. Ako by mala pomoc vldy poda vs vyzera? U dlhie opakujeme, e opatrenia maj by doasn a cielen. Rieenm zrejme bude kombincia priamej podpory obanom, ale aj prava cien. Asi nie je politicky priechodn a mono ani ekonomicky sprvne, aby sa ty domcnost upravili presne poda vzorca, ktor mme, ie by prudko stpli, len by sa im to kompenzovalo. Je dleit, aby opatrenia naalej zachovvali motivciu etri energiu. Mne osobne sa celkom pozdva nemeck model, kde maj udia ist mieru spotreby za cenu umelo stanoven vldou a vetko nad to zvis od vvoja na svetovch trhoch. K takmu nieomu by sme mali dospie aj na Slovensku, mono aj v prpade firiem aj domcnost. Ale nie sme sasou tchto diskusi. Na Slovensku sa opakovane stretvame s tm, e na to, aby sme dobre dizajnovali pomoc, potrebujeme dobr daje a administratvu. Dobieha ns minulos, e sme kapacity ttu v tejto oblasti nebudovali dostatone. Ako vemi me eurpska dohoda o cench energi ovplyvni rozhodovanie Eurpskej centrlnej banky (ECB), o koko zvi budci tde rokov sadzby? Vvoj cien energi zaujma ECB do tej miery, do akej sa to potom prena do irieho okruhu tovarov a sluieb v dlhom asovom horizonte, takisto do mzdovch poiadaviek povedzme v dvojronom horizonte, a ako to men sprvanie firiem. ie dleit je, o tieto pravy znamenaj pre vhad inflcie v eurozne. Obva sa ECB teraz najm vvoja cien tovarov a sluieb? Je vidno, e inflan vvoj zasahuje oraz ir okruh tovarov a sluieb. Obava je, aby jadrov inflcia, ktor je oisten o vplyv regulovanch cien, nezostala dlhodobo na vych rovniach. Samozrejme, kad si uvedomuje, e je tam stle vea doasnch prvkov, aj postpandemickch, a do cien tovarov a sluieb sa premietaj aj drah energie. Koncom oktbra ECB rozhodne o alom zvyovan sadzieb. Na trhu prevauje nzor, e sa zkladn rok op zvi o 0,75 percentulneho bodu na 2 percent. o si o tom myslte? Trhy maj v cench v zsade zahrnut zvenie zkladnej sadzby o 0,75 percentulneho bodu. Poda vvoja trhovch sadzieb vieme poveda, e trhy oakvaj, e sa zkladn sadzba ECB vyplh niekde k rovni 3 percent do polovice budceho roka. To by malo zabezpei, e sa inflcia vrti k dvom percentm. Treba poveda, e dlhodob oakvania v eurozne s naalej blzko dvoch percent. V oiach trhov m ECB stle kredibilitu, e zvyovanm sadzieb a inou formou uahovania menovej politiky doke dosiahnu inflan cie. Je rast rokov na hypotky v slade s tm, ako rast roky ECB? To by si takisto zaslilo hlbiu analzu. roky ili, samozrejme, hore, ale konkurenn boj v tejto oblasti naalej trv. Ale aj bankm rast nklady na financovanie, take roky na hypotky stpli. Aj to bude ovplyvova v budcom roku situciu domcnost v zvislosti od toho, koko im zostane na spotrebu. Ako ECB pomha teraz vldam s oraz drahmi pikami? Stle prebiehaj reinvestcie portflia vldnych dlhopisov, ktor ECB nakpila, a udruje ho vo vke, ktor dosiahlo. Ke s niektor dlhopisy momentlne splatn, namiesto nich nakupuje nov. U sa diskutuje o tom, e sa reinvestcie ukonia, a i banka zane aj aktvne zniova svoje portflio. Medzi krajinami E s vo vke inflcie rozdiely. Vyiu inflciu ako Slovensko malo v septembri 8 krajn, okrem pobaltskch krajn aj esko, Maarsko, Posko, Bulharsko a Holandsko. o m tto skupina krajn spolon? Jedna vec je podiel energi na spotrebnom koi, ten je v rznych krajinch dos odlin. Dleit lohu zohrva regulan rmec. Slovensko sce patr medzi krajiny s vyou inflciou, ale obyvatestvo nrast cien energi doteraz ledva poctilo, km v inch krajinch je prenos vych cien ovea rchlej. V echch sa t as ceny energi, ktor je odvoden od samotnej suroviny, aktualizuje kad mesiac. Meme ma pre to v budcom roku vyiu inflciu, ako maj v eskej republike? Samozrejme. Regulan rmec je u ns nastaven tak, e ceny reaguj s ronm oneskorenm, o je v E dos zriedkav. V ostatnch krajinch je prenos cien energi o dos rchlej a u sa to tam do vekej miery deje. Na Slovensku to skokovo poctime v januri a bude to ovplyvova ceny pre domcnosti do konca budceho roku. Otzka, i je to dobre nastaven, by si zaslila celospoloensk diskusiu. Dleit lohu zohrva aj to, z oho sa energia produkuje. Aj inde maj jadrov elektrrne a cena elektriny na loklnom trhu dohodnut v dlhodobch kontraktoch je tam predsa len lacnejia ako inde, kde sa nakupuje medzinrodne. Inflcia v postkomunistickch krajinch je vo veobecnosti vyia ako inde v eurozne. Preo je to tak? Vo vchodoeurpskych krajinch vidme, e prenos dovezenej inflcie do spotrebiteskch cien je podstatne silnej ako inde, take mme vysok aj jadrov inflciu. Ke si zoberieme ist inflciu, teda bez energi, potravn a pohonnch ltok, mme inflciu tie niekde okolo 10 a 11 percent. Aj ke aj v inch krajinch sa obvaj, e by k podobnmu nrastu mohlo djs s nejakm oneskorenm. Vo vchodnch krajinch to do istej miery svis aj s mimoriadnym pnutm na trhu prce. Ale zrejme maj firmy u ns men priestor na to, aby sa vyrovnali s nkladovmi tlakmi bez zvyovania cien. Akkovek rezervy po pandmii museli by vemi nzke. Kedy bude inflcia na Slovensku vrcholi? Zrejme zaiatkom budceho roka bude skok, ke sa upravia regulovan ceny. Tam by to malo niekde vrcholi a nsledne by mala pozvone klesa. Strm klesanie, ako sme sa ndejali mono ete pred pol rokom, zrejme nebude. Take v budcom roku bud aha inflciu najm drah energie alebo aj in tovary a sluby? V budcom roku s to jednoznane energie. Treba si aj uvedomi, e mme sekundrne tlaky z cien energi na strane vrobcov a tovary a sluby, ktor k nm prichdzaj zo zahraniia, bud takisto tlai na inflciu a bud odznieva pomerne pomaly. Ako vysok rast cien ovplyvn realitn trh? Aktulny vvoj na realitnom trhu by som charakterizoval ako spomaovanie, o sa do istej miery dalo aj aka. Zatia neevidujeme znmky takho prepadu, ak vidno naprklad v Holandsku, kde sa trh po vemi dynamickch dvoch rokoch zjavne otoil a ceny tam padaj. o sa v Holandsku dialo inak ako u ns? V Holandsku sa ovea viac hovorilo o nadhodnoten ako na Slovensku a v inch krajinch. Na Slovensku mme problm aj s ponukou nehnutenost, rastie pomaly a dlhodobo ovplyvuje situciu na trhu. Boli ste prvm lenom rozpotovej rady. V nvrhu rozpotu na budci rok je 3,4- miliardov rezerva na kompenzcie drahch energi, o prudko zvyuje rozpotov deficit. Je v poriadku, e deficit by mal v budcom roku previ osem milird eur, resp. 6,4 percenta HDP? Skr ma trpi to, e vbec netum, o bude potom. Absentuje akkovek pln na dlhodob konsolidciu verejnch financi. Dleitm pilierom mali by vdavkov limity, ktor sa prestali zavdza do praxe. Naviac nie s ani eurpske pravidl pre alie obdobie. Kad tu, e bud zapnut, ale nikto nevie, v akej forme. Je to problm pre cel euroznu. Tto neprehadnos a dlhodob neukotvenos verejnch financi treba prirta k alm rizikm inflanho vvoja. eliac takejto krze je poda ma normlne, e vlda, verejn sektor vstupuje do diania formou podpory pre rzne skupiny, ktor me tto situcia zrani. Z principilneho pohadu je to v poriadku. Aj v prpade covidu sme videli, e boli alokovan vek sumy a skuton erpanie bolo napokon podstatne niie aj z dvodu kapacity ttu. Berieme to ako nastrelen sumu. Ako ekonm sa obvate rizika, e v budcom roku bude rozpotov provizrium? Ako ekonma ma to trpi. Ide o obdobie, ke bude potrebn pomc ekonomike, uom, firmm. Ke pjdeme poda tohtoronho rozpotu, mnostvo prostriedkov v relnom vyjadren bude nzke. Hrozilo by, e vlda sa bude sprva procyklicky, bude krti v ase, kedy by mala skr pomha. Title: NBS Chief Economist Michal Horvth in Economy TA3: Analysts expect better numbers than a few months ago.
text: Chief Economist N Michal Horvath S In Economics TA3: Analysts expect better numbers than a few months ago. Dec 22, 2022 Andrej Horvath, moderator: "We will stay on the topic of the economic forecast. Analysts expect better numbers than a few months ago. Of course, the situation can change quickly, as the war conflict in Ukraine is still not over. More about the forecast I will talk to Michal Horvath, Chief Economist of the National Bank of Slovakia. Hello, Mr. Horvath." Michal Horvath, Chief Economist of the National Bank of Slovakia: "Good day." Andrej Horvath: "We have also heard it from the mouth of Governor Peter Kazimir. Next year's inflation will not be as dramatic as the analysts of the National Bank expected in September, not eighteen percent, but the expected ten percent. What has happened since then?" Michal Horvath: "The measures announced by the government in the meantime in the area of regulated energy prices have made a fundamental contribution to improving this outlook. We already said in the autumn that if the government takes further measures, inflation might not be eighteen percent next year, but it could be significantly lower. And that is exactly what happened, and even the government announced measures that are even more generous than we counted on in the autumn even in the better scenario. So that's why the drop to the expected ten percent next year." Andrej Horvath: "We will get to those measures later, but I would be interested in food prices now, because they largely concern people and this year they have grown really significantly, at a rate of up to sixteen percent. Will this growth slow down next year?" Michal Horvath: "We believe so. The development this year was basically marked by an increase in food prices. Given that households were as if protected from developments in global energy markets thanks to the regulatory mechanism, the main driver of inflation This year, food prices were high. At the end of the year, they are about a quarter more expensive than at the end of the previous year. Of course, you can point out individual categories that grew much more, but on average it comes out to that quarter. Current prices on the world markets indicate a reversal and we believe that the pace of food price growth could slow to single digits over the next year." Andrej Horvath: "And why did food prices rise so significantly? It is therefore also related to the energy prices, as they are interconnected vessels? Those food transfers, production and so on cost something. So have those energy prices been reflected in those foods?" Michal Horvath: "There are several factors and an important factor is, of course, energy prices, but not only as a direct input into production, but for example agriculture also uses fertilisers, the production of which is dependent on gas, and we know how gas prices have developed during this year, so this also made agricultural production more expensive. In addition, there are other things. The post-pandemic opening was still weighing on global development economy and the growth of consumption and food on a global scale. And besides, the cards Russia's aggression against Ukraine, which created a enormous uncertainty on the grain market, especially given that these two countries account for a significant share of global grain production and exports." Andrej Horvath: "What does it look like with wage growth? Will the higher wages, if companies pay employees some extra part, cover the higher inflation, or do people really get poorer?" Michal Horvath: "We expect that next year approximately yes. This year, people have lost some of their purchasing power, real incomes have fallen by about four percent, but next year, due to the fact that the growth of regulated energy prices will not be so high high, roughly the increases we see, we expect, wage increases should be covered by increased costs, increased prices." Andrej Horvath: "Not only food prices have risen, but also real estate prices, and in recent years they have risen by tens of percent. What does the National Bank expect? Will this growth be subdued, or will it continue? We know that real estate agencies are already warning that this trend is reversed, at least in that prices are gradually rising more slowly." Michal Horvath: "The growth of real estate prices, as you said, is already slowing down. Even In some regions, slight declines can be seen. Of course, we cannot expect the double-digit growth that we have seen in recent years in the future, the market will probably cool down a bit, the growth rate will moderate. It is important to focus on those circumstances that affect the development of the real estate market. Interest rates are expected to rise further. The income situation of the population, although next year it will be better than we expected, but in the coming years the situation is very uncertain due to the fact that we do not know what will happen to energy prices, what will happen with various government measures, and at the same time we are also observing that quite a lot is currently being built and completed, so the supply on the market is also increasing. These factors all seem to indicate that demand will be weaker and supply is improving, so price developments will probably be subdued in the coming period." Andrej Horvath: "Let's move a little further to economic growth, to the growth of gross domestic product. Several European Union countries expect a recession next year, for example, Germany. In September, analysts at the National Bank also warned that this scenario was realistic for Slovakia. What are your current expectations now?" Michal Horvath: "We have improved our expectations in this regard as well. It is all related exactly to those energy prices for households. By capping them in a sense, the purchasing power of the population will remain relatively strong, which will support the economy. In the coming months, we will probably not avoid some cooling, as in other eurozone countries. After all, the development from this year, when the real incomes of the population were falling, also affects the consumption in our country. But in the course of next year, especially in the second half of next year, when we expect that the world The economy will recover, the Slovak economy could also grow, and thus we could end up with relatively solid growth throughout the year." Andrej Horvath: "I think the number should be around one and a half percent next year. We already know the structure of this growth, which factors contributed to the growth of the Slovak economy, or rather which ones will be signed?" Michal Horvath: "An absolutely fundamental thing is the expected massive inflow of EU funds, where we have such a specific situation, next year is specific from this point of view. It is the last year, when we can draw funds from the previous budget period at the EU level, and we are quite late with the drawing of EU funds, so the whole thing has been concentrated in one year. This should significantly shift public investment, but also private investment, and this will significantly contribute to the growth of the economy. But also, I say, domestic consumption should be stable, in the past we expected it to fall, so it will stabilize the economy. And at the same time, we expect a recovery in exports earlier in the second half of the year. So investments and exports are what will probably pull the economy the most next year." Andrej Horvath: "As for the money from EU funds and the recovery plan, it is a huge amount, billions of euros. To what extent do you think Slovakia is effectively drawing this money?" Michal Horvath: "Well, the efficiency of drawing is quite questionable. After all, we can see it in the overall numbers for the economy. We are not able to catch up with the standard of living of Western countries, and lately this catching up seems to have stopped. And it is these funds that are intended to prepare and modernize the economy for faster catch-up. In practice, we see that the drawdown over the years is relatively weak, and then it all focuses on the end of the period within which we can draw funds, and then the priority is to spend somehow and not necessarily efficiently and with the greatest potential for the economy." Andrej Horvath: "Mr. Horvath, you have already mentioned that inflation will be lower as a result of the fact that the government has adopted several measures within which it wants to compensate or Pay for energy prices so that they are not so high for people. But this will cost the state a lot of money. What impact will this have on public finances and public debt?" Michal Horvath: "Of course, and this is exactly the other side, that on the one hand we have a better inflation development, we expect a better development in the economy next year, but At the same time, it will cost us that the burden is borne by the state, and we expect an increase there deficit of public finances. This year we will probably end up somewhere around three percent, next year up to six percent. It should be noted that not all of the support for the economy in the area of energy prices, which we estimate at about three and a half billion euros, is not all financed from debt. There will also be some special taxes, it is expected that part of the EU funds will be diverted for this purpose, by the way, which is also not a completely expedient use of those Of course, a certain part will also go to debt, so at the end of the year we will be even more indebted, and this creates a very limited space for similar support in the field of energy prices in the coming years." Andrej Horvath: "The debt should be around sixty percent of GDP. Is this already a high number?" Michal Horvath: "For a country like Slovakia, this is a high number. Of course, we have a difficult period behind us. We had a pandemic, this crisis associated with the war came And objectively, even in these times of energy crisis, people need to be helped. Maybe we have set up the aid too generously, it is not targeted at all, it does not motivate people to save energy, and therefore it costs public finances a lot. But it would be important at this moment to have a plan to get out of the sixty percent lower, and we don't have that plan at all." Andrej Horvath: "Now I will ask a key question in connection with public finances. Since the parliament has passed a vote of no confidence in the government, what impact will this have on your forecast?" Michal Horvath: "It's hard to say. The only thing I can say is that uncertainty has increased." Andrej Horvath: "I suppose those predictions are linked to the planned state budget." Michal Horvath: "Yes, the predictions are linked to the planned state budget, to the implementation of those measures that the government has promised. I think that there is still good reason to believe that those measures will be introduced. Without it, the situation would be very, very difficult in Slovakia, and I think that the political elite will probably not allow themselves to do so in the electoral or the pre-election year. But in any case, it is not good that even now there are question marks over how it will be with energy prices next year." Andrej Horvath: "There is a certain probability that the quarreling opposition and coalition will agree on the budget, the parliament will approve it, but there is another possibility, perhaps even more likely, that Slovakia will go into a provisional budget. In that case, according to the Ministry of Finance, there would be eight billion euros less in the state coffers. According to the Council for Budget Responsibility, it would be a little more than two and a half billion. What impact will this have on the lives of people in Slovakia?" Michal Horvath: "Well, let's hope it won't be temporary. It is not good to go into a very uncertain situation..." Andrej Horvath: "But we can also speak in this scenario." Michal Horvath: "Yes. And if we simply look at what the state expenditures are this year and what would be expected next year, there is the eight billion difference. However, it cannot be said that so much will be missing next year. I trust my colleagues in the Council for Budget Responsibility, that they calculated it well. There are several factors there. Next year, those expenses are largely influenced by the expected drawdown of those EU funds. At the time of the provisional budget, state social security contributions are excluded from expenditure In addition, this year's budget contained various reserves that were still related to the pandemic situation, and thus increase the ceilings that would be worked with in some provisional situation next year. So the situation is not entirely bad next year, but it would be ideal to go into uncertain times with a budget and with enough money." Andrej Horvath: "But according to some analysts, in that case, the energy aid to people and companies would be endangered." Michal Horvath: "I think that the money will eventually be found for this. It's a solvable situation." Andrej Horvath: "At the moment, however, we are witnessing a situation where there is a disagreement regarding the memorandum of Slovenske elektrarne, and it is not yet known whether those households will have their prices frozen or not. Do you see this as a problem?" Michal Horvath: "Yes, it would be good if these measures were brought to the very end. I see this as a discussion not only about electricity prices, but at the same time we know that there is a parallel discussion about extraordinary taxes that should affect Slovenske elektrarne. So I believe that in the end an agreement will be found that will be beneficial both socially and for the company." Andrej Horvath: "Mr. Horvath, that was my last question. Thank you for taking the time to share the information of the National Bank's forecast with TA3 viewers." Michal Horvath: "Thank you very much for the opportunity and I wish you pleasant holidays." text_original: Hlavn ekonm N S Michal Horvth v Ekonomika TA3: Analytici oakvaj lepie sla ako pred pr mesiacmi. 22. dec 2022 Andrej Horvth, modertor: Pri tme ekonomickej prognzy ete zostaneme. Analytici oakvaj lepie sla ako pred pr mesiacmi. Samozrejme, situcia sa me rchlo zmeni, kee vojnov konflikt na Ukrajine nie je stle zaehnan. Viac si o prognze poviem s Michalom Horvthom, hlavnm ekonmom Nrodnej banky Slovenska. Dobr de, pn Horvth. Michal Horvth, hlavn ekonm Nrodnej banky Slovenska: Dobr de prajem. Andrej Horvth: Pouli sme to aj u st guvernra Petra Kaimra. T inflcia budci rok nebude a tak dramatick ako analytici Nrodnej banky v septembri oakvali, nie osemns percent, ale tch predpokladanch desa percent. o sa odvtedy stalo? Michal Horvth: Zsadnm spsobom k zlepeniu tohto vhadu prispeli opatrenia, ktor medziasom vlda ohlsila v oblasti regulovanch cien energi. U na jese sme hovorili, e ak vlda prijme alie opatrenia, tak t inflcia by nemusela by v budcom roku osemns percent, ale mohla by by podstatne niia. No a presne to sa stalo, ba dokonca vlda ohlsila opatrenia, ktor s ete tedrejie, s akmi sme aj v tom lepom scenri rtali na jese. Take preto ten pokles na oakvanch desa percent v budcom roku. Andrej Horvth: K tm opatreniam sa ete dostaneme, ma by ale teraz zaujmali ceny potravn, pretoe tie sa do vekej miery tkaj ud a tento rok rstli skutone vrazne, a estnspercentnm tempom. Spomal sa tento rast budci rok? Michal Horvth: Verme, e no. Ten vvoj tento rok v zsade sa niesol v znamen rastu cien potravn. Vzhadom na to, e domcnosti boli vaka regulanmu mechanizmu ako keby chrnen od vvoja na svetovch trhoch s energiami, hlavnm ahom inflcie v tomto roku boli ceny potravn. Na konci roka s zhruba o tvrtinu drahie ako na konci predolho roka. Samozrejme, daj sa vypichn jednotliv kategrie, ktor rstli ovea viac, ale tak v priemere to vychdza na t tvrtinu. Momentlne ceny na svetovch trhoch naznauj obrat a verme, e v priebehu budceho roku by sa tempo rastu cien potravn mohlo spomali do jednocifernch sel. Andrej Horvth: A preo prve tak vrazne rstli ceny potravn? Svis to teda aj s cenami energi, kee ide o prepojen ndoby? Tie transfery potravn, vroba a tak alej nieo stoja. Take premietli sa do tch potravn prve tie ceny energi? Michal Horvth: Je tam niekoko faktorov a dleit faktor s samozrejme ceny energi, ale nielen ako priamo vstup do vroby, ale naprklad ponohospodrstvo pouva aj hnojiv, ktorch vroba je zvisl na plyne, a vieme, ako sa vyvjali ceny plynu v priebehu tohto roku, take aj to predrailo ponohospodrsku vrobu. Okrem toho s tam aj in veci. Ete stle na svetov vvoj doliehalo postpandemick otvranie ekonomiky a rast spotreby aj potravn v celosvetovom meradle. A okrem toho karty zamieala plne zsadnm spsobom agresia Ruska voi Ukrajine, ktor vytvorila obrovsk neistotu na trhu najm s obilm, vzhadom na to, e prve tieto dve krajiny sa vo vznamnej miere podieaj na svetovej produkcii a vvoze obilia. Andrej Horvth: Ako to vyzer s rastom miezd? Pokryj tie vyie mzdy, pokia teda firmy zaplatia zamestnancom nejak as navye, t vyiu inflciu, alebo udia relne chudobnej? Michal Horvth: Oakvame, e v budcom roku pribline no. Tento rok udia stratili as svojej kpyschopnosti, relne prjmy poklesli zhruba o tyri percent, ale v budcom roku vzhadom na to, e rast regulovanch cien energi nebude a tak vysok, zhruba tie nrasty, ktor vidme, oakvame, nrasty miezd by mali pokry zven nklady, zven ceny. Andrej Horvth: Nerstli len ceny potravn, ale aj ceny nehnutenost, a to posledn roky o desiatky percent. o oakva Nrodn banka? Utlm sa tento rast, alebo bude pokraova naalej? Vieme, e realitn agentry u upozoruj na to, e dochdza k obratu tohto trendu, aspo v tom, e ceny postupne rast pomalie. Michal Horvth: Rast cien nehnutenost, ako ste povedali, u spomauje. Dokonca v niektorch reginoch vidno ako keby mierne poklesy. Do budcna teda samozrejme nemono oakva tie dvojcifern rasty, ktor sme videli v uplynulch rokoch, ten trh sa zrejme trochu ochlad, tempo rastu sa zmierni. Dleit je sa zamera na tie okolnosti, ktor ovplyvuj vvoj na trhu s nehnutenosami. Oakva sa al rast rokovch sadzieb. T prjmov situcia obyvatestva, aj ke v budcom roku bude lepie ako sme akali, ale v tch alch rokoch je situcia vemi neist vzhadom na to, e nevieme, o bude s cenami energi, o bude s rznymi vldnymi opatreniami, a zrove ale aj sledujeme, e momentlne sa dos vea stavia a dokonuje, take aj ponuka na trhu sa zvyuje. Tieto faktory vetky ako keby naznaovali, e aj dopyt bude slab, aj ponuka sa zlepuje, take cenov vvoj bude zrejme tlmen v nasledujcom obdob. Andrej Horvth: Posume sa teraz troku alej k ekonomickmu rastu, k rastu hrubho domceho produktu. Viacer krajiny Eurpskej nie oakvaj budci rok recesiu, naprklad Nemecko. Analytici Nrodnej banky v septembri tie upozorovali, e tento scenr je pre Slovensko relny. Ak s teraz vae aktulne oakvania? Michal Horvth: Zlepili sme oakvania aj v tomto smere. Ono vetko to svis presne s tmi cenami energi pre domcnosti. Tm, e ony bud v istom zmysle zastropovan, tak t kpna sila obyvatestva zostane pomerne siln, o podr t ekonomiku. V nasledujcich mesiacoch sa zrejme nejakmu ochladeniu nevyhneme, podobne ako aj v inch krajinch eurozny. Predsa len, ten vvoj z tohto roka, ke relne prjmy obyvatestva klesali, dolieha aj na t spotrebu u ns. Ale v priebehu budceho roka, najm v tej druhej polovici budceho roka, ke oakvame, e sa u aj svetov ekonomika bude zotavova, aj slovensk ekonomika by mohla pors a tm pdom celorone by sme mohli skoni s pomerne soldnym rastom. Andrej Horvth: To slo by budci rok myslm e malo by okolo percenta a pol. Poznme u aj truktru tohto rastu, ktor faktory sa podpsali pod rast slovenskej ekonomiky, alebo lepie povedan ktor sa podpu? Michal Horvth: plne zsadnou vecou je oakvan masvny prlev eurofondov, kde mme tak pecifick situciu, budci rok je pecifick z tohto hadiska. Je to posledn rok, ke vieme erpa prostriedky ete z predchdzajceho rozpotovacieho obdobia na rovni E, a mekme dos s erpanm eurofondov, tak sa to cel sstredilo do jednho roka. To by malo vo vraznej miere posun verejn investcie, ale aj skromn investcie, a toto bude podstatnm spsobom prispieva k rastu ekonomiky. Ale tie, hovorm, domca spotreba m by stabiln, v minulosti sme akali, e bude jej prepad, take ona bude stabilizova t ekonomiku. A zrove oakvame oivenie v exporte skr v tej druhej polovici roka. Take investcie a export je to, o asi najviac potiahne ekonomiku v budcom roku. Andrej Horvth: o sa tka ete tch peaz z eurofondov a plnu obnovy, ide o obrovsk sumy, miliardy eur. Do akej miery myslte, e Slovensko efektvne erp tieto peniaze? Michal Horvth: Tak efektivita erpania je pomerne otzna. Vidme to koniec-koncov aj na celkovch slach za ekonomiku. Nedar sa nm dobieha ivotn rove zpadnch krajn, v poslednej dobe sa toto dobiehanie ako keby zastavilo. A prve tieto prostriedky s uren na to, aby sme pripravili, modernizovali ekonomiku na rchlejie dobiehanie. V praxi vidme, e to erpanie v priebehu rokov je pomerne slab a potom sa to vetko sstreuje na koniec toho obdobia, v rmci ktorho vieme erpa prostriedky, a vtedy je priorita min nejako a nie nutne efektvne a s najvm potencilom pre ekonomiku. Andrej Horvth: Pn Horvth, u ste to spomnali, e t inflcia bude niia v dsledku toho, e vlda prijala viacer opatrenia, v rmci ktorch chce kompenzova alebo doplca tie ceny energi, aby pre ud neboli tak vysok. To ale bude tt st nemal peniaze. Ak to bude ma dopad na verejn financie a verejn dlh? Michal Horvth: Samozrejme, a toto je presne t druh strnka, e na jednej strane mme lep inflan vvoj, oakvame lep vvoj v ekonomike v budcom roku, ale zrove ns to bude st to, e to bremeno nesie tt, a tam oakvame zvenie deficitu verejnch financi. Tento rok pravdepodobne skonme niekde okolo troch percent, v budcom roku a es percent. Treba podotkn, e nie cel t podpora pre ekonomiku v oblasti cien energi, o odhadujeme na zhruba tri a pol miliardy eur, nie vetko je financovan z dlhu. Bud aj nejak pecilne dane, oakva sa, e sa odklon as eurofondov na tento el, mimochodom, o je tie nie plne eln vyuitie tch eurofondov, ale ist as pjde samozrejme aj na dlh, take na konci roka budeme ete viac zadlen, a to vytvra vemi obmedzen priestor na podobn podporu v oblasti cien energi v tch alch rokoch. Andrej Horvth: Ten dlh by sa mal pohybova okolo esdesiatich percent HDP. Je u toto vysok slo? Michal Horvth: Pre krajinu, ako Slovensko, je to vysok slo. Samozrejme, mme ak obdobie za sebou. Mali sme pandmiu, prila tto krza spojen s vojnou a objektvne aj v tchto asoch energetickej krzy treba uom pomha. Mono t pomoc sme nastavili prli tedro, nie je to vbec cielen, nemotivuje ud etri energie, a tm pdom to verejn financie stoj vea. Ale dleit by bolo v tomto momente ma nejak pln, ako sa dostaneme z tch esdesiatich percent niie, a ten pln vbec nemme. Andrej Horvth: Teraz sa optam kov otzku v svislosti s verejnmi financiami. Kee parlament vyslovil nedveru vlde, ak to bude ma vplyv na vau prognzu? Michal Horvth: ako poveda. Ako jedin, o viem poveda, e sa tm pdom zvila neistota. Andrej Horvth: Tie predikcie s predpokladm naviazan na ten plnovan ttny rozpoet. Michal Horvth: no, predikcie s naviazan na plnovan ttny rozpoet, na realizovanie tch opatren, ktor vlda sbila. Myslm si, e je naalej dobr dvod sa domnieva, e tie opatrenia bud zaveden. Bez toho by bola situcia vemi, vemi ak na Slovensku, a myslm si, e to si politick elita zrejme nedovol vo volebnom i predvolebnom roku. Ale v kadom prpade nie je dobr, e ete aj teraz visia otzniky nad tm, ako to bude s tmi cenami energi v budcom roku. Andrej Horvth: Je tu ist pravdepodobnos, e rozhdan opozcia a koalcia sa dohodne na rozpote, parlament ho schvli, aleje tu alia monos, mono ete pravdepodobnejia, e Slovensko prejde do rozpotovho provizria. V tom prpade poda ministerstva financi by v ttnej kase bolo o osem milird eur menej. Poda Rady pre rozpotov zodpovednos by to bolo nieo viac ako dve a pol miliardy. Ak toto bude ma vplyv na ivot ud na Slovensku? Michal Horvth: No dfajme, e nebude to provizrium. Nie je dobr s do vemi neistej situcie... Andrej Horvth: Ale meme hovori teda aj v tomto scenri. Michal Horvth: no. A pokia sa jednoducho pozrieme na to, ak s vdavky ttu v tomto roku a ak by boli oakvan v budcom roku, je tam ten osemmiliardov rozdiel. Ned sa vak poveda, e toko bude chba v budcom roku. Verm kolegom v Rade pre rozpotov zodpovednos, e to dobre vyrtali. Tam je niekoko faktorov. V budcom roku tie vdavky vo vekej miere ovplyvuje oakvan erpanie prve tch eurofondov. V ase rozpotovho provizria s z vdavkov vyat ttne socilne dvky, na ktor maj vdy by peniaze, navye tentoron rozpoet obsahoval rzne rezervy, ktor ete sviseli s pandemickou situciou, a tm pdom navyuj tie stropy, s ktormi by sa pracovalo v nejakom provizriu v budcom roku. Take t situcia nie je plne zl v budcom roku, ale idelne by bolo do neistch asov s s rozpotom a s dostatonm mnostvom peaz. Andrej Horvth: Ale poda niektorch analytikov by v tom prpade bola ohrozen t energetick pomoc uom a firmm. Michal Horvth: Ja si myslm, e na to sa peniaze napokon nejakm spsobom njdu. Je to rieiten situcia. Andrej Horvth: Aktulne ale sme svedkami situcie, kedy je nezhoda, o sa tka memoranda Slovenskch elektrrn, a zatia sa nevie teda, e i tie domcnosti bud ma zmrazen ceny alebo nie. Vnmate toto ako problm? Michal Horvth: no, bolo by dobr, keby u tieto opatrenia boli dotiahnut do plnho konca. Vnmam to ako diskusiu nielen o cench elektriny, ale zrove tam vieme, e prebieha paraleln diskusia o mimoriadnych daniach, ktor by mali zasiahnu Slovensk elektrrne. Take verm, e nakoniec sa njde nejak dohoda, ktor bude prospen aj spoloensky, aj pre dan firmu. Andrej Horvth: Pn Horvth, to bola moja posledn otzka. akujem, e ste si nali as a podelili ste sa s divkmi TA3 o informcich prognzy Nrodnej banky. Michal Horvth: akujem vemi pekne za prleitos a prjemn sviatky prajem. Andrej Horvth: Podobne. Title: NBS Chief Economist Michal Horvth in RTVS Morning News on the Development of the Economy
text: NBS Chief Economist Michal Horvath in RTVS's Morning News on Economic Development Dec 22, 2022 NBS expects a more favourable development of the economy Martina Janekova, moderator: "NBS no longer predicts a slump next year of the Slovak economy. It has also significantly eased its inflation outlook in 2023, which it justifies by the government's measures against energy prices. More with Michal Horvath from the NBS, welcome to us, good morning." Michal Horvath, Chief Economist of the National Bank of Slovakia: "Good morning, I wish you." Martina Janekova: "If you will allow me, the first question at the beginning, last night there was a to such shifts in political negotiations, they agreed to approve the state budget. Is this also important and positive information for you economists?" Michal Horvath: "It is positive information and it is important, because our favorable The forecast for next year is just conditioned by acceptance or completion important government measures that will mitigate the price development in the field of energy for households." Michal Horvath: "The government has intervened, or wants to intervene with the help of this budget, there are certain measures planned against those high energy prices, it wants to help households, ordinary residents. But this, in turn, will affect public finances and those resources are not inexhaustible. So why are you so optimistic?" Michal Horvath: "Well, we are optimistic about 2023, but at the same time we emphasize that by doing so, we are shifting the burden to the next years and it is a budgetary burden, so next year these measures will cost us a lot of money, which will increase the country's debt. But at the same time, sometimes in the future we will also face a clash with reality when it comes to energy prices. Namely, it is expected that they will remain at a higher level on world markets and we At the moment, it is as if we are isolating Slovak households from this development, but this cannot be done in the long term, eventually those prices will have to be realistic." Martina Janekova: "You no longer predict such a sharp increase in inflation and its growth, rather the moderation, but still, will it peak when? In the coming months? Let's say at the beginning of next year?" Michal Horvath: "We should see a peak in the coming months, the only question is that how high inflation will peak, the beginning of the year is always so uncertain and we are still bothered by food prices. Over the course of the year, however, inflation should gradually fall to single-digit values over the course of next year. Then 2024 we will see whether it will be 2024 or 2025, only when energy prices for households become realistic, then the Inflation may jump up a little more." Martina Janekova: "What is currently signed on it and what could be done so that it does not rise as you say." Michal Horvath: "In particular, the story of 2022 is about the rapid rise in food prices, to a large extent it comes to us from abroad, world prices of agricultural crops have risen very sharply during the year and they are right, their growth is supposed to slow down, so that's why We hope that soon we will see it on our shelves, that the prices are already so they do not grow. And then we have a strong impact of energy prices, secondarily rising costs for companies And they, of course, reflect this to some extent in their prices. So, basically, Everything has become more expensive as a consequence." Martina Janekova: "You are optimistic about the inflation rate, but still, we have it, let's say, we are one of the countries that have the highest inflation, because, for example, The southern countries, which joined the eurozone later, have a lower one. Why is that?" Michal Horvath: "It is partly due to the different composition of the consumer basket, simply To put it simply, we, in poorer countries, spend more on food, energy, fuel, and these things have been the things that have risen sharply in price recently. To some extent, this can also be explained by the fact that some larger countries have energy from other sources, for example, a lot is produced from nuclear, nuclear power plants produce a lot of electricity in some Western countries. There is also such an impact that in our country, in these eastern countries, there is currently an extraordinary shortage of labor, so wages are also growing relatively quickly, and therefore entrepreneurs do not have room to save elsewhere and reflect these increased costs in prices." Martina Janekova: "When we talk about wages, they are growing quite quickly, and they will grow, that is also your forecast. Does this mean that our standard of living will increase, or is it not?" Michal Horvath: "Next year, if everything goes well, we should maintain the standard of living this year in terms of purchasing power and wages. We see both inflation and nominal wage growth somewhere around 10 percent, which is good news compared to our earlier forecasts, because in the autumn it still looked like the purchasing power of our salaries should fall significantly. The year 2023 will therefore be more positive, spent in isolation from world events, but as I say, there is always the other side that one day the world energy prices will catch up with us." Martina Janekova: "When you talk to companies, what bothers them the most? Those expensive prices or a shortage of skilled labour?' Michal Horvath: "Both to a certain extent, but especially the currently expensive energy prices and the uncertainty associated with expensive energy prices. It's not just about their own expenditure on energy, we have many companies that are relatively energy efficient, so they don't spend much on energy, but they have their suppliers, for whom it is an important item and there is a huge uncertainty whether they can deliver some goods to them, at what price they will deliver, and this also affects their lives, that they will be able to deliver those goods to their consumers at some price, So it's still such a very confusing situation in which it is very difficult to plan and it would be good if next year brought a little more peace to this year as well." Martina Janekova: "We hope so. Thank you very much for explaining these difficult terms for the morning for visiting the RTVS Morning News. We spoke with the Chief Economist of the NBS, Michal Horvath." You can watch the whole interview with Michal Horvath:

Vrazne zmiernila aj vhad inflcie v roku 2023, o odvoduje vldnymi opatreniami proti cenm energi. Viac u s Michalom Horvthom z NBS, vitajte u ns, dobr rno. Michal Horvth, hlavn ekonm Nrodnej banky Slovenska: Dobr rno, prajem. Martina Janekov: Ak dovolte, hne na vod t prv otzka, vera veer dolo k takm posunom v politickch rokovaniach, dohodli sa na schvlen ttneho rozpotu. Je to pre vs ekonmov tie vznamn a pozitvna informcia? Michal Horvth: Je to pozitvna informcia a je to dleit, lebo t naa priazniv predpove pre budci rok je prve podmienen prijatm, alebo dotiahnutm do konca tch dleitch vldnych opatren, ktor zmiernia cenov vvoj v oblasti energi pre domcnosti. Michal Horvth: Vlda zakroila, alebo teda chce zakroi aj pomocou tohto rozpotu, s tam plnovan ist opatrenia proti tm vysokm cenm energi, chce pomc domcnostiam, benm obyvateom. Ale to zase ovplyvn verejn financie a tie zdroje nie s nevyerpaten. Tak preo ste napriek tomu tak optimistick? Michal Horvth: No sme optimistick ohadom roku 2023, ale zrove zdrazujeme, e tmto pdom odsvame bremeno do alch rokov a je to jedna bremeno rozpotov, take budci rok ns tieto opatrenia bud st nemal peniaze, ktor navia dlh krajiny. Ale zrove niekedy ns ak v budcnosti aj stret s realitou, o sa tka cien energi. Toti to oakva sa, e tie zostan na vyej rovni na svetovch trhoch a my momentlne ako keby sme izolovali slovensk domcnosti od tohto vvoja, ale toto sa ned robi dlhodobo, eventulne tie ceny bude potrebn zrelni. Martina Janekov: U nepredpovedte tak prudk zvyovanie inflcie a jej rast, skr to zmiernenie, ale predsa len, bude vrcholi kedy? V nasledujcich mesiacoch? Povedzme zaiatkom budceho roka? Michal Horvth: V nasledujcich mesiacoch by sme mali vidie vrchol, otzne je akurt, e ako vysoko bude inflcia vrcholi, ten zaiatok roka je vdy tak neist a stle ns trpia najm ceny potravn. V priebehu roka, v priebehu budceho roka by vak inflcia mala postupne klesa do jednocifernch hodnt. Potom rok 2024 uvidme, i to bude rok 2024, alebo rok 2025, a ke sa zrelnia ceny energi aj pre domcnosti, vtedy ten inflan vvoj me ete trochu poskoi smerom hore. Martina Janekov: o sa na nej podpisuje aktulne a o by sa dalo urobi, aby u potom nestpla tak, ako hovorte. Michal Horvth: Najm prbeh roku 2022 je o rchlom raste cien potravn, do vekej miery to k nm prichdza zo zahraniia, svetov ceny ponohospodrskych plodn vemi prudko narstli v priebehu roka a oni prve, ten ich rast m spomali, take preto sa ndejame, e oskoro to uvidme aj na naich regloch, e tie ceny u tak vemi nerast. No a potom mme siln vplyv cien energi, sekundrne rast nklady firmm a oni to, samozrejme, premietaj v nejakej miere do svojich cien. Take v zsade zdraelo vetko, ako dsledok toho. Martina Janekov: Ste sce optimistick pokia ide o t mieru inflcie, ale predsa len, mme ju povedzme, sme jedna z krajn, ktor ju maj najvyiu, pretoe naprklad junejie krajiny, a tie do eurozny vstpili neskr, ju maj niiu. m to je? Michal Horvth: Je to jednak odlinm zloenm spotrebnho koa, jednoducho povedan, my, v chudobnejch krajinch, mame viac na potraviny, energie, pohonn ltky a prve tieto veci boli to, o v poslednom obdob prudko zdraeli. Do istej miery sa to d vysvetli aj tm, e niektor vie krajiny maj energie z inch zdrojov, vea sa naprklad produkuje z jadrovej, jadrov elektrrne produkuj vea elektriny v niektorch zpadnch krajinch. Je tam ete aj tak vplyv, e u ns, v tchto vchodnch krajinch je momentlne mimoriadny nedostatok pracovnej sily, take aj mzdy rast pomerne rchlo, a tm pdom podnikatelia nemaj priestor etri inde a premietaj tieto zven nklady do cien. Martina Janekov: Ke sme pri tch mzdch, rast pomerne rchlo, aj bud rs, to je tie vaa predpove. Znamen to, e naa ivotn rove sa bude zvyova, alebo nie je to tak? Michal Horvth: V budcom roku, ak vetko dobre vyjde, tak by sme si mali zachova ivotn rove tohto roku, o sa tka kpyschopnosti a miezd. Obidve, aj inflciu, aj rast nominlnych miezd vidme niekde okolo 10 percent, o je dobr sprva oproti naim skorm predpovediam, lebo na jese to ete vyzeralo tak, e t kpna sila naich platov by mala vrazne prepadn. Rok 2023 tmto pdom bude tak pozitvnej, strven v izolcii od svetovho diania, ale ako vravm, vdy tam je t druh strana, e raz ns tie svetov ceny energi dobehn. Martina Janekov: Ke hovorte s firmami, o ich najviac trpi? Tie drah ceny energi, alebo nedostatok kvalifikovanej pracovnej sily? Michal Horvth: Oboje do istej miery, ale najm momentlne drah ceny energi a t neistota spojen prve s drahmi cenami energi. Nejde len o ich vlastn vdavky na energie, mme vea firiem, ktor s pomerne energeticky efektvne, take nemaj vea na energie, ale maj svojich dodvateov, pre ktorch je to dleit poloka a tam je obrovsk neistota, i vedia doda im nejak tovar, za ak cenu bud dodva a to ovplyvuje aj ich ivot, e i oni bud schopn v nejakej cene dorui ten tovar svojim spotrebiteom, take je to stle tak vemi neprehadn situcia, v ktorej sa vemi ako plnuje a bolo by dobr, keby budci rok priniesol aj do tohto trochu v pokoj. Martina Janekov: Dfame. akujem vemi pekne za vysvetlenie tchto nronch pojmov na rno za nvtevu v Rannch sprvach RTVS. Hovorili sme s hlavnm ekonmom NBS Michalom Horvthom.
