Title: NBS Chief Economist Michal Horvth warns: The government will protect households and companies with billions, but reality will knock on our door one day (HNonline.sk)
text: Chief Economist N Michal Horvath S warns: The government will protect with billions MICHAL HORVaTH CHIEF ECONOMIST OF NBS MICHAL HORVaTH CHIEF ECONOMIST OF NBS Dec 22, 2022 In an interview with HN, the NBS Chief Economist explains why government measures to support households and businesses in the energy crisis are key to economic growth and the inflation outlook of our country At the same time, Michal Horvath explains why it is only postponing the problem and how it can catch up with us in the future. There has been a lot of talk and writing about the ECB's monetary policy in recent days, but the message of the central bank's chief economist with a view to the future is clear - let's get ready for interest rates to go next year higher. Is it time to revise the inflation target when the ECB cannot achieve it in the short term? In its winter forecast, the NBS suggests that a key factor in improving the economic outlook of Slovakia is government assistance with high energy prices. Would a provisional budget be a problem? The government's announced measures in the area of regulated energy prices have a major impact on the outlook for next year. They are a key prerequisite for what we are in our The forecast talked not only about growth, but also about inflation. Without these measures, the announced decline in inflation would not have occurred, either compared to this year or compared to the previous forecast. The same applies to the assumption of relatively solid economic growth next year. Therefore, it is a great pity that the government measures have not yet been fully completed and there is still uncertainty around them. In the end, there will be no provisional budget. It would not be good if we went into such uncertain times with a provisional budget. It is better to have a proper budget ready with reserves. One could also philosophize that the measures could be cheaper, perhaps more targeted and more effective. The provisional has its clear and significant drawbacks, but it may not be quite as catastrophic as it might seem. Why do you think it wouldn't be such a disaster? The issue of the provisional budget is not easy at all. Some items are excluded from the monthly ceilings that apply in this case. It is the year-on-year increase in expenditure that is expected to be largely due to the expected higher absorption of EU funds, which are exempt from those ceilings, and at the same time the government also has in the budget provisionally the obligation to pay state social benefits. These are to be indexed to a significant extent, so this is another item for which there will be money, and it must also be said that this year the budget contains various reserves that were still intended for the pandemic. Later, the expenditure side of the budget was also increased by energy aid at the end of the year. So these factors seem to mitigate the overall impact of the provisional budget. However, this is far from an ideal situation, but the shortfall would not reach eight billion, which is sometimes mentioned, but it would be a smaller amount. A skilful government would know how to At the end of the year, we will also play with the transfer of money between years. Do you think that Igor Matovi is one of the smartest ones in this government? I will not comment on that. I mean rather the administration at the Ministry of Finance, where there will certainly be smart people who know how to do such things. A significant limitation provisional budget would be that exactly one-twelfth of that could be spent budget package per month. This means that any transfers are not possible there. It would reduce the flexibility of disbursing aid in such uncertain times, when we do not know how the situation will develop next year or when it will be necessary to give money to help companies with energy. It would not be possible to react to unexpected situations. How exactly will energy aid support economic growth next year? The most important thing is that the population would be protected from a high increase in costs. This would preserve the purchasing power of households. We expect revenues to grow at about the same rate as inflation, which is a significantly better situation. Back in the autumn, we expected the real incomes of the population to fall significantly next year. So this would make it possible to stabilize the economy in a significant way. In addition, we expect a great impulse from EU funds. Next year is specific in that it is the last year in which it is possible to draw money from the previous programming period, which ended in 2020. As is customary in our country, we left a huge part of that money for the last possible year. We expect much of this to be implemented, and this will support both public and private investments, which should significantly contribute to the growth of the economy next year. We also expect it to recover in the second half of the year after a temporary cooling world economy. Our key partners will start to do better, which should support exports from Slovakia. Do you think that GDP growth will be driven by all its components, i.e. household consumption, state consumption, investments and net exports at once?  Basically, yes. In the case of consumption, we are rather talking about stability close to positive zero, but the good news is that there will not be a big drop. Thus, next year they should Rather, investments and, to a certain extent, foreign trade should take over the reins of growth. We expect that the situation with the supply of components will gradually normalize, so Industry will function better and inventories may be smaller than this year. It could be a relatively good year. China recently lifted its zero-tolerance covid policy, which should increase the momentum of global trade. Is this the effect you are talking about, or are you referring to the global recovery of our key partners such as Germany or Germany? Austria? It's all connected. China is also dragging Germany as well as the entire world economy, but I think that a recovery in the United States is also expected during the next year.  The situation is currently difficult for China due to the pandemic situation and this will be In the near term, make an important contribution to the cooling of the global economy, beyond other factors such as high inflation and the resulting slowdown in consumption in large economies. However, China may be a source of interesting things next year Impacts. After the pandemic wave subsides, it will start to open again, trade more, which will mean higher demand. This applies especially to raw materials, so this may also affect the global development of gas prices, but also metal prices. They have fallen quite sharply recently, and it is more related to the cooling of the world economy, so we can expect that when China picks up its pace again, metal prices will start to rise again. From an inflationary perspective, China's opening up poses a risk of higher price pressures on a global scale later next year. Paradoxically, producer prices in China fell by 1.3 percent in November. So don't you expect such an effect that after a year of exporting inflation, it will export deflation, at least in the short term? In the short term, it works that way. As I said, metal prices and energy prices are currently at a relatively low level compared to where they were in the middle of this year. That is until To a large extent, it is also due to the fact that China is struggling with pandemic problems, but also, for example, problems in the real estate sector. Let's go back to the government's energy support as a positive price factor. However, there is also a downside. What would you highlight? There are even three other sides to it. First, we are talking about an anti-inflationary effect in 2023, but this opens up two big question marks regarding inflation developments in 2024 and 2025. The other flip side is the impact on public finances and other possible consequences in the future. And the third thing is that these measures are set up in such a way that they basically mean minimal motivation for residents to change their behavior and save energy. Regarding the former, i.e. the uncertainty about inflation in 2024 and 2025, it must be said that at the moment it looks like it looks like the current expectations are reflected in the price level through our regulatory framework in 2025, energy prices in Slovakia for the population should double compared to this year. That is, one hundred percent growth. Yes, one hundred percent growth. Next year, we are cutting off the minimum of this expected 100 percent growth, and there is the rest that we will somehow have to spread over time. It is, of course, possible that those prices will eventually fall significantly more significantly in the future, but it would be a miracle in a way. The probability that prices would fall significantly is currently very small. Not even if the war in Ukraine ends suddenly? I don't think it was even then. Deep structural changes have been initiated in the global economy, which are in line with persistently higher energy prices. This is especially true of the traditional sources we are talking about here. So, in principle, no one expects a return to pre-crisis levels or something like that. It follows that the prices will have to become realistic in our country at some point. Next year we will live in such a parallel reality, as if the world development did not concern us, but one day reality will knock on our door and we will have to open it to it. This is then related to the fiscal issue. Next year, the government decided to spend some 3.5 billion to protect households and companies from the market Development. As a result, the deficit will be higher and the debt will be close to the limit of 60 percent of GDP. Any other measures in the coming years that we would like to protect economy before the development of energy prices, would be very difficult to implement. The question of the need to consolidate public finances will become even more acute. From your point of view, it is not an alibi of the government that it shifts the burden of debt to unpredictable future at a time of rising interest rates, which means that the cost of debt will be even higher? The fact is that we are facing certain debt limits in the area of public finances. Any further assistance in the coming years will be more difficult in terms of funding and the availability of money. The next issue is, of course, the price. Yes, we are on the path of raising interest rates, and when the markets do not believe that the government has the situation under control, then government bond yields, i.e. the price at which the government borrows, will rise even more as a result of risk premiums. A fundamental change is also that central banks will no longer buy debt to the same extent as before. So even from this point of view, the conditions for debt refinancing will be significantly more difficult. Let's not forget that similar measures are being taken elsewhere and other governments will go to the market trying to sell their debt. Among them will be the German government, which is a significantly more credible debtor than the Slovak Republic. The market has some absorption capacity, so even from this point of view The coming years look complicated. Therefore, it is very difficult to say anything definitive about 2024 and 2025. Do you think that we are at risk of a downgrade by the end of 2023, what would happen next? Has the cost of debt financing become more expensive? Credit rating agencies certainly monitor the level of political uncertainty and the development of public finances. It must be said that, for example, in the case of the provisional budget, there is a threat that there will be no money for some programmes. At the same time, there is also a risk that expenditures could be much higher through various proposals that we have no idea about. All this will play an important role in how rating agencies will change their view of the Slovak economy during the year. It must be said that arguments against the current rating have been piling up for a long time. Could inflation reach the ceiling next year? We expect inflation to peak sometime in the coming months. The question is how high the maximum will be. I admit that there is a lot of uncertainty on this issue. When we have recently looked at the development of prices, whether of food or services, we try to describe it on the basis of the development of prices of inputs, energy, services, wages, agricultural commodities and so on. But the development can be even worse. We are in a kind of non-standard regime. Given that inflation is in double digits, pricing is completely different than it used to be in the past. Therefore, it is difficult to say exactly how high it will still shoot Inflation, let's say in January. Prices of agricultural commodities, energy and other inputs currently suggest that cost pressures on producers could ease over the next year relieve. Inflation should therefore gradually fall into single digits. As for the outlook for the coming years, the uncertainty of when we will make energy prices real in Slovakia plays a role. This could make the return to lower inflation levels rocky. If we decide to adjust our prices towards world prices at the beginning of 2024, depending on how the government subsidizes it in a given moment, there may still be some other small leap. In our prediction, we say That inflation could average nine percent in 2024, but that means it would jump from some lower levels in January, and then fall again. Is it just a base effect that will cause this moderation in the pace of price growth, or are there also deflationary pressures that we see, for example, in agricultural commodities? It is true that the development in agricultural commodities is already reversing, it also depends on what one is watching exactly, but there has already been an earlier reversal in some indices. In our country, it is about a five- to seven-month delay before it starts to really manifest itself. Next year is exactly a mixture of the base effect, as the food has basically started to take off since the spring of last year, and also the fact that real inflation at those inputs is significantly lower than this year. Former IMF chief economist Olivier Blanchard argues that the 2 percent inflation target is historically rather a rarity and that, naturally, inflation is more likely to be three percent or more. Isn't it time to redefine, for example, the targeting of core inflation a year after the strategic reassessment of the ECB's targets? I do not think that it would be good for the credibility of the institution and, in principle, of the entire monetary policy framework in these circumstances to make such changes. The higher inflation target was first discussed in the context of moving away from the zero limit of nominal interest rates, but in the meantime other arguments may have been added. In any case, now is not the right time for such changes. I think that the two percent target and the medium-term orientation of monetary policy give room for us to be in a difficult They were able to navigate the environment in such a way that we do not take hasty measures or something that would explicitly harm the economy beyond the need to stabilize prices. A medium-term orientation means that we do not try to have inflation at two percent at every moment, but always with a view to some period within which monetary policy has an impact on the economy. This allows us to cope with situations where certain items, such as food or even energy, fluctuate. Thus, we can wait out these temporary effects, provided that they do not affect the medium-term outlook. At the moment, we are in a situation of huge shocks to energy and food prices Direction. Inflation is very high and there are concerns that this is also affecting the medium-term outlook. That is why the ECB has taken action and will continue to act. We are simply no longer in a situation where we can only wait until everything returns to normal. It is necessary to actively From a monetary policy position, it should contribute to bringing inflation back to two percent. What does the medium-term outlook mean in concrete terms? Usually, the medium-term horizon means the next year and a half to two years. Sometimes there are reasons that it stretches for longer, but that's when credibility comes into play. At the last meeting of the ECB's Governing Council, discussions were held on how soon the inflation target should be achieved. To a large extent, the trajectory of monetary policy policy that will follow in the course of next year. In fact, the ECB has never raised interest rates so sharply in its history in such a short time as this year, with an increase of another 100 to 150 points. If we want to see a deviation from the goal, it is enough to observe the two- to A three-year inflation swap? I think that these market indicators are useful in assessing the risks of inflation developments. The essential information was the ECB's forecast, on which we also with a one percent weight. The ECB's December forecast showed that headline inflation would be higher and would be above the target for longer, with the target being adjusted under the monetary policy, which preceded the December meeting, returned to the target only at the the very end of that horizon of 2025. Core inflation would be well above two percent that year as well. This was unacceptable for the governors, so the vigorous communication came so that on the one hand, With the increase in rates and the communication, a message was sent to the market that as far as interest rates are concerned, their increase is far from over. It's not entirely clear how far rates will rise, but they will continue to rise until it's clear enough that inflation will fall to the two percent threshold in an acceptable time. Are better times dawning for investors on the stock markets only in 2024? Economic forecasts suggest that the situation in the world economy, including eurozone could improve noticeably in the second half of next year. The path of interest rates is related to how the inflation outlook will be rewritten. If in a sufficiently large number of scenarios that can be considered, there will be no clear calculation of how Inflation is falling back to where we would like it to be, so until then, interest rates will rise. As for mortgages, when ECB interest rates are 3.5 percent, commercial rates would perhaps be around five? I'll leave pricing to the banks. Factors such as their costs, margin or the riskiness of clients will quickly increase the difference between the commercial rate and the ECB's interest. At the same time, however, it should be remembered that interest rates should also fall again after the inflation situation calms down. From the point of view of monetary policy, those levels above three percent can be seen as restrictively. There, monetary policy is already actively hampering the economy and price developments, and given the condition of the European economy, long-term interest rate levels are probably lower than those of three percent. The central bank weighs inflation and economic growth. But all governments in Europe have intervened in energy prices and are trying to dampen the impact on households and businesses, thereby supporting economic growth. Does this mean that the risk of recession could theoretically make interest rate hikes even worse? I don't think the weights have changed. It's more about the fact that there has been more bad news on the inflation side lately. The ECB adjusted its growth outlook in this last December forecast to the downside. The autumn forecast was generally accepted as optimistic. The December forecast seems to confirm what everyone already knew or expected. As far as the medium-term inflation outlook is concerned, there has been a real deterioration, with the inflation outlook being the ECB's main objective. The only question is when we want inflation back to two percent, whether sooner or later. Any damage or some impact on the real economy then also depends on this. Important The argument is then the credibility of the central bank, so these things are considered And the governors then decide accordingly. If we were to take into account the ECB's autumn forecast from 2021, then the accuracy of its estimate would have to be considered a disaster today. Of course, no one could have predicted that the factor of the war in Ukraine would come, which made it significantly worse. Why should people trust the ECB or central banks in general in their predictive ability when they are so wrong, and why do central banks think they are always right? Predictions are a hell of a thing and you should always realize that it is a conditional statement. It's not that we think inflation will be a specific single number. It depends on a number of assumptions that go into it, and even under those circumstances, there is a lot of some uncertainty. In my opinion, if someone says that a prediction was wrong or we were wrong, they don't understand what a prediction actually is. Of course, deviations are important, they need to be monitored, but they need to be evaluated for what reasons. I can assure everyone that nowhere is so much effort and resources devoted to making people understand the development in the economy as in central banks. But it's a very difficult thing. It's even harder than predicting the weather. In the case of the economy, the development responds to people's behavior and people react to that development. So it goes both ways. While In weather forecasting, when you know that the assumptions that it will rain are being fulfilled, you announce rain for the next day. People take an umbrella to work. But imagine if the clouds reacted to the fact that people take an umbrella to work en masse. Work It would be much more difficult for meteorologists, and even so it happens that they sometimes do not hit accurately. We make predictions in conditions where many factors intervene. We also do not pretend that we have a perfectly described behavior of the economy. We try to to understand the behavior of the economy and the people or companies in it, but if we wanted to fully describe reality, it would be much more complicated and unusable. We work with simplified models and try to do it as best as possible. Could we say that the last message for the new year is that people should save on energy, because the whip will crack in 2024? One of the messages is that sooner or later reality will catch up with us. So if someone has invested in alternative energy sources this year, bought a more efficient boiler or insulated their house, they don't have to bang their head against the wall, these investments will still bring people a return in the future. Editor's note: This interview was written two days before the budget was approved by the National Council of the Slovak Republic. text_original: Hlavn ekonm N S Michal Horvth varuje: Vlda miliardami uchrni domcnosti a firmy, ale realita nm raz zaklope na dvere (HNonline.sk) MICHAL HORVTH HLAVN EKONM NBS 22. dec 2022 Hlavn ekonm NBS v rozhovore pre HN vysvetuje, preo s vldne opatrenia v oblasti podpory domcnost a firiem v energetickej krze kov pre hospodrsky rast a inflan vhad naej krajiny Zrove Michal Horvth objasuje, preo je to len odloenie problmu a ako ns to me dobehn v budcnosti. O menovej politike ECB sa v poslednch doch vea hovorilo a psalo, no odkaz hlavnho ekonma centrlnej banky s vhadom do budcnosti je jasn -pripravme sa, e rokov sadzby pjdu budci rok vyie. Nastal as na revziu inflanho ciea, ke ho ECB nevie krtkodobo dosiahnu? V zimnej prognze NBS naznauje, e kovm faktorom zlepenia ekonomickho vhadu Slovenska je vldna pomoc s vysokmi cenami energi. Bolo by rozpotov provizrium problm? Ohlsen opatrenia vldy v oblasti regulovanch cien energi zsadnm spsobom ovplyvuj vhad na budci rok. S kovm predpokladom toho, o sme v naej predikcii hovorili nielen o raste, ale aj o inflcii. Bez tch opatren by nenastal avizovan pokles inflcie, i u oproti tomuto roku, alebo voi predolej predpovedi. To ist plat pre predpoklad pomerne soldneho rastu ekonomiky v budcom roku. Preto je vek koda, e vldne opatrenia ete nie s plne dotiahnut do konca a stle je okolo nich neistota. Rozpotov provizrium nakoniec nebude. Nebolo by dobr, ak by sme ili do takto neistch asov s rozpotovm provizriom. Je lepie ma pripraven riadny rozpoet aj s rezervami. Tie by sa dalo filozofova, e tie opatrenia by mohli by lacnejie, mono cielenejie a efektvnejie. Provizrium m svoje jasn a vrazn nevhody, ale nemus to by plne a tak katastrofa, ako by sa mohlo zda. Preo si myslte, e by to nebola a tak katastrofa? Otzka rozpotovho provizria vbec nie je jednoduch. Z mesanch stropov, ktor sa v tomto prpade uplatuj, s niektor poloky vyat. Prve to medziron zvenie vdavkov, ktor sa oakva, je do vekej miery kvli oakvanmu vyiemu erpaniu eurofondov, ktor s z tch stropov vyat a zrove vlda m aj v rozpotovom provizriu povinnos vyplca ttne socilne dvky. Tie sa maj vo vraznej miere valorizova, take to je alia poloka, na ktor peniaze bud a treba tie poveda, e v tomto roku rozpoet obsahuje rzne rezervy, ktor boli uren ete na pandmiu. Neskr sa vdavkov strana rozpotu v zvere roka tie zvyovala o energetick pomoc. Take tieto faktory ako keby zmierovali ten celkov vplyv rozpotovho provizria. Zaleka to vak nie je idelny stav, ale vpadok by nedosiahol osem milird, o sa niekedy spomna, ale bola by to menia suma. ikovn vlda by sa vedela v zvere roka pohra aj s presunmi peaz medzi rokmi. Myslte si, e Igor Matovi je jeden z tch ikovnejch v tejto vlde? To nebudem komentova. Myslm skr administratvu na ministerstve financi, kde sa urite njdu ikovn udia, ktor vedia takto veci robi. Podstatnm obmedzenm rozpotovho provizria by bolo to, e sa d ma presne jedna dvanstina toho rozpotovho balka mesane. To znamen, e tam nejak presuny nie s mon. Znilo by to flexibilitu vyplcania pomoci v takchto neistch asoch, ke nevieme, ako sa bude t situcia v budcom roku vyvja alebo kedy bude potrebn dva peniaze na pomoc s energiami firmm. Nebolo by mon reagova na neakan situcie. Ako konkrtne podpor energetick pomoc hospodrsky rast v budcom roku? Najdleitejia vec je, e obyvatestvo by bolo ochrnen pred vysokm nrastom nkladov. Tm by sa zachovala kpna sila domcnost. Oakvame, e prjmy by rstli zhruba takm tempom ako inflcia, o je podstatne lepia situcia. Ete na jese sme akali, e relne prjmy obyvatestva budci rok vrazne klesn. Take to by umonilo vraznm spsobom stabilizova ekonomiku. Nad rmec toho oakvame vek impulz z eurofondov. Budci rok je pecifick tm, e je to posledn rok, v ktorom je mon erpa peniaze z predolho programovho obdobia, ktor sa skonilo v roku 2020. Ako to je u ns zvykom, obrovsk as tch peaz sme nechali na posledn mon rok. Oakvame, e vek as toho sa zrealizuje, a to podpor verejn aj skromn investcie, o by malo zsadnm spsobom prispie k rastu ekonomiky v budcom roku. Taktie oakvame, e po prechodnom ochladen sa v druhej polovici roka zotav svetov ekonomika. Naim kovm partnerom sa zane dari lepie, o by malo podpori vvoz zo Slovenska. Myslte si, e rast HDP potiahnu vetky jeho zloky, teda spotreba domcnosti, spotreba ttu, investcie a ist export naraz? V podstate no. V prpade spotreby skr hovorme o stabilite blzkej pozitvnej nule, ale dobr sprva je, e nenastane vek prepad. Tm pdom v budcom roku by mali prebra opraty rastu skr investcie a do istej miery aj zahranin obchod. Oakvame, e sa postupne bude normalizova aj situcia s dodvkami komponentov, take priemysel bude lepie fungova a aj zsoby bud mono menie ako v tomto roku. Mohol by to by pomerne dobr rok. na nedvno zruila politiku nulovej tolerancie covidu, o by malo zvi dynamiku globlneho obchodu. Je toto ten efekt, o ktorom hovorte, alebo mte na mysli globlne oivenie naich kovch partnerov ako Nemecko alebo Raksko? Vetko to spolu svis. na ah aj Nemecko, ako aj cel svetov ekonomiku, ale myslm si, e v priebehu budceho roka sa oakva aj oivenie v Spojench ttoch. V ne je situcia momentlne kvli pandemickej situcii zloit a toto bude v najbliom obdob prispieva dleitou mierou do ochladenia svetovej ekonomiky nad rmec inch faktorov, akmi je vysok inflcia a z toho vyplvajce spomalenie spotreby vo vekch ekonomikch. na vak me by budci rok prameom zaujmavch vplyvov. Po odznen pandemickej vlny sa zane znovu otvra, viac obchodova, o bude znamena vy dopyt. To sa tka najm nerastnch surovn, take aj toto me ete ovplyvni svetov vvoj cien plynu, ale aj ceny kovov. Tie v poslednom ase pomerne strmo poklesli a viac to svis s ochladenm svetovej ekonomiky, take meme aka, e ke na op nabehne na svoje tempo, tak ceny kovov zan op rs. Z inflanho hadiska otvorenie ny predstavuje riziko vych cenovch tlakov v globlnom meradle neskr v budcom roku. Paradoxne ale vrobn ceny v ne v novembri klesli o 1,3 percenta. Neakte teda tak efekt, e po roku exportovania inflcie bude aspo krtkodobo vyva deflciu? Krtkodobo to tak funguje. Ako som hovoril, ceny kovov a ceny energi s momentlne na pomerne nzkej rovni v porovnan s tm, kde boli v polovici tohto roka. To je do vekej miery aj tm, e sa na trpi s pandemickmi problmami, ale naprklad aj problmami v sektore nehnutenost. Vrme sa k tej energetickej podpore vldy ako pozitvnemu cenovmu faktoru. M to vak aj odvrten stranu. o by ste vyzdvihli? M to dokonca tri druh strany. Po prv, hovorme o protiinflanom inku v roku 2023, ale tm pdom sa otvraj dva vek otzniky ohadne inflanho vvoja v roku 2024 a 2025. Druhou odvrtenou stranou je vplyv na verejn financie a alie mon dsledky v budcnosti. A tretia vec je to, e tieto opatrenia s nastaven tak, e pre obyvateov znamenaj v podstate minimlnu motivciu meni sprvanie a etri energiami. K tomu prvmu, teda neistote ohadne inflcie v roku 2024 a 2025 treba poveda toko, e momentlne to vyzer na svetovch trhoch s plynom a elektrinou tak, e ke sa sasn oakvania premietnu cez n regulan rmec do cenovej hladiny v roku 2025, tak oproti tomuto roku by sa ceny energi na Slovensku pre obyvatestvo mali zdvojnsobi. Teda stopercentn rast. no, stopercentn rast. V budcom roku z tohto oakvanho stopercentnho rastu odkrajujeme minimum a zostva tam ten zvyok, ktor budeme nejako musie rozloi v ase. Je, samozrejme, mon, e tie ceny napokon v budcnosti klesn podstatne vraznejie, ale bol by to istm spsobom zzrak. Pravdepodobnos toho, e ceny by vrazne klesli, je momentlne vemi mal. Ani keby sa nhle skonila vojna na Ukrajine? Myslm si, e ani vtedy nie. Vo svetovej ekonomike sa natartovali hlbok trukturlne zmeny, ktor s v slade s trvalo vymi cenami energi. To sa tka najm tradinch zdrojov, o ktorch sa tu rozprvame. Take nvrat na pred-krzov rovne alebo nieo podobn v zsade neak nikto. Z toho vyplva, e sa u ns bud musie niekedy tie ceny zrelni. Budci rok budeme i v takej paralelnej realite, ako keby sa ns svetov vvoj netkal, ale jeden de nm realita zaklope na dvere a my jej ich budeme musie pootvori. Toto potom svis s tou fiklnou otzkou. Budci rok sa vlda rozhodla min nejakch zhruba 3,5 miliardy na to, aby uchrnila domcnosti a firmy od trhovho vvoja. Vaka tomu bude deficit vy a dlh bude blzko hranice 60 percent HDP. Akkovek alie opatrenia v nasledujcich rokoch, ktormi by sme chceli chrni ekonomiku pred cenovm vvojom energi, by bolo vemi ak realizova. Dokonca oraz aktnejou bude otzka potreby konsolidcie verejnch financi. Nie je to z vho pohadu alibizmus vldy, e presva bremeno dlhu do nepredvdatenej budcnosti v ase rastcich rokovch sadzieb, o znamen, e nklady zadlovania bud ete vyie? Faktom je, e v oblasti verejnch financi narame na urit limity zadlenosti. Akkovek alia pomoc v alch rokoch bude zloitejia z hadiska financovania a dostupnosti peaz. alou otzkou je, samozrejme, cena. no, sme na ceste zvyovania rokovch sadzieb a ke trhy nebud veri, e vlda m situciu pod kontrolou, tak vnosy vldnych dlhopisov, teda cena, za ktor si vlda poiiava, bud narasta ete viac v dsledku rizikovch prirok. Zsadn zmena tie je, e centrlne banky u nebud nakupova dlh v takej miere ako doteraz. Take aj z tohto pohadu bud podmienky pre refinancovanie dlhu podstatne aie. Nezabdajme, e podobn opatrenia sa prijmaj aj inde a na trh pjdu aj in vldy snaiac sa preda svoj dlh. Medzi nimi bude aj nemeck vlda, ktor je podstatne dveryhodnej dlnk ako Slovensk republika. Trh m nejak absorpn kapacitu, take aj z tohto pohadu vyzeraj budce roky zloito. Preto je vemi ak poveda nieo definitvne o roku 2024 a 2025. Myslte si, e nm do konca roka 2023 hroz znenie ratingu, o by alej predraovalo nklady na financovanie dlhu? Ratingov agentry urite sleduj mieru politickej neistoty a vvoj verejnch financi. Treba poveda, e naprklad v prpade rozpotovho provizria je hrozba, e nebud peniaze na niektor programy. Zrove je tu aj riziko toho, e by vdavky mohli by cez rzne nvrhy, o ktorch vbec ani netume, ovea vyie. Toto vetko bude hra dleit lohu v tom, ako bud ratingov agentry meni svoj pohad na slovensk ekonomiku v priebehu roka. Treba poveda, e argumenty v neprospech sasnho ratingu sa kopia u dlhie. Mohla by inflcia v budcom roku dosiahnu strop? Oakvame, e inflcia dosiahne maximum niekedy v nasledujcich mesiacoch. Otzka je, ako vysoko bude to maximum. Priznm sa, e pri tejto otzke je vek neistota. Ke sa v poslednom ase pozerme na vvoj cien, i u potravn alebo sluieb, sname sa ho opsa na zklade vvoja cien vstupov, energi, sluieb, mzdy, agrokomodt a podobne. No vvoj doke by ete hor. Sme v akomsi netandardnom reime. Vzhadom na to, e inflcia sa pohybuje v dvojcifernch slach, je cenotvorba plne in ako zvykla by v minulosti. Preto je ak presne poveda, ako vysoko ete vystrel inflcia povedzme v januri. Ceny agrokomodt, energi a inch vstupov momentlne naznauj, e by sa nkladov tlaky na vrobcov v priebehu budceho roka mohli zmierni. Inflcia by teda mala postupne klesa do jednocifernch sel. Pokia ide o vhad na alie roky, tam hr lohu prve neistota, kedy na Slovensku zrelnime ceny energi. To by mohlo spsobi, e nvrat na niie inflan rovne by mohol by kostrbat. Ak sa rozhodneme upravi nae ceny smerom k svetovm cenm zaiatkom roku 2024 v zvislosti od toho, akm spsobom to ete vlda zadotuje v danom momente, tak tam ete me by nejak al mal skok. V naej predikcii hovorme o tom, e by inflcia v roku 2024 mohla by v priemere dev percent, ale to znamen, e by v januri poskoila z nejakch nich rovn, a potom by zase klesala. Je to len bzick efekt, ktor spsob toto zmiernenie tempa rastu cien, alebo s tu aj deflan tlaky, ktor vidme naprklad pri agrokomoditch? Je pravda, e vvoj v agrokomoditch sa u obracia, zvis aj od toho, o lovek presne sleduje, ale pri niektorch indexoch u dolo k skoriemu obratu. U ns je to zhruba tak p- a sedemmesan odklad, km sa to zane relne prejavova. Ten budci rok je presne zmes bzickho efektu, kee tie potraviny sa zaali v podstate rozbieha od jari minulho roku a aj toho, e relne inflcia pri tch vstupoch je podstatne niia ako v tomto roku. Bval hlavn ekonm MMF Olivier Blanchard tvrd, e dvojpercentn inflan cie je historicky skr raritou a e prirodzene je inflcia skr tri a viac percent. Nie je rok po strategickom prehodnoten cieov ECB as predefinova naprklad na cielenie jadrovej inflcie? Nemyslm si, e prve za tchto okolnost by to bolo dobr pre dveryhodnos intitcie a v zsade celho rmca menovej politiky, keby sa robili takto zmeny. O tom vyom inflanom cieli sa najskr diskutovalo v kontexte toho, aby sme sa vzdialili od nulovej hranice nominlnych rokov, ale medziasom mono pribudli in argumenty. V kadom prpade teraz nie je ten sprvny as na takho zmeny. Myslm si, e dvojpercentn cie a strednodob orientcia menovej politiky dva priestor na to, aby sme v zloitom prostred dokzali navigova tak, e nerobme unhlen opatrenia alebo nieo, o by vyslovene kodilo ekonomike nad rmec potreby stabilizova ceny. Strednodob orientcia znamen, e sa nesname ma inflciu na dvoch percentch v kadom okamihu, ale vdy s vhadom na nejak obdobie, v rmci ktorho menov politika m vplyv na ekonomiku. To nm umouje vyrovna sa so situciami, e niektor poloky, ako naprklad potraviny alebo aj energie, kolu. Tm pdom vieme preka tieto doasn vplyvy, za predpokladu, e neovplyvuj strednodob vhad. Momentlne sme v situcii obrovskch okov aj cien energi aj potravn rovnakm smerom. Inflcia je vemi vysoko a existuj obavy, e to m vplyv aj na strednodob vhad. Preto zaala ECB kona a bude kona aj naalej. Jednoducho nie sme u v situcii, ke to vieme len preka, km sa vetko vrti do normlu. Treba aktvne prispie z pozcie menovej politiky k tomu, aby sa inflcia vrtila k dvom percentm. o konkrtne znamen strednodob vhad? Obyajne sa pod strednodobm horizontom rozumie najbli rok a pol a dva roky. Niekedy s dvody, e sa to natiahne na dlhie, ale vtedy vstupuje do hry kredibilita. Na poslednom zasadnut Rady guvernrov ECB sa viedli diskusie ohadne toho, ako skoro sa m inflan cie dosiahnu. Do vekej miery od toho zvis trajektria menovej politiky, ktor bude nasledova v priebehu budceho roka. ECB v podstate nikdy vo svojej histrii nezvila rokov sadzby tak prudko v takom krtkom ase ako tento rok, priom v hre je zvenie o alch 100 a 150 bodov. Ak chceme vidie odchlku od ciea, sta sledova ten dvoj- a trojron inflan swap? Myslm si, e tieto trhov indiktory s oson v hodnoten rizk inflanho vvoja. Podstatn informcia bola prve predpove ECB, na ktorej sme sa aj my naou jednopercentnou vhou podieali. Decembrov predikcia ECB ukzala, e celkov inflcia bude vyia a bude dlhie nad cieom s tm, e k cieu by sa za nastavenia menovej politiky, ktor boli pred decembrovm zasadnutm, vracala k cieu iba na plnom konci toho horizontu 2025. Jadrov inflcia by aj v tom roku bola vrazne nad dvoma percentami. Toto bolo pre guvernrov neakceptovaten, preto prila t rzna komunikcia, aby jednak aj zvenm sadieb aj tou komunikciu bol vyslan odkaz trhu, e o sa tka rokovch sadzieb, ete zaleka nie je ich zvyovaniu koniec. Nie je plne jasn, kam a sadzby vystpaj, ale ony bud rs dovtedy, km nebude dostatone jasn, e inflcia poklesne k dvojpercentnej hranici v prijatenom ase. Svit investorom na akciovch trhoch na lepie asy a v roku 2024? Ekonomick predpovede naznauj, e situcia vo svetovej ekonomike vrtane eurozny by sa citene mohla zlepova v druhej polovici budceho roka. Trajektria rokovch sadzieb svis s tm, ako sa bude prepisova inflan vhad. Pokia v dostatone vea scenroch, o ktorch sa d uvaova, nebude jasne vpoet, ako inflcia kles sp tam, kde by sme ju chceli ma, tak dovtedy bud rokov sadzby stpa. o sa tka hypotk, ke bud rokov sadzby ECB 3,5 percenta, tak komern sadzby by boli mono okolo piatich? Cenotvorbu nechm na banky. Faktory ako ich nklady, mara i rizikovos klientov rchlo zvia rozdiel medzi komernou sadzbou a rokmi ECB. Zrove vak treba pripomen, e po upokojen inflanej situcie by rokov sadzby mali zase aj klesa. Tie rovne nad tromi percentami mono z pohadu menovej politiky vnma ako retriktvne. Tam u menov politika aktvne brzd ekonomiku a cenov vvoj, priom vzhadom na to, v akej je kondci je eurpska ekonomika, dlhodob rovne rokovch sadzieb s pravdepodobne niie ako tie trojpercentn. Centrlna banka vi inflciu a hospodrsky rast. No vetky vldy v Eurpe zasiahli do cien energi a snaia sa tlmi dosahy na domcnosti a podniky, m podporuj hospodrsky rast. Znamen to, e riziko recesie by mohlo zvyovanie rokovch sadzieb teoreticky ete zhori? Nemyslm si, e sa zmenili vhy. Ide skr o to, e tch zlch sprv bolo v poslednom ase viac na tej inflanej strane. Vhad pre rast ECB upravovala v tejto poslednej decembrovej predpovedi smerom nadol. T jesenn predpove bola vo veobecnosti prijat ako optimistick. Decembrov predpove ako keby len potvrdila, o u kad vedel alebo oakval. o sa tka strednodobho inflanho vhadu, tak dolo k relnemu zhoreniu, priom inflan vhad je hlavn cie ECB. Jedin otzka je, kedy chceme ma inflciu nasp na dvoch percentch, i skr alebo neskr. Od toho potom zvisia aj prpadn kody alebo nejak vplyvy na relnu ekonomiku. Dleitm argumentom je potom kredibilita centrlnej banky, take tieto veci sa zvauj a guvernri potom poda toho rozhodn. Ak by sme do vahy zobrali jesenn predikciu ECB z roku 2021, tak presnos jej odhadu by sme dnes museli povaova za katastrofu. Samozrejme, nikto nemohol predpoklada, e prde faktor vojny na Ukrajine, ktor to vrazne zhoril. Preo by mali udia veri ECB alebo centrlnym bankm vo veobecnosti v ich predikn schopnos, ke sa tak pomlili a preo si centrlne banky myslia, e maj vdy pravdu? Predikcie s pekeln vec a vdy si treba uvedomi, e to je podmienen vrok. Nejde o to, e my si myslme, e inflcia bude nejak konkrtne jedno slo. Zvis to od mnostva predpokladov, ktor do toho vstupuj a aj za tch okolnost je okolo toho nejak neistota. Poda ma, ak niekto hovor, e nejak predikcia bola zl alebo sme sa zmlili, tak nerozumie tomu, o je vlastne predikcia. Samozrejme, odchlky s dleit, treba ich sledova, ale treba ich vyhodnocova, e z akch dvodom sa dej. Mem kadho ubezpei, e nikde sa nevenuje toko silia a zdrojov tomu, aby udia pochopili vvoj v ekonomike ako v centrlnych bankch. Je to ale vemi ak vec. Je to ete aie ako predpoveda poasie. V prpade ekonomiky toti ten vvoj reaguje na sprvanie ud a udia reaguj na ten vvoj. Take to ide oboma smermi. Km v predpovedan poasia, ke viete, e sa napaj predpoklady toho, e bude pra, tak ohlsite na al de d. udia si zober do prce ddnik. Ale predstavte si, e by oblaky reagovali na to, e si udia hromadne zober do prce ddnik. Prca meteorolgov by bola ovea aia, a pritom aj takto sa stva, e obas netrafia presne. My robme predpovede v podmienkach, ke do toho zasahuje vea faktorov. Tie sa vbec netvrime, e mme dokonale opsan sprvanie ekonomiky. Sname sa pochopi sprvanie ekonomiky a ud i firiem v nej, ale ak by sme chceli plne opsa realitu, bolo by to ovea zloitejie a nepouiten. My pracujeme so zjednoduenmi modelmi a sname sa to robi o najlepie. Mohli by sme poveda, e ten posledn odkaz do novho roku je, e udia by mali etri na energich, lebo ten bi bude plieska v roku 2024? Jeden z odkazov je, e skr i neskr ns realita dobehne. Take ke niekto v tomto roku investoval do alternatvnych zdrojov energie, kpil si efektvnej bojler alebo zateplil dom, tak si nemus bcha hlavu o stenu, tieto investcie uom ete prines vnos v budcnosti. Title: NBS Chief Economist M. Horvth: If the government keeps its promises, prices will not rise so sharply, says NBS Chief Economist (e.dennikn.sk)
text: Chief Economist N S M. Horvath: Ak the government will keep its promises, prices will no longer rise so sharply, says the chief economist of the NBS (e.dennikn.sk) Jan 23, 2023 Inflation in Slovakia reached 15.4 percent in December, and it was the same in November. But it probably hasn't reached the peak yet, it should happen in the coming months, assumes the chief economist of the National Bank of Slovakia , Michal Horvath. He says that if the government keeps its word and compensates businesses and households for expensive energy, inflation will be lower than last year. Average inflation reached almost 13 percent last year, this year it could be around 10 percent. "We believe that the promises made by the government to the citizens will be fulfilled," he says. According to Horvath, there are still risks in the euro area that inflation may be above the 2% inflation target for a longer period of time. Markets expect a further increase in the base interest rate somewhere to the level of 3 to 3.5 percent in the first half of the year. In the interview, he also says:  that the rise in food prices on our shelves should moderate this year,  why December inflation in Hungary was as high as 25 percent,  that a cooling of the economy in the eurozone will come, but some dramatic recession At the moment, no one seems to be waiting. Listen to the podcast In December, year-on-year inflation was 15.4 percent, and it was the same in November. Has it already reached its peak or do you expect it to grow even further? Inflation in December was slightly lower than our latest forecasts. Something like this hasn't happened to us for a long time. Almost all of the favourable impact on price developments can be attributed to fuel prices. We expect inflation to peak in these months. The question is how high it will be. In our forecast, we had that inflation should not go significantly higher, but the beginning of the year is always quite specific and things can still happen. Last year, food prices rose significantly, in December on average by up to 29 percent per year. Housing costs rose by 17 percent. Will food and energy grow significantly this year? According to our expectations, not anymore. And we have good reasons for this to be optimistic, at least as far as the nearest outlook is concerned. In the case of energy prices for households, the government has decided to intervene quite generously and limit the rise in electricity, gas and heat prices and so on. As for the development of food prices, which bothered us mainly last year, we have been seeing for a long time that the growth of agricultural prices on world markets is slowing down, which will gradually reach us. So the average customer will already feel in stores that food prices will not jump up so much from month to month? Yes, it always happens with a certain distance from world events and they should Gradually, months will follow, when the rise in food prices on the shelves in our country should also moderate. What actually caused the prices of agricultural commodities to fall on the stock exchanges? Food prices have been driven by several influences in the past period, some of which were still related to the pandemic and the recovering global economy. Energy prices have had a huge impact, which also affects fertilizer prices. Some agricultural products are also a substitute (substitute - editor's note) in fuel production. Somewhere in the world there was also bad weather, which affected the prices of coffee, cocoa and the like. These influences are clearly fading away, and this has been confirmed to us by the manufacturers, we have recently spoken to them. So this year, this source should no longer be the source of such strong pressures on price increases as last year. This was a significant factor in the development of food prices. Have you also talked to local farmers? We discussed with producers, food producers and retail chains. Inflation averaged nearly 13 percent last year, the highest since 1994. You based your forecast for this year on the fact that the government will compensate high energy prices for businesses and households. Also in view of the confusion With the high advance payments that some businesses received in the new year, do you still expect it to be around 10 percent? We believe that the promises made by the government to the citizens will be fulfilled. It may not be going completely smoothly, but we believe that to a large extent what has been promised will be true. And it is in terms of development inflation in Slovakia is an absolutely key factor - these measures in a fundamental way changed the outlook for price developments in Slovakia. Could high advance payments have made some entrepreneurs uncertain? Could they have changed their plans because of that? I don't know, you probably have to ask entrepreneurs. When we talk to them, we hear that for a long time - basically since the summer - they have existed in conditions of extreme uncertainty for prices Energy. Even inputs from those who are not necessarily energy-intensive producers can come from such producers, and last year there was enormous uncertainty at what price. Of course, these "additional" ambiguities certainly did not contribute to the good mood, but I believe that even this will be shaken off. What do you think will bother entrepreneurs the most this year? Energy prices, Problems with the supply of components, problems in supply chains? Even energy prices. Conditions in supply chains have improved globally, but we keep hearing that there are problems with this in Slovakia. However, this could improve over the course of the year. An important factor is the development of energy prices, but there is still uncertainty about the of the form in which and by when the government aid will arrive. In our calculations, we counted that what was promised now as help until the end of spring would continue until the end of the year. Of course, it needs to be done at the government level. In December, average inflation was 15.4 percent, but pension inflation and inflation of low-income groups were slightly higher. We can describe in more detail Which groups have been hit the hardest by inflation? Inflation is currently hitting the items that fall into the category of essentials the most. These are food, energy, including heat, transport. Low-income people in particular spend a significantly larger part of their income on these items. If we were to construct a consumer basket of low-income groups, including pensioners, measured inflation would be higher than the average numbers that are published. However, this is done officially by the Statistical Office. It also calculates inflation for pensioners, as this subsequently enters into the indexation mechanisms, on the basis of which pensions are adjusted every year. Can we say in more detail who all belong to low-income groups? These are people on social benefits, the unemployed, people in material need, single people Mothers who are raising their child, so who is it? Also low-income employed and ordinary people. Do we have data that people would change their shopping behavior due to high inflation and buy cheaper versions of products? We don't have very good data on this. Since we also talk to retail chains, we have information about how people change what they buy. But the interesting thing is (and we see it in aggregated data and it also results from surveys) that in a situation like this, as it is today, people tend to draw on their savings. Not so much to change their shopping plans, including larger purchases of durable goods such as refrigerators, televisions, but rather go into their savings, if they have any. Is it wiser to build up a larger cash reserve now, or rather to invest, as stocks have fallen in price after last year's slumps? The important thing is not to panic. For example, people are now receiving statements from the third pillar and they can see in the development of their investments that the numbers are often negative. Last year on the global stock and bond markets was relatively negative, so many investments lost their value. It would be bad if these investments, which people certainly originally intended as something long-term, were currently correcting in a panic or moving the money somewhere else. I still think that when someone has room to invest for the long term, well-diversified portfolios are a wise investment. You also asked about cash reserves; It's good if People have the equivalent of several months' income deferred as a reserve. According to Eurostat data, we had the seventh highest inflation in December in the European Union. Poland and the Czech Republic had only slightly higher scores, but Hungary had up to 25 percent of it. Why was it so high in Hungary? There has been a relaxation of many administrative interventions by the government in pricing, whether in the field of energy or - what people probably noticed the most - fuel. Since they were relatively cheap a year ago and now their price has risen, this noticeably increases inflation. In the case of Hungary and other neighbouring countries, we should not forget about the development of the exchange rate. The Hungarian forint has weakened noticeably against the euro and other world currencies over the past year. Of course, this is also reflected in consumer prices with a distance. Thanks to the euro, Slovakia has the advantage of lower interest rates. The base rate of the European Central Bank (ECB) is 2.5 percent, it is almost a third compared to the Czech Republic or Poland, in Hungary the rate is 13 percent. Will these interest rates go even significantly higher, and how will this affect mortgage interest rates? Markets expect a further increase in the ECB's key interest rate somewhere between 3 and 3.5 percent in the first half of the year. However, interest on mortgages is a more complicated matter. On the one hand, there is interest on loans with a longer maturity, but when we talk about the basic interest rate, we are talking about a short-term rate. Long-term interest rates also take into account expected future developments. Markets expect the long-term level of rates, consistent with the inflation target, to be lower than the 3 to 3.5 percent. So for mortgages with a maturity of more than three or four years, this one also comes into play factor. Of course, banks have their own policy, which takes into account the risk of clients, the cost of their own financing, and also the margin, which reflects the competitive environment. The question is always to what extent all this is already reflected in the existing rates. Apparently, there will still be an upward movement. Now, for example, with a 5-year fixation, interest rates are already around four percent. When we take into account the expected development of key rates, then the interest at which the Banks lend money on the interbank market, and some margin on top of that, are we already getting to five percent this year? I would not like to speculate. It is probably a better question for people from the banking environment. Of course, we monitor and evaluate it, but I would not like to predict the development. Market expectations are such that short-term interest rates will peak next year And then there could be a slight decline. At the beginning of February, the first ECB meeting of the year takes place. Bloomberg reported from the bank's corridors that it is considering a more moderate rate hike, i.e. not by 50 points, but by 25 points. What do you think about it? It is in the hands of the governors - they have their own opinion on this, depending on how they read the situation. In the euro area, too, the last two inflation figures have already been relatively favourable. To a large extent, this is due to factors such as the decline in energy prices on world markets, which is at least to some extent influenced by the development of the weather. There are countries where these effects are very quickly reflected in prices for consumers, and this has pushed inflation numbers for the whole the eurozone is down. In addition, there have been various government interventions that resemble the which we also do at home. The aim is to protect consumers from the development of world prices, but the measures are implemented faster and last shorter, and these have also affected development in December. However, these are temporary effects that should not affect thinking about where rates will move in the future. On the other hand, core inflation, which is adjusted for these more volatile items outside the direct influence of central banks, continued to rise. Risks that inflation may be above inflation target for longer. This would suggest that there are no fundamental reasons to change course now compared to the December communication. Inflation in the eurozone fell from 10.1 percent to 9.2 percent in December, which is higher than expected; However, core inflation was rising, i.e. the prices of other goods and services. So how does the ECB read this? The analysis is very comprehensive. Perhaps the most important is the evaluation of the current figures: what they mean for inflation in a year, a year and a half. It is not an easy question. Government interventions may dampen inflation now, but they may mean that inflation in the future will be higher than without them, i.e. they increase the inertia of inflation. This is something that central banks are very careful about. It is from inertia that the risk that inflation will take root in the economy and stay with us longer. Therefore, it is not easy to say that if we have had relatively good numbers, it automatically means that we can slow down in the pace of monetary policy tightening. You have already mentioned that electricity and gas prices on commodity exchanges are falling. What this means for our citizens and for businesses, and energy bills, for example, in 2024? From the point of view of companies that operate either on spot markets or operate through short-term contracts, this is clearly good news at least in the near future Future. Cost pressures from this source will be smaller. Even with the decline in world markets, it should be noted that this is largely related to the development of the weather in Europe and the related decline in demand. So this story is far from over, Uncertainty is high, prices may return back to higher levels. The essence from the point of view households in Slovakia is that even with this decline, the price outlook is higher than we currently have. Even in the last forecast, we pointed out that although government measures "solved" 2023, we have an unresolved problem ahead of us, that we will have to make energy prices more realistic so that they more closely match the development of global markets. And there, expectations for the future have not fallen so much that we fundamentally change the outlook for 2024 or 2025. So the next government will again face the question of whether and to what extent to compensate for rising energy prices for businesses and households? Yes. We are currently in an environment where households are very much isolated from external events in the world, and sometimes we will have to make prices realistic. Either a miracle will happen and world prices will fall to more reasonable pre-pandemic levels and so on, but few people are expecting that at the moment. Or the alternative is that we will have to adjust the prices. We have already experienced the so-called price liberalization in Slovakia several times, when energy prices were radically revised. Then there is always the question that it needs to be done, but at the same time we have groups of the population that cannot handle it, and thus it will be necessary to provide some compensation. In the first auction of this year, the state borrowed cheaper with longer interest maturities than in the autumn. We rode the European wave. It can also change and turn around whereas the ECB is winding down its bond purchase programmes and may Will investors look more at the health of public finances? Yes, the central bank has announced that it has stopped buying, but it is slowly starting with the end of reinvestments. Until now, it has worked in such a way that when the purchased bonds mature, It bought new ones in the same volume. It is these purchases, these reinvestments, that will end from the spring of this year. Yes, the question is whether this will affect what is happening on the bond markets. The ECB will apply this in practice in such a way that there is no such fuss and will follow the path of gradual steps. I don't want to get ahead of myself yet. At the moment, specific plans and numbers are just being created. After the next meeting of the Governing Council, there should be information on the volumes, pace and how this process will be applied in practice. Let's move on. What probability do you give that our economy will fall into recession this year? In Slovakia, the probability is small. In the eurozone, it is smaller than we thought a few months ago, but there is still a possibility that some quarter will slip slightly negative numbers on a quarter-on-quarter basis. However, a smoother landing is expected sooner. Of course, the cooling of the economy will come and is already underway to a certain extent, but no one is expecting a noticeable dramatic recession at the moment. So we don't have to worry, for example, about an increase in unemployment in Slovakia? Not in Slovakia, or to a very limited extent, but even then probably in the future. Given that this year we will exist in such a pleasant isolation around us, the situation on the labor market should continue to be favorable, also taking into account the fact that there is still a shortage of labor.

Horvth: Ak vlda dodr svoje suby, ceny u nebud rs tak prudko, hovor hlavn ekonm NBS (e.dennikn.sk) 23. jan 2023 Inflcia na Slovensku dosiahla v decembri 15,4 percenta, rovnak bola aj v novembri. No vrchol zrejme ete nedosiahla, malo by sa tak sta v najblich mesiacoch, predpoklad hlavn ekonm Nrodnej banky Slovenska Michal Horvth. Hovor, e ak vlda dodr slovo a podnikom a domcnostiam bude kompenzova drah energie, inflcia bude niia ako vlani. Priemern inflcia dosiahla minul rok takmer 13 percent, v tomto roku by to mohlo by okolo 10 percent. Verme, e suby, ktor vlda dala obanom, aj napln, hovor. Poda Horvtha v eurozne naalej pretrvvaj rizik, e inflcia me by nad dvojpercentnm inflanm cieom dlh as. V rozhovore ete vrav:  e rast cien potravn na naich regloch by sa mal v tomto roku zmierova,  preo bola decembrov inflcia v Maarsku a 25 percent,  e ochladenie ekonomiky v eurozne prde, ale nejak dramatick recesiu momentlne zrejme nikto neak. Vypoujte si podcast V decembri bola medziron inflcia 15,4 percenta, rovnak bola aj v novembri. Dosiahla u vrchol alebo akte, e bude ete alej rs? Inflcia v decembri bola o osi niia ako nae posledn predikcie. U dlho sa nm nieo tak nestalo. Takmer cel priazniv vplyv na cenov vvoj meme pripsa cenm pohonnch hmt. Oakvame, e inflcia dosiahne vrchol v tchto mesiacoch. Otzka je, ako vysoko bude. V naej predpovedi sme mali, e by inflcia nemala s vrazne vyie, ale zaiatok roka zvykne by vdy pomerne pecifick a mu sa ete udia veci. Vlani vrazne zdraeli potraviny, v decembri v priemere za rok a o 29 percent. Nklady na bvanie stpli o 17 percent. Bud potraviny a energie vrazne rs aj v tomto roku? Poda naich oakvan u nie. A mme na to dobr dvody, e sme optimisti, aspo o sa tka najbliieho vhadu. V prpade cien energi pre domcnosti plat, e sa vlda rozhodla pomerne tedro zakroi a obmedzi rast cien elektriny, plynu, tepla a podobne. o sa tka vvoja cien potravn, ktor ns trpili hlavne v minulom roku, u dlhie vidme, e sa spomauje rast cien ponohospodrskych produktov na svetovch trhoch, o sa postupne bude dostva aj k nm. ie ben zkaznk pocti u aj v obchodoch, e ceny potravn nebud z mesiaca na mesiac skka tak nahor? no, deje sa to vdy s istm odstupom oproti svetovmu dianiu a prve by mali postupne nasledova mesiace, ke by sa u aj rast cien potravn na regloch u ns mal zmierova. o vlastne spsobilo, e ceny ponohospodrskych komodt na burzch klesaj? Ceny potravn boli v uplynulom obdob pohan viacermi vplyvmi. as z nich ete svisela s pandmiou a zotavujcou sa globlnou ekonomikou. Obrovsk vplyv mali ceny energi, ktor ovplyvuj aj ceny hnojv. Niektor ponohospodrske produkty s aj substittom (nhradou - pozn. red.) vo vrobe pohonnch hmt. Niekde vo svete bolo aj zl poasie, o ovplyvnilo ceny kvy, kakaa a podobne. Tieto vplyvy u jednoznane odznievaj a potvrdili nm to aj vrobcovia, nedvno sme s nimi hovorili. Take v tomto roku by u z tohto zdroja nemali prameni tak siln tlaky na zvyovanie cien ako vlani. Vo vvoji cien potravn to bol podstatn faktor. Hovorili ste sa aj s domcimi farmrmi? Diskutovali sme sa s vrobcami, potravinrmi a obchodnmi reazcami. Inflcia vlani v priemere dosiahla takmer 13 percent, o je najviac od roku 1994. Prognzu na tento rok ste postavili na tom, e vlda bude kompenzova podnikom a domcnostiam vysok ceny energi. Aj vzhadom na ten zmtok s vysokmi zlohovmi platbami, ktor dostali v novom roku niektor podniky, stle akte, e bude okolo 10 percent? Verme, e suby, ktor vlda dala obanom, aj napln. Mono to nejde plne hladko, ale verme, e do vekej miery bude plati to, o bolo sben. A je to z hadiska vvoja inflcie na Slovensku plne kov faktor - tieto opatrenia zsadnm spsobom zmenili vhad cenovho vvoja na Slovensku. Mohli vysok zlohov platby niektorch podnikateov zneisti? Mohli preto meni svoje plny? Neviem, to sa asi muste spta podnikateov. Ke sa s nimi rozprvame, povame, e u dlho - v zsade od leta - existuj v podmienkach mimoriadnej neistoty pre ceny energi. Aj vstupy tch, ktor nie s nutne energeticky nron vrobcovia, mu pochdza od takch vrobcov, priom v minulom roku panovala obrovsk neistota, za ak cenu. Samozrejme, tieto dodaton nejasnosti iste neprispeli k dobrej nlade, ale verm, e aj to sa utrasie. o poda vs bude najviac trpi podnikateov v tomto roku? Ceny energi, problmy s dodvkami komponentov, problmy v dodvateskch reazcoch? Aj ceny energi. Podmienky v dodvateskch reazcoch sa globlne zlepili, ale stle povame, e s s tm na Slovensku problmy. V priebehu roka by sa to vak mohlo zlepi. Dleit faktor je vvoj cien energi, naalej vak panuje neistota aj ohadom toho, akou formou a dokedy bude prichdza vldna pomoc. V naich prepotoch sme rtali, e to, o bolo sben teraz ako pomoc do konca jari, bude pokraova do konca roka. Treba to, samozrejme, dotiahnu na vldnej rovni. V decembri sce priemern inflcia bola 15,4 percenta, ale dchodcovsk inflcia a inflcia nzkoprjmovch skupn bola o nieo vyia. Vieme bliie opsa skupiny, na ktor inflcia dopadla najviac? Inflcia momentlne najviac zasahuje poloky, ktor patria do kategrie nevyhnutnch. Ide o potraviny, energie vrtane tepla, dopravu. Osobitne nzkoprjmov udia maj na tieto poloky podstatne viu as svojich prjmov. Keby sme zostrojili spotrebn k nzkoprjmovch skupn vrtane dchodcov, meran inflcia by bola vyia ako priemern sla, ktor sa zverejuj. Rob to vak oficilne tatistick rad. Rta inflciu aj pre dchodcov, kee to nsledne vstupuje aj do valorizanch mechanizmov, na zklade oho sa upravuj kad rok dchodky. Meme detailnejie poveda, kto vetko patr do nzkoprjmovch skupn? S to udia na socilnych dvkach, nezamestnan, udia v hmotnej ndzi, slobodn matky, ktor vychovvaj svoje diea, ie kto vetko? Aj nzkoprjmov zamestnan a ben udia. Mme dta o tom, e by udia menili pre vysok inflciu svoje nkupn sprvanie a nakupovali lacnejie verzie produktov? Nemme o tom vemi dobr dta. Kee sa rozprvame aj s obchodnmi reazcami, mme informcie o tom, ako udia menia to, o nakupuj. Ale zaujmav je to (a vidme to na agregovanch dtach a vyplva to aj z prieskumov), e v prpade takejto situcie, ako je dnes, maj udia tendenciu erpa zo svojich spor. Ani nie tak vemi meni svoje nkupn plny, vrtane vch nkupov tovarov dlhodobej spotreby, ako s chladniky, televzory, ale skr id do svojich spor, pokia nejak maj. Je rozumnejie si teraz tvori viu hotovostn rezervu, alebo radej investova, kee akcie po vlaajch prepadoch zlacneli? Dleit je hlavne nepanikri. udia teraz naprklad dostvaj vpisy z tretieho piliera a aj na vvoji svojich investci vidia, e sla s asto zporn. Minul rok na svetovch akciovch aj dlhopisovch trhoch bol pomerne negatvny, take vea investci stratilo zo svojej hodnoty. Bolo by zl, keby tieto investcie, ktor udia iste pvodne zamali ako nieo dlhodob, momentlne v panike korigovali alebo presvali peniaze niekam inam. Naalej si myslm, e ke m niekto priestor investova dlhodobo, dobre diverzifikovan portfli s rozumnou investciou. Ptali ste sa aj na hotovostn rezervy; je dobr, ak udia maj odloen ekvivalent niekokch mesanch prjmov ako rezervu. Poda dajov Eurostatu sme mali v decembri siedmu najvyiu inflciu v Eurpskej nii. Len o nieo vyiu malo Posko a esk republika, no Maarsko ju malo a 25 percent. Preo bola v Maarsku a tak vysok? Dolo tam k uvoneniu mnohch administratvnych zsahov vldy do cenotvorby, i u v oblasti energi, alebo aj - o asi udia registrovali najviac - pohonnch hmt. Kee pred rokom boli pomerne lacn a teraz ich cena stpla, citene to zvyuje inflciu. V prpade Maarska a aj ostatnch okolitch krajn netreba zabda ani na vvoj vmennho kurzu. Maarsk forint sa v priebehu minulho roka citene oslaboval voi euru aj voi inm svetovm menm. Samozrejme, aj to sa s odstupom premieta do spotrebiteskch cien. Slovensko m vaka euru vhodu nich rokovch sadzieb. Zkladn sadzba Eurpskej centrlnej banky (ECB) je 2,5 percenta, je takmer tretinov v porovnan s eskom alebo Poskom, v Maarsku je sadzba 13 percent. Pjdu tieto roky ete vznamne vyie a ako sa to dotkne roenia hypotk? Trhy oakvaj v prvom polroku alie zvyovanie zkladnej rokovej sadzby ECB niekde na rove medzi 3 a 3,5 percenta. roky na hypotkach s vak zloitejia vec. Jednak s to roky na very s dlhou splatnosou, ale ke hovorme o zkladnej rokovej sadzbe, hovorme o krtkodobej sadzbe. Pri tvorbe dlhodobch rokovch sadzieb sa berie do vahy aj oakvan budci vvoj. Trhy oakvaj, e dlhodob rove sadzieb, konzistentn s inflanm cieom, je niie ako tch 3 a 3,5 percenta. Take pri hypotkach so splatnosou nad tri alebo tyri roky u vstupuje do hry aj tento faktor. Banky maj, samozrejme, svoju vlastn politiku, ktor zohaduje rizikovos klientov, nklady vlastnho financovania a aj maru, ktor odzrkaduje konkurenn prostredie. Vdy je otzka, do akej miery je to u vetko premietnut do existujcich sadzieb. Zrejme tam ete bude pohyb smerom hore. Teraz sa roky naprklad pri 5-ronej fixcii pohybuj u aj okolo tyroch percent. Ke zartame oakvan vvoj kovch sadzieb, potom roky, za ktor si banky poiiavaj peniaze na medzibankovom trhu, a k tomu nejak maru, dostvame sa u aj k piatim percentm tento rok? Nechcel by som pekulova. Je to asi lepia otzka pre ud z prostredia bnk. My to, samozrejme, sledujeme a vyhodnocujeme, ale nechcel by som predikova vvoj. Trhov oakvania s tak, e krtkodob rokov sadzby bud vrcholi v budcom roku a potom by mohlo djs k miernemu poklesu. Zaiatkom februra je prv zasadnutie ECB v tomto roku. Bloomberg priniesol z kulorov banky informciu, e zvauje miernejie zvyovanie sadzieb, ie nie o 50 bodov, ale o 25 bodov. o si o tom myslte? Je to v rukch guvernrov - oni maj na to svoj nzor v zvislosti od toho, ako taj situciu. Aj v eurozne boli posledn dve inflan sla u pomerne priazniv. Do vekej miery za tm stoja faktory ako pokles cien energi na svetovch trhoch, ktor je minimlne do istej miery ovplyvnen vvojom poasia. S krajiny, kde sa tieto vplyvy vemi rchlo premietaj do cien pre spotrebiteov, a to tlailo inflan sla za cel euroznu dole. Navye tam boli rzne vldne zsahy, ktor sa podobaj tomu, o robme aj u ns doma. Cieom je ochrni spotrebiteov od vvoja svetovch cien, akurt opatrenia s rchlejie implementovan a trvaj kratie, a aj tieto ovplyvnili zsadnm spsobom vvoj v decembri. Ide vak o doasn vplyvy, ktor by nemali a natoko ovplyvova rozmanie o tom, kam sa sadzby pohn v budcnosti. Na druhej strane jadrov inflcia, ktor je oisten o tieto pohyblivejie poloky mimo priameho vplyvu centrlnych bnk, naalej rstla. Rizik, e inflcia me by nad inflanm cieom dlhie, naalej pretrvvaj. To by napovedalo tomu, e nie s zsadn dvody meni teraz kurz oproti decembrovej komunikcii. Inflcia v eurozne klesla v decembri z 10,1 percenta na 9,2 percenta, o je viac, ako sa akalo; rstla vak jadrov inflcia, teda ceny ostatnch tovarov a sluieb. Ako to teda ECB ta? Analza je vemi komplexn. Asi najdleitejie je vyhodnotenie aktulnych sel: o znamenaj pre inflan vvoj o nejak rok, rok a pol. Nie je to jednoduch otzka. Vldne intervencie sce mu teraz tlmi inflan vvoj, ale mu znamena, e inflcia v budcnosti bude vyia ako bez nich, teda zvyuj zotrvanos inflcie. To je nieo, na o si centrlne banky dvaj vek pozor. Prve zo zotrvanosti me prameni riziko, e inflcia sa zakoren do ekonomiky a zostane s nami dlhie. Preto nie je jednoduch poveda, e ke sme mali pomerne dobr sla, automaticky to znamen, e meme poavi v tempe sprsovania menovej politiky. U ste spomenuli, e ceny elektriny a plynu na komoditnch burzch klesaj. o to znamen pre naich obanov a pre podniky, a faktry za energie naprklad v roku 2024? Z pohadu firiem, ktor operuj i u na spotovch trhoch, alebo funguj cez krtkodobejie kontrakty, je to jednoznane dobr sprva minimlne v najbliej budcnosti. Nkladov tlaky z tohto zdroja bud menie. Aj pri poklese na svetovch trhoch si treba uvedomi, e do vekej miery to svis s vvojom poasia v Eurpe a svisiacim poklesom dopytu. Take tomuto prbehu ete zaleka nie je koniec, neistota je vek, ceny sa mu vrti sp na vyie rovne. Podstata z pohadu domcnost na Slovensku je to, e aj pri tomto poklese je cenov vhad vy, ako mme v sasnosti. Aj v poslednej predikcii sme upozornili na to, e vldne opatrenia sce vyrieili rok 2023, ale mme pred sebou nevyrieen problm, e ceny energi budeme musie zrelni tak, aby viac zodpovedali vvoju na svetovch trhoch. A tam oakvania do budcna neklesli o toko, aby sme zsadnm spsobom menili vhad na rok 2024 alebo 2025. ie budca vlda bude znova st pred otzkou, i a do akej miery kompenzova rastce ceny energi pre podniky a domcnosti? no. Momentlne sa nachdzame v prostred, ke domcnosti s do vemi vekej miery izolovan od vonkajieho diania vo svete, a niekedy budeme musie ceny zrelni.
