Title: Governor Peter Kaimr: We are halfway, I see no reason to slow down the pace
text: Governor Peter Kazimir: We are halfway there, I see no reason to slow down Pace Jan 23, 2023 The decline in inflation for two months in a row is positive news. However, it is not the reason slow down the pace of rate hikes. The encouraging November and December inflation figures include the "noise" of one-off compensatory measures by governments to mitigate the effects of high energy prices. What is currently the most authoritative from my point of view is the trend of core inflation. Its development confirms the need to continue on the path we have taken. I am convinced that we need to "deliver" another two 50s. The eurozone economy is coping better than expected a month ago or doubts. On the one hand, this is very welcome, but on the other hand, it will have a probably a more moderate dampening effect on the development of price increases. We are halfway there. If it were up to me, I would go on summer vacation with a completed tightening cycle. But today, please don't ask me at what "altitude" we will camp. In translation, how high we will go with the rates, and how long it will take to stay there to tame inflation as it is Necessary. What the summer will be like is therefore a question for meteorologists today.
text_original: Guvernr Peter Kaimr: Sme na polceste, nevidm dvod spomali tempo 23. jan 2023 Pokles inflcie dva mesiace po sebe je pozitvnou sprvou. Nie je vak dvodom spomali tempo zvyovania sadzieb. Povzbudiv novembrov a decembrov inflan sla toti zahaj um jednorazovch kompenzanch opatren vld zmierujcich dopady vysokch cien energi. To, o je z mjho pohadu aktulne najsmerodajnejie, je trend jadrovej inflcie. Jej vvoj potvrdzuje potrebu pokraova na nastpenej ceste. Som presveden, e potrebujeme dorui alie dve 50-tky. Ekonomika eurozny zvlda situciu lepie, ne bolo oakvan pred mesiacom i dvomi. Na jednej strane je to vemi vtan, no na druhej strane to bude ma pravdepodobne miernej tlmiaci inok na vvoj rastu cien. Sme na polceste. Ak by to zlealo odo ma, iiel by som na letn przdniny s ukonenm cyklom sprsovania. Ale dnes sa ma, prosm, neptajte, v akej nadmorskej vke zakempujeme. V preklade, ako vysoko so sadzbami pjdeme, a ako dlho tam bude potrebn pobudn na to, aby sme skrotili inflciu tak, ako je potrebn. To, ak bude leto, je preto dnes otzka pre meteorolgov.

Title: Governor Peter Kaimr: There is no rose without thorns
text: Governor Peter Kazimir: There is no rose without a thorn Feb 3, 2023 With yesterday's decision, we raised the key interest rates to the highest level in the past 15 years. Many will ask why, when the January inflation figures point to a noticeable decline in price growth in the eurozone. It's quite simple. While January's drop in inflation below 9 percent is very welcome, we are still very, very far from the target. We cannot afford to slow down in the pace and based on the data available today, I don't even see a reason for that. At the same time, I am afraid that core inflation may stubbornly remain at too high levels, and that is unacceptable. At the moment when people And businesses get used to high inflation and it translates into expectations, we have a fundamental problem. In March, we intend to continue the established rhythm and raise rates again by 50 basis points. March will also be the month when we will have Updated forecasts on the expected development of the economy and inflation for this and the next two years. It will be the moment for me to start talking about what to do next. Assuming that the March and June estimates show a decline in inflation towards the target, We can begin to cautiously say that we are succeeding in taming the inflationary beast. I think that the March increase will not be the last. About how many more there will be necessary, we will decide later. While we continue to raise rates, financial markets have already begun to speculate about when we will start cutting rates. However, we are not yet at the top And I think we won't be there in March either. At the same time, I would like to reiterate that we will remain at the top. We will remain there until we are sure that we can begin the descent with a clear conscience. In translation, that we can start reducing Rates. It is said that it is better to measure twice and cut once. The fight against inflation is far from won and it will take months before we can say with certainty that we have directed inflation where it belongs.
text_original: Guvernr Peter Kaimr: Niet rue bez ta 3. feb 2023 Verajm rozhodnutm sme zdvihli zkladn rokov sadzby na najvyiu rove za uplynulch 15 rokov. Mnoh sa bud pta, preo, ke janurov sla inflcia poukazuj na citen pokles rastu cien v eurozne. Je to pomerne jednoduch. Aj ke je janurov pokles inflcie pod 9 percent vemi vtan, sme stle vemi, vemi aleko od ciea. Nememe si dovoli poavi v tempe a na zklade dnes dostupnch dt na to ani nevidm dvod. Zrove sa obvam, e jadrov inflcia me tvrdohlavo zotrva na privysokch rovniach a to je neprpustn. V momente, ke si udia a podniky zvykn na vysok inflciu a pretav sa to do oakvan, mme zsadn problm. V marci mme v mysle pokraova v nastolenom rytme a optovne zvi sadzby o 50 bzickch bodov. Marec bude zrove mesiac, ke budeme ma k dispozcii aktualizovan predpovede o oakvanom vvoji ekonomiky a inflcie na tento a najbliie dva roky. Bude to pre ma moment, ke sa zaa rozprva o tom, o alej. Za predpokladu, e marcov a nsledne jnov odhady uku pokles inflcie k cieu, meme zaa opatrne hovori, e sa nm dar kroti inflan betiu. Myslm si, e marcov zvenie nebude posledn. O tom, koko alch bude potrebnch, rozhodneme nsledne. Zatia o my pokraujeme so zvyovanm sadzieb, finann trhy u zaali pekulova o tom, kedy zaneme so zniovanm sadzieb. My vak ete nie sme na vrchole a myslm si, e na om nebudeme ani v marci. Zrove by som rd zopakoval, e na tom vrchole zotrvme. Zotrvme tam tak dlho, km nebudeme ma istotu, e meme s kudnm svedomm zaa zostup. V preklade, e meme zaa so zniovanm sadzieb. Hovor sa, e je lepie dva krt mera a raz striha. Boj s inflciou nie je ani zaleka vyhran a potrv mesiace, ne budeme vedie s istotou poveda, e sme nasmerovali inflciu tam, kam patr.

Title: Opening remarks by the NBS Governor at the conference "Climate and sustainability risks and opportunities"
text: Uvodne slovo guvernera NBS na konferencii Climate and sustainability risks and opportunities PETER KAZIMIR GUVERNER NBS 7. feb 2023 Never was the life of central bankers, businesses, and policy-makers as puzzling and challenging as it is today. The emergence of new structural challenges fundamentally changes the game for all of us.Climate change ranks among the most difficult and ones. Its 2021, its Christmas, and Netflix is releasing a long-awaited movie - Dont look up. The stellar cast is secondary to the story. Two almost unknown astronomers discover a comet rushing towards Earth on a collision course. But paradoxically, this is not the biggest problem. The primary concern is that only some people care. After all, warning and preparing humanity for a life extinction event is very annoying and laborious, and no one knows how to cope. Sad as it may be, this work of fiction carries way too many similarities with our resolve to seek solutions to intensifying impacts of climate change on our lives and the economy. As far as I recall, the most common response to climate change is the question, What does that have to do with me, my business, and our policies". Not so much today, but it can alter our way of life as we know it tomorrow. Many ask whether the consequences of climate change are that ultimate and worrisome. The simple answer to this - Yes, they are. We are beginning to experience it more and more intensely at home, in the country we know best. No other country has, compared to its size, as many mineral springs as Slovakia, water-rich for centuries - and yet we suffer from droughts. In January, the Slovak Hydrometeorological Institute published a report on the last years drought in Slovakia. The year 2022 was exceptional in terms of drought occurrence in Slovakia. Arid conditions occurred in more than half of the country, and the drought duration in some places was more than 200 days. In most districts in Slovakia, the harvest was meagre, and the drought significantly affected forest ecosystems." Lets rewind and look at what all this has to do with central bankers. The role of a central bank is not to pivot. Its primarily up to the governments, academia, innovators and businesses. They are the first line of defense. Our role is more of a facilitator, and were enablers. Still. How does it all relate to the financial sectors stability, sustainability and resilience of the financial system, policy-makers, businesses, and us? The topic of todays conference is Sustainability opportunities and risks in the context of the impacts of climate change. Since childhood, all of us have been indoctrinated and guided by our parents not to put off until tomorrow what can be done and fixed today. A wise, often annoying principle. Nevertheless, well on the spot. The devils advocate would raise a hand and remind me that future generations will be more innovative and have enhanced and cutting-edge technologies dwarfing todays capabilities. As a result, they will be able to solve problems insurmountable for us today. Sure, but it can be too late. Its called the tragedy of the time horizon. The National bank of Slovakia, the ECB and other central banks and supervisors from around the world can and will play its part and help the change to happen ... within our mandates. Rigorous analyses will be a crucial tool and we have a platform for that, the NGFS. NGFS has developed a typical picture of what our economies might look like under different assumptions, together with leading academic climate institutions. These are called climate scenarios11. Were starting to better understand risks related to the green transition; we can now identify physical and macro-financial risks. These climate scenarios can help policy-makers, financial institutions, businesses and the public to deal with the uncertainty ahead. We cant fix everything today; we wont and dont need to. So we need to stay agile but realistic. The last thing is to overburden, to over-regulate the financial system and do more harm than damage. There are five things for us to do:  to help to steer the public debate,  to drive collaboration among the central banks, market supervisors, here the NGFS is vital,  to assist financial institutions with the transition,  invest in data collection, quality and granularity of data, analyse them and create scenarios  enhance our models and forecasting to understand climate change impacts on inflation better. All this is doable and already in motion. I am optimistic that together we can manage even these challenges. Allow me to conclude with a quote by Albert Comus Real generosity toward the future lies in giving all to the present.

Title: Governor Peter Kaimr: We can sleep peacefully
text: PETER KAzIMiR GOVERNOR OF THE NBS PETER KAzIMiR GOVERNOR OF THE NBS Mar 17, 2023 The turbulence of the past days has "revived" memories of times long past. Images of sleepless nights spent trying to protect Europe from collapse came to life, and it was not easy to resist them. The benefit and huge advantage of the aforementioned sleepless nights is that today we can, you can, sleep peacefully. I do not see the current events as a pilot episode of a new global mess. Rather, it is a reminder of the need to be careful. For years, I have been hearing how we are suffocating the financial sector by over-regulation, how counterproductive it is. I didn't agree then, and I don't agree today. Today, we can lean on what is often called the "straitjacket" of banks and sleep contentedly, knowing that even in the case of major problems, we are able to handle the situation. That is why we continued to tighten our monetary policy yesterday. From my point of view, the increase in base interest rates by 50 basis points was inevitable and necessary. Even the current events on the financial markets do not change anything in my opinion that it is necessary to continue. I am very well aware of the delicacy of the situation, but at the same time I think that despite the bumpy road we are on, we are not yet at the finish line. Core inflation is stubbornly "sticky". The steps we have taken since July last year are bearing fruit and we are starting to see the effects. Higher interest rates are starting to work. Today, it is useless to speculate what will happen in May. Let's wait. There are risks to inflation on both sides, but from my point of view, there are much greater upside risks. The development of core inflation, how wages will move, how profitability will develop businesses at a time of receding inflation, how quickly and targeted they will respond fiscally Politicians will co-decide when we stop raising rates. The ability of governments to take off the gas will be (together) crucial. I mean what the departure from support and compensation measures will look like. Politics is a fickle thing. The elections, in some countries, including Slovakia, are certainly not conducive to efforts to gradually and sensibly end support for the pandemic-era economy. From the point of view of inflation, fiscal policy is a risk that must not be underestimated. Some countries are more affected, others less. Slovakia is in the first group. I am satisfied with Thursday's decision and fully support it. The captain of the ship must not deviate from the course just because a crosswind suddenly hits the boat. In my opinion, the current view of the future development of inflation over the entire horizon of our forecast period speaks clearly in favour of the need to continue. Whether, how vigorously, in how many steps and to where ... will show the time, the data.
text_original: Guvernr Peter Kaimr: Meme(-te) pokojne spva PETER KAIMR GUVERNR NBS 17. mar 2023 Turbulentnos uplynulch dn oivila spomienky na asy dvno minul. Obrazy bezsennch noc strvench snahou ochrni Eurpu pred kolapsom oili a nebolo jednoduch sa im ubrni. Prnosom a obrovskou vhodou spomnanch bezsennch noc je to, e dnes meme, mete, pokojne spva. Sasn dianie nevnmam ako pilotn epizdu novej globlnej lamastiky. Je to skr pripomenutie potreby ma sa na pozore. Roky povam, ako prlinou regulciou dusme finann sektora ak kontraproduktvne to je. Neshlasil som vtedy, neshlasm ani dnes. O to, o sa asto nazva kazajkou bnk, sa dnes meme oprie a spokojne spva s vedomm, e aj v prpade zsadnch problmov sme schopn dan situciu zvldnu. Aj preto sme vera pokraovali v sprsovan nastavenia naej menovej politiky. Zvenie zkladnch rokovch sadzieb o 50 bzickch bodov bolo z mjho pohadu nevyhnutn a potrebn. Ani aktulne dianie na finannch trhoch nemen ni na mojom nzore, e je treba pokraova. Vemi dobre si uvedomujem deliktnos situcie, no zrove si myslm, e napriek hrboatosti cesty po ktorej ideme, ete nie sme v cieli. Jadrov inflcia je tvrdohlavo lepkav. Kroky, ktor sme podnikli od jla minulho roku, prinaj ovocie a zaname vidie inky. Vyie rokov sadzby zanaj fungova. Dnes je zbyton pekulova, o sa udeje v mji. Pokajme si. Rizik pri inflcii existuj na oboch stranch, no z mjho pohadu s ovea vie rizik smerom nahor. Vvoj jadrovej inflcie, to ako sa bud hba mzdy, ako sa bude vyvja ziskovos podnikov v ase ustupujcej inflcie, ako rchlo a adresne bud reagova fiklne politiky spolurozhodn o tom, kedy prestaneme so zvyovanm sadzieb. Schopnos vld ubra z plynu bude (spolu) rozhodujca. Mm na mysli to, ako bude vyzera odchod od podpornch a kompenzanch opatren. Politika je vec vrtkav. Voby, v niektorch krajinch vrtane Slovenska, urite nepraj snahm postupne a rozumne ukoni podporu ekonomiky z ias pandmie. Fiklna politika je z pohadu inflcie riziko, ktor nesmieme podceni. Niektorch krajn sa to tka viac, inch menej. Slovensko je v tej prvej skupine. So tvrtkovm rozhodnutm som spokojn a plne ho podporujem. Kapitn lode nesmie uhn z kurzu len preto, e sa zrazu do lode oprie bon vietor. Aktulny pohad na budci vvoj inflcie na celom horizonte nami prognzovanho obdobia hovor poda ma jasne v prospech potreby pokraova. To, i, ako razantne, v kokch krokoch a a kam ... uke as, dta.

Title: Interview of Governor Peter Kaimr for Hospodrske noviny
text: Interview of Governor Peter Kazimir for Hospodarske noviny May 14, 2023  In an interview with NBS Governor Peter Kazimir, you will find out what the situation is like at the central bank after the bank's key figures moved to a caretaker government.  The NBS Governor also revealed how he perceives the current economic situation in the Slovakia. He also spoke about the economic growth forecast by the bank in the short and medium term, and when prices stop rising so sharply.  Peter Kazimir will also open a window into thinking in the ECB's Governing Council And he will present his idea of how far interest rates in the eurozone can rise.  The NBS Governor also commented on the corruption case he is facing. The Prime Minister of the caretaker government will be the Deputy Governor of the NBS, udovit odor and the bank's chief economist Michal Horvath is likely to be the finance minister. How do you evaluate it? I know both gentlemen very well. I have been professionally working with ud odor for more than 20 years, we have collaborated on important projects and I have twice proposed him for the important positions. For the first time, he will join the founding line-up of the Budget Council responsibility and then to the position of Vice-Governor of the NBS. Michal Horvath, we persuaded him to come to Slovakia from Great Britain, where he was an established academics at Oxford before the introduction of the euro in 2007, after which we remained in contact and after I joined the NBS, he has been very successful as the chief economist. He can explain things that are not very understandable in a semi-pathetic and simple language, but he has a talent for being able to present things in such a way that we can all understand them better. It is an honour for the NBS, because we are a good personnel reservoir, and I do not want to get ahead of myself, but maybe they are not the only people who will leave the NBS for a while. I take it that it is a service to the country, even if it represents a certain discomfort. But we can do it. And about the caretaker government, I have heard that it is not a constitutionally correct term, because it is a government like any other that will seek confidence with its program statement. I had the honour of talking to both gentlemen about what they want to do in the coming months, and although they will certainly tell you themselves, these are things that the country definitely needs and that we will probably talk about today in this interview. What is the perspective of these gentlemen on a possible return to the NBS? As for ud odor, and for me it will always be the People's Government, the post of Deputy Governor is not compatible with the performance of the function of the Prime Minister, so he is in the process of resigning. He is leaving his post nine months before the end of his mandate. And everyone else is as if on unpaid leave. This means that they will be entitled to return and we will be very happy if they return. Do you have in mind the names of the candidates you would like to work with, or Will you keep a spot on the original people? We will keep their fingers crossed in any case. udo odor and Michal Horvath are my closest collaborators, all the people from the inside will confirm that. And in recent years, we have They devoted themselves to bringing new blood to the bank, so that they could internationalize. We have a German in the position of head of research, even though he has a permanent contract with the ECB. We have withdrawn it from the Vienna Institute. We have analysts of different nationalities, not only from Europe, but also from other parts of the world. And at the same time, we have good old colleagues who have been working at NBS for decades. So for those few months, we have sufficient capacity to replace people who will devote themselves to other activities. Vision of the economic future according to the NBS Let's move on to the economy. In the spring forecast, you revised economic growth for this year significantly downwards, but you revised future years upwards. If this What does this mean for our economy, our salaries and prices? The forecast is made by analysts, not governors. And when they came up with the new numbers, they were happy that it was not so different from the previous forecast. Because in this period of fundamental changes, it is not easy to forecast and neither analysts nor the public are happy about it. It detracts from credibility and, above all, increases uncertainty. Title: Governor Peter Kaimr: Under the top?
text: PETER KAzIMiR GOVERNOR OF THE NBS PETER KAzIMiR GOVERNOR OF THE NBS July 28, 2023 Yesterday's expected and ninth increase in interest rates brought us within reach of the peak of our efforts. In other words, we are nearing the completion of the tightening of the monetary policy stance necessary to restore price stability. It is great that inflation continues to fall, from the point of view of households, businesses and the economy as a whole. However, we will not see a drop to the desired level of two percent either this year and next year. In the case of Slovakia, this decline will most likely last much longer. While headline inflation continues to slow down, mainly due to external factors, core inflation remains at a record high. From my point of view, this means that we need to be extremely vigilant for the future. It is core inflation that hides risks for overall inflation. It is the core inflation figures that show that we have not won yet. I continue to see inflation risks clearly to the upside. Despite the anemic growth of the eurozone economy, the labor market remains "hot". The shortage of people in the labor market, combined with high inflation, puts pressure on wage growth, which helps consumption and affects prices. It is the people and households with the lowest incomes who suffer the most from high prices, and the sooner we deal with high inflation, the better. We continue to live in uncertainty, both in terms of inflation and the economy. Effects of the collapse The validity of the Black Sea Grain Deal on prices cannot yet be fully evaluated at this time. We will see what the impact will be on the commodity market and on prices Food. Endless heat and drought will also take their toll on food prices. We do not yet know the cumulative impact of the tightening in full force on the economy. We evaluate it continuously and we will be wiser in the fall. The closer we are to the top, the more important it is to comprehensively evaluate the situation. I don't have an answer to what will come in September. Today, I would say that our mission is still not fulfilled and that we should continue with a firm step on the path to top. Even if we were to take a pause in September, it would be premature to consider it automatically after the end of the cycle. This will be decided by the incoming data on the economy. We are like climbers looking for the safest place to decide overnight. In the middle of unknown mountains and in constantly changing weather. It's just that we are looking for the right place where we intend to stay for a large part of next year. And you will admit that then it must be a place where we all have to have a little Enjoy. With such a large expedition as the Governing Council, this is not an easy task. Recently, there have been complaints and outcry that the ECB's actions are suffocating economic growth and harm. I absolutely disagree with this. Yes, the increase in interest rates is noticeable in the decline in the interest of companies and people loans. However, we are not suffocating the economy. The problem of shouting is elsewhere and is long-term. It lies in the lack of reforms, in the ailing public finances, weak public investment in future growth, innovation and modernisation. This is our Achilles' heel and if anyone wants to point the finger at the causes of stagnation, they should look in this direction, and not at the ECB.

Title: Governor Peter Kaimr: The long-awaited "pause" has arrived
text: Governor Peter Kazimir: The long- expected pause button pushed PETER KAZIMIR GOVERNOR 30 Oct 2023 As widely expected, weve hit the pause button on Thursday to thoroughly assess the strengthening impacts of our policy decisions on inflation and the eurozone economy. A large chunk of our past decisions still needs to transpire into the real economy. All those voices coining this as the end of the cycle should hold their horses. Its too soon to declare victory and say the jobs done. As much as I would like this to be the end of the path, upside inflation risks have yet to dissipate entirely. We must stay vigilant. Long story short, additional tightening could come, if incoming data force us to take such a step. Therefore, I will eagerly await the December update of our inflation forecast to get a clearer picture, confirmation, that the decline in inflation is sustained. I hope that renewed upside inflation risks from the escalating tragic conflict in the Middle East will not materialize. The eurozones economy, already exposed to a combination of growth-slowing factors, struggles to regain momentum. December forecasts are one of two key milestones needed to pass. March is the latter. By then, it should have become clearer how wage negotiations for the whole year turned out and whether the risks of a spiral of high prices and high wages were off the table. Only then will we be able to say the tightening cycle is completed and move on to the subsequent - monitoring - phase. As I have said several times, we will have to stay at the peak for the next few quarters. Bets on rate cuts happening already in the first half of next year are entirely misplaced. The December meeting is going to be a very interesting one.

Title: NBS analyst Roman Vrbovsk: We do not see many factors that should restart the growth of apartment prices (Dennk N)
text: NBS analyst Roman Vrbovsky: We don't see many factors that would They were supposed to restart price growth apartments (Dennik N) Dec 22, 2022 The average price of flats and houses has been falling since July and the lower interest in real estate will last for some time, predicts a mathematician and real estate analyst at the National Bank Slovak Roman Vrbovsky. According to him, in the last quarter of this year, it will probably turn out that real estate prices will be lower compared to the third quarter. One of the reasons is higher interest rates on mortgages, another is the high number of apartments under construction. Vrbovsky also says that the availability of housing in Slovakia has deteriorated significantly. Although it has been deteriorating since 2019, because real estate prices have grown faster than wages, However, in the second quarter of 2022, another reason was added - an increase in interest rates. "More people who are interested in becoming independent will rather reach for sublet housing. That's why we see room for growth there," he explains. What development of real estate prices do you expect next year? We assume that we will already see a quarter-on-quarter decline in prices this quarter. We also expect that the scissors between the new and the old should be opened more Realtor. High prices of building materials will not allow prices to In new buildings, they corrected more significantly. This reason will not be present in older properties. So the prices of old apartments should go down in the coming months, but with Isn't it the same in new buildings? Yes, this is to be expected. It is obvious that mortgage interest rates will continue to rise next year. Will this push real estate prices down even more? We see the rise in interest rates as one of the main reasons why we will probably be talking about a decline in real estate prices this quarter. There are people who would qualify to get a mortgage at lower interest rates, and now they no longer qualify. Another thing is that households basically expected interest rates to rise in the first half of the year, and they tried to get ahead of themselves in how to get a loan as quickly as possible and buy a property as quickly as possible. We take this as one of the factors why real estate prices rose so significantly in the first and second quarters. In the first quarter, they grew by more than 8 percent quarter-on-quarter, in the second by more than 6 percent. It turned around in July, when the "frontloading" ended and at the same time it had already begun more significantly interest rates. Since July, the average price of real estate has been slowly falling. So in the last quarter, the activity on the real estate market is not so great and it will probably be confirmed that price growth is slowing down? Yes. The interest in real estate has influenced the fact that loans are more expensive, and many of those who wanted to buy real estate preferred to do so during the first half of the year and, naturally, are no longer interested in buying another one. Since mortgages have become more expensive, can we say that the availability of housing has deteriorated? That's right, it has been deteriorating since 2019, but relatively slowly. The primary reason was that real estate prices grew faster than wages, which we have talked about several times. The change occurred in the second quarter of 2022, when availability was already deteriorating also because interest rates were rising, which is now the main reason. Real estate prices increased by only 1.6 percent compared to the second quarter and interest rates grew significantly faster. If we wanted housing affordability not to deteriorate between the second and third quarters, then real estate prices would have to decrease by 4 percent, according to our calculations. However, even in the second quarter, availability was well above the long-term average. That is why we consider that the possibilities for real estate prices to rise are limited. Is it true that the worst housing availability is in Liptov and the Tatras? In our analyses, we do not look at such micro-regions, but at the regions. The worst housing availability is in the zilina and Presov regions. However, tourist regions such as the Tatras and Liptov contribute the most to the price increase. When we look at how prices and wages change in the given regions, these regions have the biggest disproportions. This is also due to the fact that real estate is also bought there by people who live there do not have permanent residence, i.e. for the purpose of recreation. Let's move on to real estate prices for next year. This year we have also seen year-on-year price increases by more than a fifth. So it won't be like that next year? At the moment, we do not see many factors that should restart price growth real estate in the next year. We do not expect interest rates to start fall. If you look at our forecast, it is slightly optimistic, with the fact that our expectations for a recession next year have eased to some extent. However, we do not expect the economy to experience any significant expansion. The only thing that can pull prices up is wage growth. Even now, we can see that wages are not growing as fast as inflation, but their growth is almost double-digit. We assume that relatively strong wage growth will continue at the beginning of next year. Overall, real wage growth should be positive in 2023. Demand pressures may stem from this. The number of completed apartments on the market has increased significantly, with almost 82 thousand apartments under construction. How are we supposed to read this? This is one of the highest numbers in history. We see this as another indicator that tells us that this is an impulse that will push prices down when these apartments hit the market. So is the buyer's position stronger now and he has more time to Has he thought about buying the apartment? That's how I see it too. And I think that's a good thing to a certain extent. I read a lot of media information about how buyers had to compete and make decisions about buying an apartment basically on the first inspection and then bid on the price. I don't think it was a healthy behavior in the market, I assume that it will now return to a healthier state. Some developers are already making it clear that more apartments will be built with smaller yardage as before. Do you also perceive such tendencies on the market? I can only rely on aggregate statistics published by the Statistical Office. According to these data, the average area of completed dwellings does not change significantly and has remained roughly at the same numbers for many years. When developers talk about the fact that they also do marketing campaigns, such as the kitchen included in the price, does it surprise you? This corresponds to the fact that, in our opinion, the real estate market is cooling, which means that interest in real estate has decreased. Since the factors that will act on the slowdown prevail price increase, I think that such practices can easily continue in the future. Of course, it depends on the individual developers, unless they want to join to change the price. The main conclusion is that the cooling of the market will probably stay for some time. So will this not only apply to 2023, but maybe also to 2024? We are already talking about this very far ahead, given how uncertain there is in our predictions for 2023. Developments in the labour market will be decisive. There was also a lot of talk about whether we had a real estate bubble on the market. How do you see it now? Last year, we have stated that we consider real estate prices to be overvalued, they are growing faster than they should. We see the cooling of the market that we have now as a natural balancing of the overly dynamic price development that we have been experiencing lately. Let's move on to rents. Rental prices rose in the third quarter compared to the second quarter at almost twice the pace of real estate prices. Is this still true today? I think that in the long run, the decisive factor will be the fact that housing in one's own home is becoming less affordable and more difficult to achieve. So more people who are interested in becoming independent will rather reach for sublet housing. That's why we see room for growth there. Going back to the numbers, yes, it is true that in the third quarter they grew almost twice as fast as real estate prices compared to the second quarter, but while real estate prices rose by almost 22 percent year-on-year, rents by less than 10 percent. It is not unreasonable to expect that in the first half of next year there will be landlords will also reflect increased energy prices in prices. Do you think the purchase of investment apartments is still interesting? Price and financial market developments would suggest that they should be clearly less attractive. This is somewhat at odds with the fact that in Slovakia, real estate investments are perceived as the most typical form of storing monetary value. So I think they will still be popular to some extent. Many people are counting on price growth to be to continue into the distant future. I would be more cautious and would not apply this rule to all sites. This will be true in touristically attractive locations or in city centers, but since In the long run, we perceive demographic problems for Slovakia, this may not be true everywhere. The working-age population will decline and there will also be relatively less demand than we see today. However, this may not be the case at all in some locations. However, I think that money can be invested much more productively than in investment apartments. For example, in actions? For example, in promotions or ideally in your own business, or its expansion. Only then would I maybe look for residential real estate. What is the development of prices of family houses? At the moment, the development of prices of apartments and houses is quite balanced. Especially after the corona crisis, the prices of family houses rose much faster. People were interested in larger properties. There is also another explanation: in suburban areas or villages that located in the vicinity of cities, average real estate prices were lower than in city centers, and households preferred to reach for them. Let's take a look at Holy's rental apartments. So far, the government has approved two investment contracts with private investors. Will this scheme affect the rental market for Slovakia? We see this as an increase in supply. More households will have a choice of whether to live in your own or in a sublease, and this should ultimately reduce the pressure on real estate prices. text_original: Analytik NBS Roman Vrbovsk: Nevidme vea faktorov, ktor by mali znovu natartova rast cien bytov (Dennk N) 22. dec 2022 Priemern cena bytov a domov od jla kles a ni zujem o nehnutenosti ete nejak as potrv, predpoklad matematik a realitn analytik Nrodnej banky Slovenska Roman Vrbovsk. Myslm si, e na dlhie obdobie bude rozhodujcim faktorom prve to, e sa bvanie vo vlastnom stva menej dostupnm a aie dosiahnutenm. ie viac ud, ktor maj zujem osamostatni sa, bude siaha skr po bvan v podnjme. Preto tam vidme priestor na rast. Ke sa ete vrtime k slam, no, je pravda, e v treom tvrroku rstli v porovnan s druhm takmer dvojnsobnm tempom ako ceny nehnutenost, ale km medzirone ceny nehnutenost stpli o takmer 22 percent, njomn o necelch 10 percent. Nie je nerozumn oakva, e v prvej polovici budceho roka bud prenajmatelia premieta do cien aj zven ceny energi. Je kpa investinch bytov poda vs ete zaujmav? Cenov vvoj a vvoj na finannom trhu by hovoril, e by mali by jednoznane menej atraktvne. To sa trochu bije s tm, e na Slovensku s investcie do nehnutenost vnman ako tak najtypickejia forma uchovvania peanej hodnoty. Take si myslm, e bud do istej miery stle populrne. Mnoh udia potaj s tm, e rast cien bude pokraova do alekej budcnosti. Bol by som obozretnej a neuplatoval by som toto pravidlo na vetky lokality. V turisticky atraktvnych lokalitch i v centrch miest to bude plati, ale kee v dlhodobom vhade vnmame pre Slovensko demografick problmy, nemus to plati plne vade. Bude klesa poet populcie v produktvnom veku a bude aj relatvne men dopyt, ako vidme dnes. To vak v niektorch lokalitch nemus vbec plati. Myslm si vak, e peniaze sa daj investova ovea produktvnejie ako do investinch bytov. Naprklad do akci? Naprklad do akci alebo idelne do vlastnho podnikania, prpadne jeho rozirovania. A potom by som sa mono pozeral po rezidennch nehnutenostiach. Ak je vvoj cien rodinnch domov? Momentlne je vvoj cien bytov a domov dos vyrovnan. Hlavne po koronakrze ovea rchlejie rstli ceny rodinnch domov. udia mali zujem o rozahlejie nehnutenosti. Nka sa aj in vysvetlenie: v prmestskch astiach alebo v dedinch, ktor sa nachdzaj v okol miest, boli priemern ceny nehnutenost niie ako v centrch miest a domcnosti radej siahali po nich. Pozrime sa ete na Holho njomn byty. Vlda zatia schvlila dve investin zmluvy so skromnmi investormi. Ovplyvn tto schma trh njmov na Slovensku? Vnmame to ako zvenie ponuky. Viac domcnost bude ma k dispozcii vobu, i bva vo vlastnom alebo v podnjme, a to by malo v konenom dsledku aj zni tlak na ceny nehnutenost. Title: Director of the NBS Financial Consumer Protection Department Roman Fusek in RTVS Morning News: How to buy gifts and maintain the family budget
text: Roman Fusek, Director of the Financial Consumer Protection Department of the NBS, RTVS Morning News: How to Buy gifts and maintain a family budget Dec 22, 2022 Jana Kosikova, moderator: "Christmas is a time of increased spending. This year, this will be doubly true due to higher inflation. How to buy gifts at the last minute and not burden the family budget. This is what the Director of the Financial Consumer Protection Department at the National Bank of Slovakia, Roman Fusek, will advise us, good morning." Roman Fusek, Director of the Financial Consumer Protection Department, National Bank Slovakia: "Good morning." Jana Kosikova: "There are really only a few days left until Christmas, it can be said that The Christmas shopping frenzy is culminating in the shops. Advise our viewers on how to Not to fall for that impulsive last-minute shopping." Roman Fusek: "Well, if you haven't bought gifts yet, it's really quite late..." Jana Kosikova: "I already have." Roman Fusek: "And if you are the kind of person who has a tendency to spend, then maybe you need to keep a little distance. Even if we already feel the pressure, let's say the pressure of the coming Christmas, it's good to take a little distance, make a shopping list, for example. This is such a completely simple recipe for how to go shopping. A few such basic principles apply to impulse buying. It's better to shop with cash as with a credit or payment card, because with cash we are not They spend money harder than from a credit card. It is better to shop offline than online, although sometimes we are under pressure again and want to buy in the online environment, so we succumb very easily to that impulse, I see something, I buy right away. Of course, if I'm under pressure from the fact that I have to buy gifts and I don't have money, then we, at the National Bank of Slovakia, rather advise not to take out a loan for gifts, that is, not to buy gifts for loans, do not take a loan on vacation, because you will be happy about those gifts for a short time, or your loved ones, but then you will repay for a long, several years." Jana Kosikova: "A lot of people are getting into debt right now during Christmas. When is it worth it Is an overdraft allowed on the account and when a credit card and what should you pay attention to when buying in installments?" Roman Fusek: "If we are talking about such a ready-made loan, or a loan that I have immediate access to, then it is the permitted overdraft or credit card. From the point of view of a debt spiral, or as an unhealthy debt, it is the most dangerous tool. So it's good to know how to use it. When we talk about a credit card, you need to have one basic habit with it. And it is that if you use it during the month, you will pay off the debt you made on your credit card during the interest-free period. That is, during that period of 30 to 50 days within that monthly purchase period, then you do not pay any interest. If you miss this period, you will already pay interest, which is relatively high. And if you get into the situation that you draw from the card and gradually repay, then you can get into a debt spiral, because you are still drawing a loan, you are repaying at the same time, you are not able to pay off the entire debt on the card, it can be a problem. The same problem can occur with an authorized overdraft. That's why it's good to think about when I'm going to take such a product. Again, when I know that I am subject to an impulse, it is better not to use it, to take cash." Jana Kosikova: "Can you give our viewers some advice, tips on how to save money on shopping for Christmas presents?" Roman Fusek: "We have already talked about the fact that the impulse sometimes means that An unexpected purchase, I didn't plan it, I had some other intention and I'm going to buy it anyway. So again, I'll just go back to the fact that it's a good idea to prepare that shopping list. And how to avoid actually buying as if it were useless, again, there is a kind of mental trick stop button. If it seems to me that there is already too much, then I can put a stop to myself in a way that, for example, to this store for a week or a month I don't enter and check myself. It's so that I don't disturb myself, whether in that in the pre-Christmas period, or in any such critical period, the summer is also sometimes critical, we want some vacation, so as not to disturb my healthy ones measure of the domestic budget and was able to return to the fact that I would be able to properly repay all my liabilities in that normal period." Jana Kosikova: "The post-Christmas period is then associated with sales, which are literally at every turn. Is there a risk of possible indebtedness?" Roman Fusek: "There is, of course. Sales are just the most critical part when it comes to shops' own or sales practices, so of course they are aimed at making people succumb to a high discount. They succumb to the fact that something is very, very advantageous and do not check whether it is really true. The first thing that is very important when selling is to check if it is really a discount. Sometimes it is really unfair practices of sellers that the goods are discounted just a few days before the sale, but otherwise it is basically a regular price. And then again, to go back to the fact that if, for example, I want to compare myself with someone and someone already has it and I don't have it yet and they have it on sale, then I'd better do it again, keep my distance, have that coffee, have tea, Exhale, and then come back to whether it is really necessary to buy in that sale." Jana Kosikova: "How is it possible when it comes to taking loans for gifts compared to the past. Are people taking more of those loans during this period, are they getting into more debt?" Roman Fusek: "During the calendar year, we have verified that the pre-Christmas period is a period of increased interest in consumer loans, but if we are talking about the periods of recent years, we do not see any fundamental change in how people whether they take out more consumer loans than in the previous year Period. As for the numbers for this year, we will see, of course, only in the spring, or in the first quarter of next year, but what is such that some very basic advice is that you definitely do not take out the loan for gifts. It's always better, and maybe even when it comes to your loved ones, they will be happier when you don't get into debt and get maybe something smaller, smaller and from the heart, than if you had to tie a two-year, three-year, or five-year repayment schedule around your neck." Jana Kosikova: "Above all, people should not succumb to impulsive shopping now in this period. Mr. Fusek, thank you very much for this up-to-date information, for accepting the invitation to the studio. Have a nice day again." Roman Fusek: "Thank you very much and have a nice day." text_original: Riadite odboru ochrany finannch spotrebiteov NBS Roman Fusek v Rann sprvy RTVS: Ako kpi dareky a udra rodinn rozpoet 22. dec 2022 Jana Kokov, modertorka: Vianoce s obdobm zvench vdavkov. V tomto roku to bude kvli vyej inflcii plati dvojnsobne. Ako na posledn chvu nakpi dareky a nezaai pri tom rodinn rozpoet. To nm porad riadite odboru ochrany finannch spotrebiteov z Nrodnej banky Slovenska Roman Fusek, dobr rno. Roman Fusek, riadite odboru ochrany finannch spotrebiteov, Nrodn banka Slovenska: Dobr rno. Jana Kokov: Do Vianoc zostva naozaj u len pr dn, d sa poveda, e v obchodoch vrchol ten vianon nkupn oia. Porate naim divkom, ako neprepadn tomu impulzvnemu nakupovaniu na posledn chvu. Roman Fusek: No, ak ete nemte nakpen dareky, tak u je naozaj, e pomerne neskoro... Jana Kokov: Ja u mm. Roman Fusek: A ak teda ste tak ten lovek, ktor m tendenciu k maniu, tak je potrebn mono si necha troku odstup. Aj ke ctime u tlak, povedzme aj ten tlak prichdzajcich Vianoc, tak je dobr urobi si troku odstup, urobi si naprklad nkupn zoznam. To je tak plne e jednoduch recept, akm spsobom s nakupova. Pri impulzvnom nakupovan plat pr takch zkladnch zsad. Je lepie nakupova s hotovosou ako s kreditnou, alebo platobnou kartou, pretoe pri hotovosti sa nm maj peniaze aie ako z kreditky. Je lepie nakupova offline, ako online, aj ke u niekedy sme zasa pod tlakom a chceme nakpi v online prostred, tak tam podliehame vemi ahko prve tomu impulzu, nieo vidm, hne nakpim. Samozrejme, ak som pod tlakom u toho, e musm kpi dareky a nemm peniaze, tak skr my, v Nrodnej banke Slovenska radme nebra si piku na dareky, to znamen nenakupova dareky na very, nebra si na dovolenku ver, pretoe budete ma sce kratuko rados z tch darekov, alebo vai blzki, ale potom budete dlho, niekoko rokov splca. Jana Kokov: Vea ud sa zadluje prve teraz poas Vianoc. Kedy sa oplat povolen preerpanie na te a kedy kreditn karta a na o si treba dva pozor pri nkupe na spltky? Roman Fusek: Ak sa bavme o takom hotovom vere, alebo o vere, ku ktormu mm hne prstup, tak to je prve to povolen preerpanie, alebo kreditn karta. Z hadiska dlhovej pirly, prpadne toho ako nezdravho zadlenia, je to najnebezpenej nstroj. ie je dobr ho vedie pouva. Ke sa bavme o kreditnej karte, tak pri nej muste ma jeden zkladn nvyk. A to je ten, e ak ju pouvate poas mesiaca, tak splatte ten dlh, ktor si ste si urobili na kreditnej karte poas bezronho obdobia. Teda poas toho obdobia 30 a 50 dn v rmci toho mesanho nkupnho obdobia, vtedy neplatte iadny rok. Ak toto obdobie previhnete, tak u budete plati roky, ktor s pomerne vysok. A ak sa dostanete do toho, e budete erpa z karty a postupne aj splca, tak sa mete dosta prve do dlhovej pirly, lebo stle ete naerpvate ver, popri tom splcate, nedokete vysplca cel ten dlh na karte, me to by problm. Rovnak problm me nasta aj pri povolenom preerpan. Preto je dobr zas uvaova o tom, kedy si takto produkt zoberiem. Optovne ke viem, e podlieham impulzu, radej ho nepouva, zobra si hotovos. Jana Kokov: Mete da naim divkom nejak rady, typy, ako uetri pri nakupovan vianonch darekov? Roman Fusek: U sme sa bavili o tom, e ten impulz znamen niekedy tak e neoakvan nkup, aj som to neplnoval, aj som mal nejak in zmer a napriek tomu to nakpim. Take op, vrtim sa len k tomu, e je dobr si pripravi ten nkupn zoznam. No a ako sa vyhn vlastne kupovaniu ako keby zbytonost, zas, existuje tak akoe mentlny trik stop tlaidlo. Ak sa mi zd, e u je toho vea, tak si mem da stopku spsobom, e naprklad do tohto obchodu na tde, alebo na mesiac nevstpim a kontrolujem sa. Je to kvli tomu, aby som si nenaruil, i u v tom predvianonom obdob, alebo v akomkovek takom obdob kritickom, to leto bva tie niekedy kritick, chceme nejak dovolenku, tak aby som si nenaruil tak tie zdrav miery domceho rozpotu a vedel sa vrti k tomu, e v tom benom obdob budem vedie riadne splca vetky svoje zvzky. Jana Kokov: S povianonm obdobm sa potom spjaj vpredaje, ktor s doslova na kadom kroku. Hroz tu prpadn zadlenie? Roman Fusek: Hroz, samozrejme. Vpredaj je prve tak t najkritickejia as pokia ide o nkupn vlastn, alebo predajn praktiky obchodov, tak samozrejme, e mieria prve na to, e udia podahn vysokej zave. Podahn tomu, e nieo je vemi, vemi vhodn a nekontroluj si, i je to naozaj pravda. T prv vec, ktor je vemi dleit pri vpredajoch je to, aby ste si skontrolovali, i naozaj ide o zavu. Niekedy s to naozaj nekal praktiky predajcov, e ten tovar je zavnen len zopr dn pred tm vpredajom, ale inak ide v zsade o ben cenu. No a potom op, vrti sa len k tomu, e pokia sa naprklad chcem porovnva s niekm a niekto to u m a ja to ete nemm a maj to vo vpredaji, tak radej znovu, necha si odstup, dajte si t kvu, dajte si aj, vydchnite, a potom sa k tomu vrti, i naozaj je potrebn nakpi v tom vpredaji. Jana Kokov: Ako je to mono o sa tka bran verov na dareky v porovnan s minulosou. Ber udia v tomto obdob mono viac tch verov, zadluj sa viacej? Roman Fusek: Poas kalendrneho roka mme overen, e predvianon obdobie je obdobie zvenho zujmu o spotrebitesk ver, ale pokia sa bavme o obdobiach poslednch rokov, tak neevidujeme nejak zsadn zmenu pri tom, ako sa udia sprvaj ako spotrebitelia, i si ber viac spotrebiteskch verov ako v minulom obdob. Pokia pjde o sla za tento rok, tak tie uvidme, samozrejme, a na jar, alebo v prvom tvrroku budceho roka, ale to, o je tak e nejak plne zkladn rada je to, aby ste si na dareky ten ver urite nezobrali. Vdy je lepie, a mono aj pokia ide o vaich blzkych, bud ma viu rados z toho, ke sa nezadlte a dostan mono nieo menie, drobnejie a zo srdca, ako keby ste si mali preto uviaza na krk mono dvojron, trojron, alebo pron spltkov kalendr. Jana Kokov: Hlavne by udia teraz nemali podlieha impulzvnemu nakupovaniu v tomto obdob. Pn Fusek, akujem vm vemi pekne za tieto aktulne informcie, e ste prijali pozvanie do tdia. Pekn de ete.
